Derek, Trump’s vice
presidential running mate JD Vance is doubling down on attacking me as
“the enemy within” in a coordinated campaign of nationally televised
attacks.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=oct2024_abs_em.0Y0BaT&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_RES_AC90_20241021_PM3_V1_S1&email=&amount=10&t=1004&akid=7979%2E5257348%2ESTX9CQ ]Trump, Vance, and their allies have been overwhelming in their attacks
on me this week. Please, I am humbly asking. Can you make an urgent
$10
contribution so we can fight back and win?

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=oct2024_abs_em.0Y0BaT&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_RES_AC90_20241021_PM3_V1_S1&t=1005&akid=7979%2E5257348%2ESTX9CQ ]JD Vance defends Trump calling opponents 'enemy from within'

“He mentioned Adam Schiff and Nancy Pelosi by name in this case over the
weekend.” — Fox News host

“Yeah, Bill, well, look, I, I mean, you have Adam Schiff and Nancy Pelosi
who have really been part of weaponizing the Department of Justice against
our country.” — Vance

This is the closing argument for their campaign — that “enemies from
within” like Speaker Pelosi and myself are the greatest danger to our
country and Trump would be justified in using the United States’ military
force against us.

And his far-right Supreme Court has enabled him to do it if he wins.

Derek, it is
hard to overstate the matter, but Trump, Vance, and their allies’ attacks
on me as “the enemy within” and calls to deploy the military against me
have been everywhere.

Barnstorming California for a Coachella rally just weeks before Election
Day where they unveiled the attack. Announcing it again on Fox News and
defending it on CNN, NBC, ABC, and everywhere else since.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=oct2024_abs_em.0Y0BaT&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_RES_AC90_20241021_PM3_V1_S1&email=&amount=10&t=1006&akid=7979%2E5257348%2ESTX9CQ ]Richard Nixon and his “enemies list” looks quaint compared to Trump and
his cronies threatening military action against their domestic political
opponents, and we HAVE to respond. Please,
Derek, there
isn’t much time left. Can you pitch in
$10 before
it’s too late?

Is Mitch McConnell secretly stabbing conservative senators in the back this November? That's the scoop, according to _The Hill: "**Cruz and Scott, both McConnell critics, get cold shoulder amid tough races."**_
---
|
---
---
|
---
Recent polls in Texas and Florida show incumbent Senators **Ted Cruz** and **Rick Scott** in neck-and-neck races against leftwing Democrat challengers with control of the Senate hanging in the balance. Yet, while McConnell’s money machine is pouring cash into some Senate races, it’s conspicuously ignoring these two key states. Everyone knows why. Ted Cruz and Rick Scott are conservative patriots, not leadership lapdogs. They fight for the American people and for the Constitution, which means they often challenge the Beltway Establishment. **[**Please don't sleep on these Senate races. Support Ted Cruz and Rick Scott with a split contribution today.**](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=d6c0051626114888b2fdf2522311d006&_e=pLRFTNCXPMc9fATr0Wq9qSE_MDtJp07J6DeCA7nzUULB_xGy3VSBHJIp72gwCnCrUyqTYt9BDfqbVcO00CcbU2shdMuAKUeTs3Cq3WP0JwH1XonGoT3FN_w-DLcvyIXKnxv_8tCkQyWTMwAUaDmbh_jp6TOopEDXTaPIzLSn3wWjKgIDot4h75GmiAnEqmLlIpZYHdglDmOi2cSrJe9aqG_udtQM9EHRfA21FsEW2jCSEzVPu3SDWx85yLAjP0v6)** **_"Mitch McConnell runs the largest Republican super PAC in the country," said Senator Cruz. Fellow Conservative,

We’re in a dead heat, Fellow Conservative.

The latest polling in the Wisconsin Senate race shows I am up **just one point.**

That’s both good and bad.

Good -- because we’ve tightened this race. We’ve put Tammy Baldwin and Senate Democrats on their heels. Because of our hard work, this race is a TOSS UP. The momentum is with us as we enter the final two weeks of this race.

name: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez
subject: This weekend in Pennsylvania
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
#
The upcoming election on November 5th could be the most pivotal in our lifetime. We will not resign to pessimism or cynicism. I am committed to doing everything I can to support GOTV efforts in critical swing states, which is why this weekend we were in Pennsylvania!
On Friday, we went to Penn State in State College for a rally. I was amazed with the turn out, we had a sold out crowd with over 300 people in overflow! The rally was electric.
On Saturday, I kicked off a bilingual canvass in Allentown, where over a thousand people showed up to knock doors. We then held a rally with fellow Reps. Chrissy Houlahan, Madeleine Dean, and Nydia Velázquez.
On Sunday, we went to Philadelphia for two canvass launches, a rally with United Auto Workers President Shawn Fain, and SEIU 32BJ.
Check out some photos from the weekend:
Being an American is not about who we’re afraid of. It’s about being courageous. And it’s about standing up and courageously demanding what the direction is for a better country.
I am going to call a spade a spade, Kamala Harris will be the first woman president of the United States. She is a Black woman who will be a powerful leader for this country. And she comes from a middle-class and working-class background.
But as we know, if you come from a working-class background, you’ve got to work twice as hard to get half as far. She needs to work, and we need to work a hundred times as hard to pull this out.
Now more than ever, it is crucial that our party and country swiftly unite to defeat Donald Trump and the threat to American democracy.
Let's get to work.
[Help us continue the fight by making a grassroots donation right now! With just 15 days until the election, every single dollar will make a difference.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20241021.S2WoUK&refcode=em20241021-7426-P_FND_CTR_GRM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=7426%2E2526796%2E42LMY8)
**[Contribute $5](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20241021.S2WoUK&refcode=em20241021-7426-P_FND_CTR_GRM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=7426%2E2526796%2E42LMY8)**
Pa’lante,
Alexandria

Folks,
My family means the world to me.
In my mom and my sisters, I see the American dream.
My mom worked her whole life to provide for us. My sisters went to college and built successful lives in service to their own families and communities.
We started with next to nothing. No money. No connections. But we made it, because the American dream is still alive.
There’s no doubt that it’s become more difficult to pursue, though. After I left the Marines, I knew my service to our country wasn’t over. I’ve dedicated the last 20 years of my life to strengthening the American dream and delivering for people who need help.
But people like Kari Lake, like Donald Trump, they’re only out for themselves. They’ll attack anyone who doesn’t fall in line. They’ll stop at nothing in their pursuit of power and influence.

# Let’s Defeat Buddy Carter
---
| $50, Peter.

If you knew that **making a $50 contribution** to Patti Hewitt’s campaign meant she could **defeat Buddy Carter** in, wouldn’t it be worth it?

If you knew that **just $50 could help flip this critical seat** and send a representative to Congress who will fight for real change, **wouldn’t it be the best $50 you ever spent?**

name: Jon Hamm
subject: A note about Josh Hawley and January 6th.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Lucas Kunce for Missouri
body:
I’m not willing to sit on the sidelines in this election.
#
Hi Peter, it’s Jon Hamm.
I’m a born-and-raised Missourian who watched with horror when Josh Hawley raised his fist at insurrectionists outside the U.S. Capitol on January 6th, then ran out the back door when they stormed the building later that day.
I’ve seen communities across my home state torn apart because of cowardly politicians like him — and I’m not willing to sit on the sidelines in this election.
So before I ask you to **[add a donation of $10 or whatever you can to my friend Lucas Kunce’s campaign to replace Josh Hawley,](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/79599?refcode=em20241021-8174&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=8174%2E614464%2EtUEShd) please let me tell you why:**
**[SUPPORT LUCAS KUNCE](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/79599?refcode=em20241021-8174&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=8174%2E614464%2EtUEShd)**
Most of my family is from a town in Missouri called Ste. Genevieve, about 60 miles south of St. Louis. I’ve watched their community go downhill for years.
While corrupt politicians shipped jobs overseas and voted to give handouts to Wall Street and their corporate allies, everyday people just trying to survive in the place they call home ran out of money and opportunities.
**Our leaders abandoned them — and Josh Hawley is the perfect example.**
Instead of fighting for what would make the communities in my home state stronger, Josh Hawley has been busy engaging in the out-of-touch culture wars that only divide us — all so he can get more and more power for himself.
That’s what we saw on January 6th, 2021. Hawley raised his fist at rioters outside the Capitol because he thought it would make himself look strong. But when sh*t got real, he ran out the back door like a coward — away from the same people he was claiming to support just hours earlier.
What’s even more ridiculous? Since that day, Hawley has desperately tried to convince all of us that he’s the authority on what it means to be a man in this country. He even published a whole book about it last year:
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/79599?refcode=em20241021-8174&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=8174%2E614464%2EtUEShd)
Well... when I think about manhood, I think about courage. And that’s not something you can write a book about.
Missouri is the Show Me State. Courage is something you have to show us.
**That’s why I’m supporting Lucas Kunce for Missouri’s U.S. Senate seat.** As a born-and-raised Missourian who joined the Marines to serve the community that took care of him growing up, Lucas has already shown us that he knows the true meaning of courage.
Lucas knows courage is about standing up to the powerful and working to rebuild our state. And he knows real leaders fight to empower everyday people and secure our future for generations to come — not for their own power or profit.
**So Peter, if you want to be told about manhood, some guy wrote a book about it.[But if you want someone to show you real courage, please join me in supporting Lucas Kunce for U.S. Senate by adding a donation of $10 to his campaign today.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/79599?refcode=em20241021-8174&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=8174%2E614464%2EtUEShd)**
If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly:
[Contribute $10](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/79600?refcode=em20241021-8174&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=10&t=5&akid=8174%2E614464%2EtUEShd) [Contribute $25](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/79600?refcode=em20241021-8174&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=25&t=6&akid=8174%2E614464%2EtUEShd) [Contribute $30](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/79600?refcode=em20241021-8174&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=30&t=7&akid=8174%2E614464%2EtUEShd) [Contribute $50](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/79600?refcode=em20241021-8174&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=50&t=8&akid=8174%2E614464%2EtUEShd) [Contribute $100](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/79600?refcode=em20241021-8174&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=100&t=9&akid=8174%2E614464%2EtUEShd) [Contribute $250](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/79600?refcode=em20241021-8174&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=250&t=10&akid=8174%2E614464%2EtUEShd) [Give another amount](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/79599?refcode=em20241021-8174&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=11&akid=8174%2E614464%2EtUEShd)
---
**Lucas worked hard over the last year to put Missouri’s Senate race on the map.** From calling out Josh Hawley’s blatant corruption to building a coalition of working people, pro-democracy organizations like End Citizens United, and local leaders across Missouri — he is Democrats’ best chance to defeat a GOP incumbent and flip a U.S. Senate seat this election cycle.
He’s building a truly grassroots campaign, without a cent from corporate PACs, to defeat Hawley and take back power for everyday working Missourians — just like my friends and family in Ste. Genevieve.
**It has never been more important to elect a warrior for working people like Lucas Kunce to the U.S. Senate.[So Peter, will you join me in supporting Lucas Kunce by adding a donation of $10 to his grassroots campaign today?](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/79599?refcode=em20241021-8174&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=12&akid=8174%2E614464%2EtUEShd)**
**[SUPPORT LUCAS KUNCE](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/79599?refcode=em20241021-8174&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=13&akid=8174%2E614464%2EtUEShd)**
Thanks for standing with me,
Jon Hamm

So before I ask you to please let me tell you why: Most of my family is from a town in Missouri called Ste. Genevieve, about 60 miles south of St. Louis. I’ve watched their community go downhill for years. While corrupt politicians shipped jobs overseas and voted to give handouts to Wall Street and their corporate allies, everyday people just trying to survive in the place they call home ran out of money and opportunities. Our leaders abandoned them — and Josh Hawley is the perfect example. Instead of fighting for what would make the communities in my home state stronger, Josh Hawley has been busy engaging in the out-of-touch culture wars that only divide us — all so he can get more and more power for himself. That’s what we saw on January 6th, 2021. Hawley raised his fist at rioters outside the Capitol because he thought it would make himself look strong. But when sht got real, he ran out the back door like a coward — away from the same people he was claiming to support just hours earlier. What’s even more ridiculous? Since that day, Hawley has desperately tried to convince all of us that he’s the authority on what it means to be a man in this country. He even published a whole book about it last year: Well... when I think about manhood, I think about courage. And that’s not something you can write a book about. Missouri is the Show Me State. Courage is something you have to show us. That’s why I’m supporting Lucas Kunce for Missouri’s U.S. Senate seat. As a born-and-raised Missourian who joined the Marines to serve the community that took care of him growing up, Lucas has already shown us that he knows the true meaning of courage. Lucas knows courage is about standing up to the powerful and working to rebuild our state. And he knows real leaders fight to empower everyday people and secure our future for generations to come — not for their own power or profit. So Peter, if you want to be told about manhood, some guy wrote a book about it. | | Our nation is facing serious problems.

We have a spiraling national debt, a looming fiscal cliff for Social Security and Medicare, a bloated federal bureaucracy, and a dysfunctional welfare system.

My name is David Pan, and I am running for Congress to solve these problems by phasing out our welfare and entitlement programs and returning the money back to the people as a universal basic income of $16,000 per year for everyone 21 and older. My plan would eliminate the fraud and waste of our existing bureaucracy and save over $1 trillion per year. It would also guarantee current Social Security and Medicare benefits for everyone 37 and older while giving our young people a new system that provides them the freedom and the responsibility to make their own futures. Whether or not you agree with all the details of my plan, please support me if you want a serious discussion of the key issues that we are facing as a nation but no politicians are willing to address.

Vote for David Pan for Congress, tell your friends and family, and find out more about my campaign at [davidpanforcongress.com](https://eot.davidpanforcongress.org/f/a/9aJcU7IrAXoRlWWZ0Vnfnw~~/AAAHUQA~/RgRo-ZKTP0UgMjkwNDc3Y2Y3YThmNzc1Y2Q1NDg5ZDgwMjYyNDhiYjJEHmh0dHA6Ly9kYXZpZHBhbmZvcmNvbmdyZXNzLmNvbVcFc3BjZXVCCmcOkw0XZ9L0bZxSFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAGud).

name: Team Carris
subject: Don't Forget! Early Voting Starts Today—Bank Your Vote Before November 5th!
body:
Peter,Today marks an exciting milestone: **the first day of expanded early voting in the 10th District** , covering portions of Lake, McHenry, and North Suburban Cook County! **For the next two weeks, every voter has the chance to bank their vote before November 5th**. For the next two weeks, you may be asking, **what can I do to help? How can I get involved?****Vote Early and Know Where to Go!**
Make sure to cast your vote and help plan for others including those who are elderly or have limited mobility! Voting early means no waiting in long lines on Election Day, and it ensures your vote is safely in--no need to worry about last-minute emergencies or scheduling conflicts. Plus, it gives you the flexibility to vote when it's most convenient for you.As our campaign focuses its resources over the next two weeks, we will be following up with absentee and mail-in voters as well as swing voters. **Every early vote cast helps us conserve resources that can be used to reach out to those who need more persuasion or assistance voting. We 're counting on you to take action and help Jim!**Click below to find out more about early voting locations, hours, and instructions. [LAKE COUNTY VOTER SERVICES](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-sjdjhx-tlidtddjku-r/) [MCHENRY COUNTY VOTER SERVICES](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-sjdjhx-tlidtddjku-y/) [COOK COUNTY VOTER SERVICES](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-sjdjhx-tlidtddjku-j/) **Help Support Voter Education**
If you've already voted or you're passionate about getting the word out, there's still time to help. **Your donation today will help us reach voters digitally, via mail, and in person throughout the District to inform them about Jim 's platform.****[Can we count on you to contribute $25 right now to help continue voter outreach efforts?](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-sjdjhx-tlidtddjku-t/)** [HELP WITH A $25 DONATION TODAY](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-sjdjhx-tlidtddjku-i/) **Bring Jim 's Message to Your Neighborhood with a Yard Sign**
It's not too late to request a yard sign! Our team will deliver it right to your door. **Let 's show our neighbors that we're fighting for change by supporting a candidate willing to put it all on the line to improve the state of our communities.** [REQUEST A YARD SIGN](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-sjdjhx-tlidtddjku-d/) Thank you for your ongoing support. Together, we can make a difference and send Jim to Washington in just a few short weeks. _Mark_ Team Carris [](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-sjdjhx-tlidtddjku-h/)[](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-sjdjhx-tlidtddjku-k/)[](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-sjdjhx-tlidtddjku-u/)[](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-sjdjhx-tlidtddjku-o/) [ Share ](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-fb-sjdjhx-tlidtddjku-m/) [ Tweet ](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-tw-sjdjhx-tlidtddjku-c/) [ Share ](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-li-sjdjhx-tlidtddjku-q/) [ Forward ](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.forwardtomyfriend.com/t-tlidtddjku-FE53F914-sjdjhx-l-a) | [Unsubscribe](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-u-sjdjhx-tlidtddjku-f/)

## Do you think that most Americans understand how the Electoral College works and its role in preserving free and representative government?
[YES](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=68cd1488c1194c548aea4e939c597ec9&_e=Su5wqSOJCVNFRB3s5N711HY145tYy4IEWtkTZEwVabA0fE9WE_RoxqSqssTk3qxudZNa6VBHUO1MtFNZF6ueTr8BGy2nOH524f4PclolMyvozGqeNqjEHFyGuysuFL9WvEmmoAkJVOf0lwD2NOX37DSB2IVoyAC7zh8HyEiGiNl8AlTWdDvL_oH1OWSBHLIco06CFJHCssMc_2j4hmPmsX_j9zvM5petWOL4Tk9Lf7ouiCEmIVuene3Jn60YkHCVSfbzWWjrrEvnnOnBoyCMA_8tIuJFPEshZ7R0QYUdcO256VjCC-u4Wax7gENr-dl-IB3lyPRvSUJVAyfznZPMT2YbUUSGW3aca7m3V9AtCNTbD9xwENJvg_DmHDNIEK-0uHoH3ElLMBlb_uXwvx8Xp68MipOVqg6bZc_p888O4V0%3D) [NO](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=68cd1488c1194c548aea4e939c597ec9&_e=Su5wqSOJCVNFRB3s5N711HY145tYy4IEWtkTZEwVabA0fE9WE_RoxqSqssTk3qxudZNa6VBHUO1MtFNZF6ueTr8BGy2nOH524f4PclolMyvozGqeNqjEHFyGuysuFL9WvEmmoAkJVOf0lwD2NOX37DSB2IVoyAC7zh8HyEiGiNl8AlTWdDvL_oH1OWSBHLIco06CFJHCssMc_2j4hmPmsX_j9zvM5petWOL4Tk9Lf7ouiCEmIVuene3Jn60YkHCVSfbzWWjrrEvnnOnBoyCMA1N8zlE0Bb0ZqH9XNvUx_s6oX3a63zne4mzv_3BzcrO4NhEO1J8x3vkshW-1q8lXPMxHMo3Mxqja8pDG1mbOrG8s8o4O6g0uq8bBLeWeDYC8e1O1MpVwXQOWYGsYNqaWX1oNJPN9Qgk57gUg_-xuQow%3D) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. ## Execution Delay Continues
Death row inmate Robert Roberson, whose execution was delayed hours before it was scheduled last week, [did not appear Monday](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGO8yAQhJ8Gd1jLghNcUPyNu_ztldYa1gk6bCLDheTtT0l_1Yw00jfS93WZLxRT3K__aWNXn2ueEdBIBRJxDhTTazZdcAuEUXXs1BnHYdQKoLs5O5jFjNauGPhkrLVnu6IPg_aagDR00b1hChAVaKWH3pPV3q4DkTboBxAGOMSaj77euPKTyppe-cFH7_PWJXer9V6E_idwEji11nq_lJ1bee8Cp3cVOB154aPKT5S8y8qlxjVykR-mTNQ2-uajSH6y_6kx7wKn7nDh3mJKsZzOwsB1o5g-x_VPEw-HvwEAAP__-tpidQ) before the Texas House committee that had issued a last-minute subpoena. Attorney General Ken Paxton's office [refused to allow](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0UL3O4yAQfBrcEcHi34LiGrrv2iujDd7YSBgs2MTx258cXXvVrjSj-fvzc__BEENafuNGlj_PfAcFrdRKAtxnDPG8t81sH2qedENWDzB1k9FKNavttZrJPHVvoDMePfh-aHU_ecJJ-bFtgr3EtALQymjT3TyOxo_PDtG04DslWkVz4FxuvBLTB-sznvlN5ebz1kS7Mu9VmF8CnAB3HMetMjLVDdPFEOAq53IKcImOKsDtOQYOvn4RZBLgrggCnFbXrwW4r49c8lsuhRaJj0dmliU_qPw7NSc5E_IqSz5kSBsySabKYcvplGt-VZI7JoqSPuRfHHIS4IZu6EfTjUoNAlxT7LwfIcZQ-0G0atkwxG8v_u_Qbwt_AwAA__9ydIBc) Roberson, convicted of killing his daughter in 2003, to appear in person over security concerns. The committee declined to take his testimony virtually. Meanwhile, Gov. Greg Abbott has asked the Texas Supreme Court to throw out the House committee's subpoena. At issue is whether the state's ["junk science" law ](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kD2P8yAQhH-N3REtCxhcULxNurztldYaloQ7YiKbfP37k-_qq0ajkUaPno_TdKJc8nL-T1f27ZXqhIBaSBCIU6Rc3pPuo58hjrJnLy2OZlQSoL941MZZsjrIwZJxMyUVhzSAmSXgrGSf_X4mAVGCksocAjkVXDJESmMw0GngmFtdD-3CjV-0pfKuD14PoV774i-t3bZO_evw2OGRbgs_t33ay9pyKNzh8fO-fIlU6MlRbCHzEljwi8O95bqItc68tt_Y6iL0SAqDczGOxszWWWM4WKuHAACQuF99vD1zKXkbbKfhfKVcfnDan34eHr8DAAD__9CxZs8)should overturn Roberson's conviction for the controversial "shaken baby" diagnosis.
## Houston Helicopter Crash Kills Four
A helicopter carrying three adults and a child [crashed into a radio tower](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00LGOszAQBOCnMR1od4FgFy7-hi5_eyUy9hJbcjCyfSF5-1NSXXP1p5mR5uu6XE2IYb_9N3fW9bmlhYCGFqElWpwJ8bUMjdMrOIUNa5xIjapHgMbrVa6TkpcVeJsALMCETFKBG4zcUHIT9LsMgQihx37srJG9ldtoTD-QHUEMwC7UlLvqufLTlC2-0oNzZ9O9idrXehTR_xM0C5rP8-ysz2l_q6B557MImn36LjXt7ScvaDa5Bhv5l3iOwaajcm5tNsW3qOSIE47d4Y8ma3ecIcZQLpMY4HY3IX7265-HPDT9BAAA__9KZWMo) Sunday night near downtown Houston. There were no survivors. The tower's lights were reported as inoperable [as recently as October 16](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGO6yAQAL8Gd2vBgmOnoHiNu7z2SgsvS4xCTARcnPz9KddfPdJoNF-X5eJiivv1v7uzba-QF5RoQElAXLyL6b2YzttV-rPq2KoRz8NZKym7zaL0NKIPK5pAJKegx0kFr4YTBqPl2kX7kSmJqKRWeujJTZqmMDinDdIghZHsY8ulbxs3frka0js_ufSU712yW2uPKvQ_gbPA-TiO_rbl7w8UOLvSIiUWOO98VIFzyuSSwHnjFCk_Gheg4uoGIRaG4nzM0PLBBXi_crox1FaYG7CrDXj3AmecBjiZgMQ4ATKvYMzgYdXkwXg2NK2KpMOuWP84YkqxnkZh5PXuYvqtbn9ufFr8CQAA__9lGXRD), though distant security camera footage of the crash appears to show the tower light flashing. The crash caused the tower to collapse, sparking a fire in the area. No injuries were reported on the ground. ([Watch Video](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0z7uOwyAQheGngS4WDBdDQbGNu2y7pYXNOEbCITKTxHn7VdKnPcV39P-dx3PMJV8vv3HDQMdSRxCgT1KcAMYUc3mNmqcwieQlxyB78MYrKQRfg1sQcenB92lC9AaNnic72UlqZb21PIc3JgWAFEoq083RqdktJkalYTaCaYEpU907WpHwiG0pr_rAvZvrxktYiW6NqR8GA4PheK8MhrXeG9VrzPuTwdAo0r0xGKTT7vME3hpnvQPL95Buz1xKbrZnWly2mMvHpq-xjwD_AQAA__-xg1Rc))

South Texas farmers and ranchers can now draw irrigation water from the Rio Grande [following a new executive order](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLvO4yAQhZ8GdxPB2PhSUGzj7t92S2sCg4MWmwiInbz9yum3Oc2RvnP587P8UIhhX3_Txqa-fVpQYgdKAuLiKMTP0jXO3KWbVMNGDTjpqVVSNg9z14MemaX3pKZeDr2mSeuuVWM_-f7eN8FcMCURlWxVq2-WxtaOXhO1HVotRSfZhZryrT648puKj590cL7ZtDXRPGp9FtH-EjgLnM_zvP0tVC9T4LzzWQTOMVmKAucrSuCs5CWDwPnLA1pzsK9YX5nBpm0LpYS0cy6w8wn8Zvuq4WBI2XEGCluBmuCZ0xEcw0mVM_iUIYcEa6bdMRwUI3_AU944XxWabNzzDDGG0g-ik-tGIX4n1P9-ehj8FwAA__8BqXre) from Texas Agriculture Commissioner Sid Miller. Miller noted that runoff from heavy rains in Mexico [is being wasted](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00LGOszAQBOCnMR3Iu7YBFy7-hi5_eyXaw3awZDDCeyF5-1PSXzsafRrN122-Ucppv_-nLTh-xjKjRN2CbBFnTym_Zt149y29hSY4GNAaq0DKZnUqRgkaQuxHsAYs2NEPozRL3_vYD6ZJ7o2BRASpQJluoVEtYzRESuNipNAy-MTl7HgNHJ5UY36VRzi7pWxNdivzUYX6J3ASOF3X1W2vSjvtXPZU3iWB0x6uKnCq5YfX9oMInOjktOQgcPok7UUczrau5WS6hxbsqHuDpjvWozmdP66Uc6r9ILS8b5TyZwD_-cjD4W8AAAD__2BHYy8) due to what he called unnecessary restrictions. Texas officials say Mexico hasn't adhered to the current water agreement. "_Enough is enough_ ," Miller said. | Hi Peter — I just made a risky decision, and Blue Amp Action suggested I reach out to share it directly. Let me explain: I just launched the final TV ad of my campaign to replace Mark Robinson and flip the NC Lieutenant Governor’s Office. And while we had enough resources to secure TV time in North Carolina’s two biggest markets, we ultimately fell short of the funding needed to confidently go on air in Eastern North Carolina. I gave the green light to expand our ad buy into Eastern North Carolina anyway — even though we currently don’t have the money in our budget. Now, I’m counting on this team to close this budget gap so we can keep our ads and other programs running without serious cutbacks. [We’re facing an uphill battle to keep our ad on the air in key markets through Election Day, so please, split a donation between my campaign and Blue Amp Action’s today to ensure as many NC voters as possible see our message.](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tde31bf8c-0c95-4a06-8a73-979ac82f6304/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Decisions like this are never easy, Peter. We need to balance our TV budget against a bunch of other important needs like supplies for volunteers, staff, events, and so much more, but here’s why I took a risk: Every public poll shows me running neck-and-neck with my opponent — and Mark Robinson’s handpicked running mate — Hal Weatherman, in this race to become North Carolina’s next Lieutenant Governor. This election will come down to which team does a better job of reaching voters with their message. That’s why I ultimately made the decision to go all-in reaching voters in Eastern NC and other communities Democrats don’t always invest in. This ad is one of our best opportunities to reach millions of voters before Election Day and swing this toss-up race in our favor, and we have to take advantage of it. Let me be clear: This was a tough call — but it’s one I felt we ultimately had to make to give ourselves the best possible chance of flipping the Lieutenant Governor’s office blue. [I felt confident taking this risk because I knew folks like you would step up and have my back. So please, Peter, will you split a donation between my campaign and Blue Amp Action’s today to ensure we can reach as many voters as possible with our new TV ad?](https://default.salsalabs.org/T96a934cf-ed6a-48e2-8035-8e05dd6e6f8e/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

| FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE TUESDAY, OCTOBER 22
KELLY LOEFFLER ISSUES STATEMENT ON VOTER ROLL CITIZENSHIP AUDIT
(ATLANTA) - Today, Greater Georgia Chairwoman Kelly Loeffler issued the following statement after Secretary of State Brad Raffensperger agreed to release the results of his 2024 voter roll citizenship audit. The statement comes after repeated outreach from Loeffler - who wrote a private letter to Raffensperger requesting the results of the audit last month. The letter was never answered and the findings were never publicized, even though the audit was first announced in July.

body:

---
Fellow American, America is at a critical crossroads, and we need to be brave now more than ever. For years the radical left has waged an all-out war against the Christian values that built this nation. As you look around at today’s culture, it’s easy to feel discouraged. But I believe with all my heart that this moment in history offers an opportunity for a spiritual comeback in America — a chance for people of faith to rise up and lead our nation back to God. My name is Kirk Cameron, and I’m not just an actor or an author. I’m a Christian, a father, and someone who deeply loves this country. Over the years, I’ve witnessed a steady erosion of the values that made America great — values rooted in faith, family, and freedom.
---
| | But recently I’ve been seeing the rumblings of revival across the nation, and I know there’s hope if we act now. In my new book, _Born to Be Brave: How to be a Part of America’s Spiritual Comeback_ , I explain how Christians can lean into their “birthright of courage” to overcome fear and boldly live out their faith. **[**And I want to offer you the opportunity to get one of the first signed copies of my latest book while supporting a project near and dear to my heart.**](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2z3u8gb0rc5l0j4uo6vtkivf98th6qcsim0cpf8qo_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4sdg61pj4c9h2bs)**

---
| | I’ve partnered with Brave Books because I believe that by standing together and standing strong, we can realign this nation with Heaven’s values. We’ve already seen the impact of that courage in our nationwide “See You at the Library” movement. This past August, over 30,000 God-fearing Americans joined us at public libraries to reclaim these spaces for God and country. Together, we reclaimed our nation’s libraries and read stories that teach children the values of faith, bravery, and love of God and country. But this is just the beginning. My friends at Brave Books and I are determined to take this movement even further. We have a goal of reaching 100,000 children in the next year with wholesome, God-honoring Story Hours across the nation — and we need your help. [**That’s why I’m asking you to support our mission with a special donation today. And as a special thank-you for your generous gift of $100 or more, I’ll send you a signed copy of my new book,****_Born to Be Brave_****.**](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2zdm8i8vr4pvh12vl7e7dst7dfhu1fjss7o0dreeg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4sdg61pj4c9h2bs) Your donation will help fund our nationwide Story Hour initiative, sending “Story Hour Kits” filled with faith-based, patriotic books to parents and grandparents who want to counter the radical left’s influence in our libraries. Each kit equips families with the tools they need to teach children the truth about faith, freedom, and the values that made America great. America’s future depends on what we do today. Together, we can stand boldly for what is right and bring our nation back to God. **[Please donate today and join us in this revival of faith and freedom. With your support, we can ensure that America’s children grow up with the courage to stand for truth.](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2ziofqbm1sdpt1666bppgi9qcn050281i3i3gp200_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4sdg61pj4c9h2bs)** Thank you, and may God bless you and this great nation. In faith,

name: Heidi Ganahl
subject: The Mountain Minute: 10/22/2024
body:
Colorado ranks 8th in violent crime, 4th in property crime and auto theft
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hi everyone,
Wow, Sunday night’s Grand Junction Rocky Mountain Rumble was amazing! Your energy and passion really lit up the room. Let’s keep this excitement going all the way to Election Day. Chat with your friends, fire up your family, and let’s get everyone out to vote. We’ve got this!
This is the Mountain Minute for Tuesday, October 22, 2024.
– Heidi Ganahl
---
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[Colorado ranks 8th in violent crime, 4th in property crime and auto theft](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [COMMON SENSE INSTITUTE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_The Federal Bureau of Investigation recently revised its national crime data to reflect latecomer reports from police agencies. In doing so, it was revealed that the national violent crime rate rose in 2023 rather than fell. CSI is presenting the FBI’s Colorado’s crime data to firmly establish the Centennial State’s trends, which remain largely unchanged as a result of the update._
_Crucially, crime is not just a social ill but an economic one. Previous CSI findings have highlighted the negative economic consequences of crime. In 2022, the tangible and intangible costs of Colorado’s crime totaled $4,623 per Coloradan._
_**Key Findings**_
* _Even though Colorado’s violent crime rate came down in 2023 from a peak in 2022, it is still at an elevated rate equivalent to the average rate of violent crime during the mid-nineteen nineties (1994 and 1995)_
* _It again has the 8th-highest violent crime rate among U.S. states and the District of Columbia, the same ranking as in 2022._
* _While Colorado’s property crime rate came down in 2023 from a peak in 2022, it is still a top ten state with the nation’s 4th-highest property crime rate._
* _Colorado ranks 4th highest in the nation for auto theft, down from #1 in 2021._

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Colorado justices, 4-2, rule tenants have right to a jury trial in eviction cases](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [COLORADO POLITICS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* The Colorado Supreme Court ruled 4-2 that tenants have the right to a jury trial in eviction cases where factual disputes exist, countering the routine denial of this right by county courts.
* Justice Carlos A. Samour Jr. explained that while jury trials may overwhelm courts, the decision aligns with practices in other states, and only certain eviction cases involving factual disputes would qualify for a jury.
* Justice William W. Hood III dissented, arguing that the state's eviction law envisions rapid proceedings, making jury trials impractical within the typical short timelines.
* Tenant advocates, such as the Colorado Poverty Law Project, praised the decision for giving renters the chance to have their disputes heard by a jury of peers. Landlord groups expressed concern that adding jury trials to eviction cases could increase costs and delays, potentially burdening property owners and the court system.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Want to know how to vote? Here’s a collection of ballot guides for 2024 election](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [COMPLETE COLORADO](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Colorado’s 2024 general election ballot includes 14 statewide measures, both constitutional and statutory, along with many local measures, which can be overwhelming for voters.
* Complete Colorado has compiled various ballot guides from libertarian and right-of-center sources, as well as one from Governor Jared Polis, to help voters navigate the measures.
* Notable guides include those from The Independence Institute, Centennial Institute, and radio hosts like Mandy Connell, Ross Kaminsky, and Kim Monson, each offering their unique perspectives on the measures and judicial retention. Former state leaders, such as Mark Hillman and Mike Rosen, also provide their analysis and recommendations.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Turning Point Action’s ‘moneyball’ ballot-chasing success ‘most unreported, untold Story’ of 2024](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [BREITBART](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Turning Point Action has adopted and refined the Democrats' ballot-chasing strategy for the 2024 election, focusing on turning out low propensity voters to boost Republican numbers.
* In Arizona, Turning Point Action is outpacing Democrats in turning in early votes, with a reported ratio of 4-to-1 in favor of Republicans, aiming to secure over 150,000 additional votes.
* Tyler Bowyer, COO of Turning Point Action, highlighted the group's "Moneyball" strategy, which involves targeting specific voter segments that typically don't vote, adding 2-5% more votes to help close gaps in tight races.
* The success of this ballot-chasing effort in key battleground states like Arizona, Wisconsin, and Pennsylvania could significantly impact the outcome of the 2024 election, especially for Donald Trump.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Aurora Showdown: Anti-Establishment Fire Ignites Voter Frenzy](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [MIG REPORTS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Between Oct. 9-16, Aurora, Colorado, became a hotspot for intense political activity and discussion following Trump’s rally in the city. Residents are grappling with a whirlwind of emotions—anxiety, enthusiasm, and distrust—all of which are influencing their civic engagement and voting propensity.
* Pro-Trump supporters view him as a necessary disruptor of a corrupt system, while Harris supporters see their vote as a defense against authoritarianism.
* Both sides share a deep anti-establishment sentiment, reflecting widespread disillusionment with traditional political and media institutions.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Harris ‘flatlining’ in polls while Trump rises](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE HILL](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Karl Rove, Republican strategist, stated that Vice President Kamala Harris is "flatlining" in the polls while Donald Trump is gaining ground, leading to a closely contested race.
* Harris initially gained momentum after receiving President Biden’s endorsement and becoming the official Democratic nominee but has since seen her support level off.
* Recent polls show a tightening race, with Trump erasing Harris’s lead in several swing states, making the election too close to call. Different poll aggregators offer varying forecasts, with some showing Trump leading in seven states and others showing Harris ahead in four states.
* With just 15 days until Election Day, Rove predicts a "nail-biter" election that will likely come down to the wire.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Trump served more McDonald’s french fries in 15 minutes than Harris probably ever has](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE FEDERALIST](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Donald Trump served French fries at a McDonald’s in Pennsylvania, joking that he worked longer there in 15 minutes than Kamala Harris allegedly did during her supposed stint as a McDonald’s cook.
* Harris has claimed to have worked at McDonald’s, but reports, including from the Washington Free Beacon, suggest she may have fabricated or exaggerated this experience, which was absent from her previous public records and biographies.
* In a recent interview, Harris reiterated that she worked at McDonald’s, but she did not provide details, leaving questions about the claim unanswered.
* Trump used the opportunity to criticize Harris and Biden for policies he says hurt franchise businesses, while also promising "no tax on tips" under his administration.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Williams: Bandimere Speedway leaves behind many fond memories over a 65-year run](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY LACI WILLAIMS, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_For 65 years, Bandimere Speedway provided a safe haven for adrenaline junkies chasing speed over a quarter mile._
_Yesterday, we said goodbye. The multi-generational Bandimere family welcomed multi-generational racers and the public to a “Surrender the Mountain” final event, including a final burnout from John Bandimere Jr., a speech from John “Sporty” Bandimere, the removal of the lighting system, and a final public walk down the raceway._
_John Bandimere Jr. explained during his farewell that with houses being built around the racetrack and the growing popularity of the sport, it had outgrown the space. He noted that it was time for a new chapter._

clean_body: Colorado ranks 8th in violent crime, 4th in property crime and auto theft | | | | PRESENTED BY | | Hi everyone, Wow, Sunday night’s Grand Junction Rocky Mountain Rumble was amazing! Your energy and passion really lit up the room. Let’s keep this excitement going all the way to Election Day. Chat with your friends, fire up your family, and let’s get everyone out to vote. We’ve got this! This is the Mountain Minute for Tuesday, October 22, 2024. – Heidi Ganahl | TODAY'S TOP STORIES The Federal Bureau of Investigation recently revised its national crime data to reflect latecomer reports from police agencies. In doing so, it was revealed that the national violent crime rate rose in 2023 rather than fell. CSI is presenting the FBI’s Colorado’s crime data to firmly establish the Centennial State’s trends, which remain largely unchanged as a result of the update. Crucially, crime is not just a social ill but an economic one. Previous CSI findings have highlighted the negative economic consequences of crime. In 2022, the tangible and intangible costs of Colorado’s crime totaled $4,623 per Coloradan. Key Findings Even though Colorado’s violent crime rate came down in 2023 from a peak in 2022, it is still at an elevated rate equivalent to the average rate of violent crime during the mid-nineteen nineties (1994 and 1995) It again has the 8th-highest violent crime rate among U.S. states and the District of Columbia, the same ranking as in 2022. While Colorado’s property crime rate came down in 2023 from a peak in 2022, it is still a top ten state with the nation’s 4th-highest property crime rate. Colorado ranks 4th highest in the nation for auto theft, down from #1 in 2021. | The Colorado Supreme Court ruled 4-2 that tenants have the right to a jury trial in eviction cases where factual disputes exist, countering the routine denial of this right by county courts. Justice Carlos A. Samour Jr. explained that while jury trials may overwhelm courts, the decision aligns with practices in other states, and only certain eviction cases involving factual disputes would qualify for a jury. Justice William W. Hood III dissented, arguing that the state's eviction law envisions rapid proceedings, making jury trials impractical within the typical short timelines. Tenant advocates, such as the Colorado Poverty Law Project, praised the decision for giving renters the chance to have their disputes heard by a jury of peers. Landlord groups expressed concern that adding jury trials to eviction cases could increase costs and delays, potentially burdening property owners and the court system. | Colorado’s 2024 general election ballot includes 14 statewide measures, both constitutional and statutory, along with many local measures, which can be overwhelming for voters. Complete Colorado has compiled various ballot guides from libertarian and right-of-center sources, as well as one from Governor Jared Polis, to help voters navigate the measures. Notable guides include those from The Independence Institute, Centennial Institute, and radio hosts like Mandy Connell, Ross Kaminsky, and Kim Monson, each offering their unique perspectives on the measures and judicial retention. Former state leaders, such as Mark Hillman and Mike Rosen, also provide their analysis and recommendations. | Turning Point Action has adopted and refined the Democrats' ballot-chasing strategy for the 2024 election, focusing on turning out low propensity voters to boost Republican numbers. In Arizona, Turning Point Action is outpacing Democrats in turning in early votes, with a reported ratio of 4-to-1 in favor of Republicans, aiming to secure over 150,000 additional votes. Tyler Bowyer, COO of Turning Point Action, highlighted the group's "Moneyball" strategy, which involves targeting specific voter segments that typically don't vote, adding 2-5% more votes to help close gaps in tight races. The success of this ballot-chasing effort in key battleground states like Arizona, Wisconsin, and Pennsylvania could significantly impact the outcome of the 2024 election, especially for Donald Trump. | Between Oct. 9-16, Aurora, Colorado, became a hotspot for intense political activity and discussion following Trump’s rally in the city. Residents are grappling with a whirlwind of emotions—anxiety, enthusiasm, and distrust—all of which are influencing their civic engagement and voting propensity. Pro-Trump supporters view him as a necessary disruptor of a corrupt system, while Harris supporters see their vote as a defense against authoritarianism. Both sides share a deep anti-establishment sentiment, reflecting widespread disillusionment with traditional political and media institutions. | Karl Rove, Republican strategist, stated that Vice President Kamala Harris is "flatlining" in the polls while Donald Trump is gaining ground, leading to a closely contested race. Harris initially gained momentum after receiving President Biden’s endorsement and becoming the official Democratic nominee but has since seen her support level off. Recent polls show a tightening race, with Trump erasing Harris’s lead in several swing states, making the election too close to call. Different poll aggregators offer varying forecasts, with some showing Trump leading in seven states and others showing Harris ahead in four states. With just 15 days until Election Day, Rove predicts a "nail-biter" election that will likely come down to the wire. | Donald Trump served French fries at a McDonald’s in Pennsylvania, joking that he worked longer there in 15 minutes than Kamala Harris allegedly did during her supposed stint as a McDonald’s cook. Harris has claimed to have worked at McDonald’s, but reports, including from the Washington Free Beacon, suggest she may have fabricated or exaggerated this experience, which was absent from her previous public records and biographies. ### The way we elect people is really dumb
[Denny Hoskins](https://substack.com/redirect/3e182a35-1a61-4ee1-bfee-b7d4d28ca911?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) will be Missouri's next Secretary of State.
I wish that weren't the case, because party affiliation aside, he's nuts.4 There are competent Republicans out there, but he isn't one of them. I'm going to vote for [Democratic nominee Barbara Phifer](https://substack.com/redirect/9c12fba6-abe1-477d-9b65-e86aefd5ca26?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). But Missouri is a red state, and she's going to lose.
Secretary of State races are important, because they administer elections. Denny is probably going to do that very badly. But he's going to be our next Secretary of State anyway.
Why?
There were eight candidates in the [Republican primary for Secretary of State](https://substack.com/redirect/418da6a9-8904-4b4f-8103-b7334d361dea?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and in states like Missouri--[as I've written about before](https://substack.com/redirect/b15ffc3e-53f8-4663-ba00-548819df3fc7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--whoever wins the Republican primary is the de-facto winner of the general election. And Denny will be the Secretary of State because he won a crowded primary with less than 25% of the vote:
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/d17e420f-e05a-4fff-80d2-e9f6f909c2d6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
As of 2022, [Missouri had about 4.3 million registered voters](https://substack.com/redirect/22caded7-33ff-40c7-8656-a2c7aa503933?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). So with that in mind, here's a quick run-down of the election that got Denny Hoskins, who wants to run Missouri's elections by [_checks notes_] [removing voting machines](https://substack.com/redirect/b8fd914b-409f-47cf-957c-aeee8cd025d0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)5 and who [peddles baseless conspiracy theories just for kicks](https://substack.com/redirect/1fd17ad8-10df-4d65-b535-42d6bb5a71fd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), elected as Missouri's next Secretary of State:
* 15% of Missouri's registered voters participated in this Republican primary election.
* 75.6% of people voted _against_ him, which means that all of 3.4% of Missouri's registered voters supported him in the primary.
* Therefore, he'll be our Secretary of State next year.

This is an insane way to choose our elected officials. We have to do better.

Open primaries and ranked-choice voting allow for more voters to participate in elections that matter, and it helps us elect people whose views are more likely to represent the views of their constituents.
### How do open primaries work?
In most states, you can pick a Republican ballot _or_ a Democratic ballot. If you're a committed Democrat in a Republican-leaning state, or vice versa, [that usually means you basically have no say in determining who eventually gets elected](https://substack.com/redirect/b15ffc3e-53f8-4663-ba00-548819df3fc7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
With this reform, everyone--Democrats, Republicans, independents, Libertarians, Greens, whoever--all run in the same [open, all-candidate primary](https://substack.com/redirect/7d228419-7560-43c5-bc05-67ab9d7c03de?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg),6 rather than separate primaries. Voters get to pick their top choice, and the top vote-getters in this system--four or five, depending on the state--move onto the general election.
Ranked-choice voting is then used in the general election. Below are the reasons why that matters.
### How does ranked-choice voting work, and why does it matter?
Here's what ranked-choice voting is designed to accomplish:
1. **Candidates have an incentive to appeal to as many voters as possible.** 7 That's a good thing!
2. **Independents can participate in the process**. [43% of Americans consider themselves independents](https://substack.com/redirect/d474fce0-5d05-49e1-b433-89ad7e900df3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), compared to 27% who consider themselves Democrats and 27% who consider themselves Republicans.8
3. **Americans[want more options besides just Democrats and Republicans](https://substack.com/redirect/1f66f8da-3219-4c36-bf8e-554ce4e4093a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and this creates a viable path to more robust choices.**9

The idea is that someone can't win an election with a mere [plurality](https://substack.com/redirect/ad199984-24c5-4662-a5b6-0d2bb82be96f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), but rather with a majority of 50% + 1 vote. [Here's an illustration of how it works](https://substack.com/redirect/3ed43293-61f6-4e62-beaf-de566679707b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b6c5f1c8-f2e2-421e-af58-5ffc1bf4302b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The effect of this is that **people running for office have an incentive to appeal to as many voters as possible**. And voters can vote their conscience--for independents and for third parties, for example--without feeling like they're wasting their vote.
### Political parties in power don't support open primaries and ranked-choice voting. That's _why_ you should support it.
Idaho is a Republican state, and [Idaho's Proposition 1](https://substack.com/redirect/6a23a5ac-9099-4f68-9fb3-87aafe87dca6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) is opposed by their Republican governor and the chair of their state Republican party. In Nevada, [where most of the state-wide elected officials are Democrats](https://substack.com/redirect/de793234-32d5-4536-9507-151ccdf3ffe1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), [Democrats are opposed to Nevada's Question 3](https://substack.com/redirect/169a89a6-9efb-43f4-9d60-ac317e8e32a2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
They're opposed because open primaries and ranked-choice voting weaken the power of established political parties. **That 's also a good thing. **In a world where [so many Americans are dissatisfied with both political parties](https://substack.com/redirect/dcbe0cc4-2fab-493e-b6b4-a36a55966782?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), reforms that weaken the ironclad rule of one political party should be celebrated.
That may be bad for elected officials looking to hold onto their jobs, but it's good for voters, good for competition, and good for democracy. And [competition is healthy and necessary for democracy to thrive](https://substack.com/redirect/729ccd90-d619-4f1f-b387-956e2f84ce19?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).10
By the way, in the states where ranked-choice voting is already happening--in Maine and in Alaska--this is working the way that it's supposed to.
1. [Maine](https://substack.com/redirect/16e7dd54-f5db-4d5c-8ce3-fa2d28a433e6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), a Democratic-leaning state, has a Democratic Governor, an Independent Senator, a Republican Senator, and two Democratic members of the House--including Jared Golden, who's probably the most conservative11 Democrat in the House caucus.
2. [Alaska](https://substack.com/redirect/bf19f4eb-dd79-48df-9881-efc06e5fc69a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), a Republican-leaning state, has a Republican governor, two Republican Senators--one of whom, Lisa Murkowski, is probably most liberal member of the Senate Republican caucus--and a Democratic member of the House.

In short, their elected officials mirror the people who live in Maine and Alaska, which presumably is what we want.
### The key argument against ranked-choice voting dismissively assumes voters are idiots
There's a word that keeps coming up in the arguments against ranked-choice voting. That word? "Complex." Take these two examples:
* From a [Democratic-leaning group in Nevada](https://substack.com/redirect/57e5e7b7-1c92-4833-8742-00cf6d949826?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg): "Ranked choice vote ballots are...an overly complex and burdensome process."
* From a [Republican State Rep. in Idaho](https://substack.com/redirect/c3b1ac3c-99a7-4d34-83ba-e3c1e7b12ff9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg): "Do not sign this complex petition with ulterior motives."

The problem with this? It's not true.
1. We rank things in our lives all the time. And asking voters to rank which of four candidates they like most? Voters are capable of doing that, and it's a nonsense argument that it's somehow "too complex" to ask voters to have ranked preferences.12
2. In Alaska, after their first-ever ranked-choice voting election, [85% of voters described the process of ranking candidates as simple](https://substack.com/redirect/3c7c7b4a-795a-40c6-8601-85b17f1f0fcd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and 95% said they received clear instructions.13
3. [Voter turnout is ](https://substack.com/redirect/2d7f532d-1bb6-4ddb-b9fa-d6234af02f03?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_[higher](https://substack.com/redirect/2d7f532d-1bb6-4ddb-b9fa-d6234af02f03?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_ in elections that deploy ranked-choice voting.14 If it really were so complex, that wouldn't be the case.

### Amendment 7 in Missouri
Missouri's Amendment 7 is peculiar in that it doesn't really do anything:
1. It bans non-citizens from voting in Missouri elections, which is already illegal.
2. It bans ranked-choice voting, which isn't happening anywhere in Missouri anyway.

If Missourians want ranked-choice voting, we'd have to affirmatively vote for it as a ballot measure in a future election.
It's not the most important amendment on Missouri's ballot this cycle. Nonetheless: **you should vote against Amendment 7**. Send a clear signal that you don't support this kind of performative politics. And in the meantime, we can hope that other states--Republican, Democratic, and swing--will show us the way.
Are open primaries and ranked-choice voting perfect? Will they solve everything? No, most certainly not. Are there better ways that we could be electing people? Maybe.
But in states across the U.S., this is the option that voters have. And it's a pretty great one.

Don't just take my word for it; [his campaign issues page](https://substack.com/redirect/4a0dcf76-b434-4138-9e3a-850c448b1d68?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) paints a nice picture.
5
How to run safe elections has become a political hot potato, but it's worth noting: [this is an insane perspective](https://substack.com/redirect/0073be1b-0458-4aee-be58-0aa0d7188911?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
6
Lots of states do this already: Mississippi, Georgia, Louisiana, California, and Washington state.
7
Today, if there are eight candidates running--as there were in Missouri's Secretary of State race--there's no difference between being someone's second choice and someone's eighth choice.
That's a poorly designed system: you're likely to have far more shared policies and priorities with your second-choice candidate than with your eighth-choice candidate. But our election system doesn't pick up on that.
8
In many states, independents are iced out of voting in primaries. Missouri allows independents to vote in primaries--for now. [Efforts are underway to change that](https://substack.com/redirect/4c3f1206-b324-435d-86a8-80a3ee771aba?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
9
[25% of Americans, and growing](https://substack.com/redirect/1f66f8da-3219-4c36-bf8e-554ce4e4093a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), believe that neither party represents their views well. That includes 30% of Americans under 50. Among men under 30, [37% hold an unfavorable view of both parties](https://substack.com/redirect/cd27af28-3b89-4ed2-8f07-36694d461312?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--which is not surprising, given the [unaddressed challenges of being a young man today](https://substack.com/redirect/a932c563-1dc4-45c1-a8cf-1fdfe713d750?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), but it is alarming.
Furthermore, [68% of Americans want more choices besides Democrats and Republicans](https://substack.com/redirect/1f66f8da-3219-4c36-bf8e-554ce4e4093a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) but don't want to waste their vote. This solves that problem too, giving voters more choices.
10
[One-party](https://substack.com/redirect/cd891c4a-a289-4c82-8ce2-031efbb5cb17?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) [rule](https://substack.com/redirect/f0ef22aa-83ee-491a-b4fd-d6cf33088979?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) [is](https://substack.com/redirect/7cf4b882-fa61-4b1f-8e53-6c72e660d3cb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) [unhealthy](https://substack.com/redirect/6c715725-01e6-4cce-8ab7-a35ed0921a53?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--regardless of whether you're a Democrat or a Republican.
11
Though he might challenge that label, or any label that'd box him in.
12
I do think there's some limit to this. In [New York City's 2021 mayoral election, for example](https://substack.com/redirect/e89d7536-068f-437d-9cf0-ddff18daba06?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), there were 13 candidates, and that does get burdensome. Not for nothing: the primaries were still partisan Democratic primaries, which misses a key part of these reforms. In any event, the way these ballot measures are structured is a lot better than the way NYC ran its election a few years ago.
13
For context, the National Park Service--the most popular branch of the U.S. federal government--[has 76% approval rating](https://substack.com/redirect/0ce3fdcf-9e2a-4c7b-92c9-b24b83dc5123?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Nurses, the most trusted professionals, [are trusted by 78% of Americans](https://substack.com/redirect/109cb3df-5fac-4f68-af57-e62d79059b1d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). People can't agree on anything and seem to trust no one, and yet 85% of Alaskans found the process simple. Literally the only thing I could find that was polling above 85%? "[95% of Americans say that protecting the water in our nation's lakes, streams and rivers is important](https://substack.com/redirect/6d301f53-8829-426c-9b80-3686f5a4eca0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)." Fair enough.
14
The theory is that people running for office engage with a wider range of voters throughout their campaigns.
15
Arizona doesn't technically _have_ to do ranked-choice voting--it could do [top-two voting](https://substack.com/redirect/ba8121d0-275e-488e-8907-b455a21b29ab?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), for example--but it would set up a single, nonpartisan primary.
16
To get ballot measures into the state constitution in Nevada, voters have to ratify it in back-to-back elections. [They already did so in 2022](https://substack.com/redirect/2774e726-7dba-40b3-9a15-de32874d3896?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
17
Geographically, it's not very diverse. In part, that's because [it's much easier to get things on the ballot west of the Mississippi](https://substack.com/redirect/44bd91b2-2baa-4062-97bf-4862b0f99729?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), as those states (generally) joined the United States later and have a more robust history of direct democracy.

subject: Claim your Hillsdale College Calendar
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vWywutfWzN

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oWywutfWzN

Please see a special message from our sponsor:

Dear Fellow American,

I'm reaching out to you today because I'd like to send you your 2025 Hillsdale College calendar.

I know, I know. It's a little early to be thinking about 2025. But since you're someone who cares about liberty, I wanted to make sure you had this chance to get the 2025 calendar.

Claim your 2025 Hillsdale College calendar before October 31 by clicking on this secure link:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/63649275:WywutfWzN:m:3:2532013465:F0E31DBB47A79B6B751F079058143DF8:r

As you know, we live in an era of increasing bureaucratic despotism. You've seen it, and you understand. More and more, we are ruled by an administrative state that operates without the say of our elected representatives.

It is, therefore, completely unaccountable to "we the people."

This collapse of the separation of powers has spread far beyond the federal level into our states, our cities, and maybe even where you live!

One particularly disturbing example is in our K-12 schools…

At these schools, swarms of administrators impose dangerous ideologies and actively undermine parents.

In higher education-especially at taxpayer-funded state universities-bloated administrations push ideologies that teach young Americans to disrespect or even hate their country.

But thanks to our supporters, we remain free of this corrupting influence. We stay true to our mission…

…to provide "sound learning" that preserves "the blessings of civil and religious liberty."

Indeed, as the crisis in our nation has deepened in recent years, we have redoubled our efforts to extend this mission nationwide. But we've only been able to do so thanks to supporters like you.

Just in the last year, our dedicated supporters have helped to…

Teach 4 million Americans in Hillsdale's free online courses, including "Constitution 101: The Meaning and History of the Constitution," "The American Left: From Liberalism to Despotism," and our newest course, "Marxism,
Socialism, and Communism."

Distribute hundreds of thousands of free copies of the Constitution to citizens nationwide-especially younger Americans, especially thousands of K-12 students.

Provide an American classical education to young students nationwide through K-12 education programs, returning excellence and proper civics instruction to K-12 classrooms.

Expand the circulation of Imprimis, Hillsdale's monthly digest of liberty, to more than 6.7 million households and businesses.

I hope you'll claim your 2025 Hillsdale College calendar so that when you use it next year, you'll remember how you can advance the important work of defending liberty through education.

Remember, your support is especially crucial because we refuse every penny of government funding-even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans. NOT. ONE. PENNY-to remain INDEPENDENT!

Your generosity, and that of tens of thousands of people like you, reaches and teaches millions of Americans nationwide. You'll help enroll millions more Americans in free online courses, expand the readership of Imprimis, and
restore excellence to K-12 education.

Please show your support today by making your best tax-deductible gift of $50, $75, or $150-or the best gift you can-by clicking the secure link below:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/63649275:WywutfWzN:m:3:2532013465:F0E31DBB47A79B6B751F079058143DF8:r

And when you do, you'll claim your 2025 Hillsdale College calendar. But you must act before October 31.

Thank you for being a steadfast Hillsdale supporter. Your generosity is needed now more than ever.

Warm regards,

Bill Gray, '01
Vice President
Institutional Advancement
Hillsdale College

P.S. Claim your 2025 Hillsdale College calendar before October 31 at the secure link below:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/63649275:WywutfWzN:m:3:2532013465:F0E31DBB47A79B6B751F079058143DF8:r

When you do, you will defend liberty and help us accomplish our mission year after year. Everything we accomplish is only possible due to your continued generosity, so thank you for your support of our mission!

name: Dr. Robert Jeffress
subject: Are you ready for the end times?
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vsbnk_fWoN
Take a moment to look around. It's like we're living out Romans
1:25 -
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/osbnk_fWoN

Hello
Friend,

Take a
moment to look around. It's like we're living out Romans 1:25 -
trading the truth of God for a lie and focusing on earthly things
rather than our Creator.

Have you
ever wondered if things could return to God's original plan?

I want to
remind you, Friend, that this chaotic time is fleeting. The
shadows will fade, and a new day will dawn. The King of Kings,
our Savior, will return.

That's
the heart of Revelation.

Each day
on this earth shapes us for what's to come - a grand finale.
Amidst today's messiness and uncertainty, remember the promise
that our story's end is already secured, regardless of the
present turmoil or future darkness.

Revelation intricately unveils where our stories lead.

It's a
captivating book filled with symbols, creatures, and events yet
to unfold. But remember Revelation 1:3 - there's a blessing for
those who read, listen, and follow its words because the time is
near.

This
isn't just a prophecy; it's a blessing-filled journey.

Revelation isn't just about revealing future events; it's about
revealing Jesus Christ.

When
Jesus came as a man, His divine brilliance was veiled by
humanity. It's like dimming a lamp's light. But when He returns,
that veil will lift, and we'll see His true glory. That's
Revelation's essence.

As the
great reveal approaches, I'm here to guide you and your loved
ones through the remarkable events preceding the revelation of
our King.

In my
brand-new book, Mysteries of the End Times: 5 Truths About God's
Future Plans, I tackle five common questions about the end times.
We'll delve into:

1.
America's Fate: Will America stand for Christ or fall for the
Antichrist?
2. The
Day of the Lord: How should we live in anticipation of this
apocalyptic event?
3. The
Marriage of the Lamb: What unfolds before and after the rapture?
4. Gog
and Magog: How can we honor God in our lives amid their
appearance?
5. The
Tree of Life: What's the significance of this tree in the New
Jerusalem?

Understanding these mysteries will anchor you in hope, bolster
your trust in God's promises, and equip you to share with the
unsure.

In
addition to this new book, I would like to share with you "The
Major Characters of the End Times," as a token of my gratitude
for your support. This full-color, large print booklet introduces
key players during the rapture, tribulation, second coming, and
final judgment - vital for understanding the grand narrative.

I would
like to send you my brand-new book Mysteries of the End Times: 5
Truths About God's Future Plans and my brand-new resource "The
Major Characters of the End Times' as a thank you for your
generous support of $10 or more to the ministry of Pathway to
Victory.

Make your
generous gift here:
https://secure.ptv.org/mysteries-of-the-end-times-generous-gift-1-dr-robert-jeffress

Pathway
to Victory is committed to equipping believers with biblical
teaching and reaching the unsaved by spreading the Good News of
Jesus Christ through the most effective means available: radio,
television, digital, and print. Your gifts fuel that important
work and enable people worldwide to experience an intimate walk
with Christ. Thank you for your faithful support.

May our
study of Revelation prepare, strengthen, and inspire you. Come
quickly, Lord Jesus.

Sharing
the Truth of God's Word,

Dr.
Robert Jeffress
Senior
Pastor, First Baptist Dallas

name: The Editors at Broad + Liberty
subject: Anonymous Letters Threaten PA Voters
body:
Op-ed by Beth Anna Rosica | B+L Featured Columnist | | | |
---
| | |
---
| _**Suburban voters receive threatening, anonymous letters**_
---
| [ ](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=bb1c85a16d&e=b7b3eddce2)
---
|
* * *
---
| "Local residents with Trump signs in their yards received what could be considered a threatening letter, signed by 'Patriotic Citizen and a True American.'

This [anonymous letter](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=5ff27ddc79&e=b7b3eddce2), includes not only inflammatory, and in some instances, false statements about Trump, but more concerning, it contains intimidating language."

"'We know where you live, you are in the data base. In the dead of a cold winter's night, this year, or next and beyond, there is no knowing what may happen. Your property, your family may be impacted, your cat may get shot. And more.'

'...Your vote for this guy is seen as treading on my rights. You tread on me at your peril, motherf*****.' [edited for inappropriate language]

'We look forward to visiting in the future'..."
---
| [Read More](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=6367645144&e=b7b3eddce2 "Read More")
---
| _Editor’s note: At this time, it is unknown who is sending these letters, and whether it is an individual or a group, or if the local letters are part of a larger campaign. **It is also unknown the political affiliation of the individual or organizations** — the letters may be generated from progressives, anti-Trump forces, or even someone attempting to make Trump’s opponents look bad. Regardless of who orchestrated the letter, we at _Broad + Liberty _ strongly condemn these actions. We will continue to investigate the matter, and if anyone has more information, please email us at [Editors@BroadAndLiberty.com](mailto:Editors@BroadAndLiberty.com)._
---
|
---
|
## About Beth Ann Rosica:
---
| |
---
Beth Ann Rosica holds a Ph.D. in Education and has dedicated her career to advocating on behalf of at-risk children and families. She became politically active during the extended school closures, speaking out about the detrimental effects on children. Beth Ann led the local grassroots movement to open schools and eliminate mandatory masks while assisting school board candidates across the state and country with their campaigns. She has a consulting business and covers education issues for _Broad + Liberty_. Beth Ann resides in West Chester, PA with her husband and two teenage sons.
---
|
---
| We at [_Broad + Liberty_](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=392e34eb8d&e=b7b3eddce2) are proud to present Beth Ann's writings, and to provide readers across our region, state and beyond, with insightful, original investigative reports, and thought-leadership, on education, crime, business and government.

A few months ago, the VA (Veterans Administration) was refusing to pay for a glaucoma medication that was crucial in preserving the sight of one of my patients. After filling out multiple forms, being placed on hold by bureaucrats who couldn't care less and getting nowhere, I decided to call the local Congressman, John Larson, as my practice is in Rocky Hill, part of his district.
I explained the situation to one of his aides, a pleasant but concerned woman who took notes while I aired my grievance. Within three hours, my patient called the office and said his medication was approved.
John Larson, a Democrat, takes care of his constituents. And he brings home the bacon. Roads in the First Congressional District of the Hartford area are constantly being repaired and improved upon. Larson, a former mayor of East Hartford and a graduate of East Hartford High School and Central Connecticut State University, is a down-to-earth politician who does his job.
Contrast this to Fairfield County's Congressman Jim Himes. Such proletariat nonsense such as improving roads, fixing bridges or improving our train system is beneath him.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b7e5bad2-69a9-499b-95fd-ef84043a4f34?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Fourth District Congressman Jim Himes
He is a graduate of Harvard College and a Rhodes scholar. He was a Master of the Universe at Goldman Sachs. He serves on the Intelligence Committee playing what the British Empire once called The Great Game, as he appears on CNN and MSNBC, waxing eloquently on the Ukraine, Israel, Yemen, Afghanistan or whatever latest foreign policy fiasco he and his ilk have created.
I have never seen Congressman Larson on CNN. I would not be surprised if he doesn't even know what channel it is on. He is too busy going to bat for his constituents.
For every dollar the hard-working taxpayers of Fairfield County pay send to the Federal Government, we receive 70 cents back. Yet in the infrastructure bill passed by the Biden administration, Fairfield County received very little. For example, the [Congress Street Bridge](https://substack.com/redirect/06e27fac-098b-47c6-b971-3179f5852107?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) has been in a state of disrepair for years, greatly inconveniencing Bridgeport drivers.
According to the Connecticut Department of Transportation, road improvements are ubiquitous in Waterbury, Hartford, East Lyme and many other towns. There is even a project to improve I-95 in southeastern Connecticut even though heavy traffic is rare.
But as Jim Himes's Republican opponent Michael Goldstein [has pointed out,](https://substack.com/redirect/7a8cbbfd-915c-4081-829a-13bb3695894d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) there have been no significant improvements on I-95 in sixteen years! Why can't exit ramps be widened? Why can't there be movable barriers when one direction is overwhelmed with traffic at rush hour?
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e61b1556-4861-433d-9aa7-36f5fadb5f0f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Fourth District Republican Challenger Michael Goldstein
A more efficient Metro North must be created. Fairfield County needs rapid transit trains that run exclusively between Bridgeport and Greenwich. With our educated workforce, corporations and tech companies would set up shop within walking distance of these stations, clearing up I-95 and the Merritt Parkway. Our children and grandchildren would choose to live here.
But Jim Himes does nothing.
The reason for this is simple. He doesn't have to. The huge amounts of campaign money he raises from Wall Street insulates him from doing his job. Thus, his seat is perceived as safe and the Democratic Party ignores the district when it comes to allocating highway funds.
Both political parties play this game, with disproportionate amounts of infrastructure money going to swing districts depending upon which party is in power.
If Michael Goldstein wins this election, all sorts of transportation funding will come to Fairfield County, not only because Dr. Goldstein will fight like a dog to receive it, but because House Republicans want to protect the seat and keep what could be a slim majority.
But unfortunately, Congressman Himes has little interest in improving Fairfield County's traffic fiasco. But maybe he could suggest some talking books his constituents could listen to while stuck in traffic. That Harvard education must be worth something.
