Friend, According to polling experts, we are at grave risk of losing the US House to the Democrats. What would this mean for the country and for a re-elected President Trump?
* Two years of investigations and obstruction of President Trump's agenda.
* More illegals and drugs flooding across our open border as Congress refuses to fund Trump's plan to secure it.
* Higher taxes as President Trump's 2017 tax cuts for working families and small businesses expire without renewal next year.
* A House Democrat Majority that refuses to certify the 2024 Election Results to prevent Trump from taking office.

This isn't speculation--this is the reality we face if Republicans don't hold Congress. My race is Republicans' **BEST HOPE** of picking up a seat to help them retain the majority. Please donate today to help us win at [https://JoeKentforCongress.com/Donate](https://contact.joekentforcongress.com/l/yKnBAvy7a4tJj7XnOa763cIw/vrUktuLx9vkf4vFtjAtSag/9QEpBaTAxLc3t2x7YBQ6gA). My opponent has only one advantage in this race: a flood of money from special interests outside the district has allowed her to outspend me by a WIDE margin. A Psalm that sustained me

| |

| | | **_" I lift my eyes to the mountains- where does my help come from? My help comes from the Lord, the maker of heaven and earth." Psalm 121_**
Peter,

When I arrived at West Point as a new cadet, I had no idea how much it would transform my life. During my first plebe summer, after a long day of training, a sermon on Psalm 121 made an imprint on my soul, strengthened my faith, and sustained me through difficult times.

I'm Dave McCormick. I'm a West Point grad, combat veteran who served in the 82nd Airborne, a 7th-generation Pennsylvanian, and running in the #1 battleground race that WILL decide the Senate majority.

I believe in the power of grassroots support from patriots like you. **[That's why I'm taking a risk to ask if you'll consider donating any amount to my campaign.](http://links.conservativeum.com/u/click?_t=26c2e4aa9bbe40418f61e26972138f21&_m=7b76a0b69bde412384f8c4e8db70e8f0&_e=BSlVWVPuLhgJq5AoQ4hPKZ5rR9HdJOiWZr6Oa4DD8Mw3tgnx48-z1yhMpMtiScCRoHQLUKIaD9HqP3SBA2E4-dzQ4ayavd0gyoJBvRqZmX-izqZFjOpXhhRwk2PxGv_X2BRvtTkdlCO7-_9F0KKjpovKMRuWAYGEfKOyb69jCrVXFX3II3QQD6LeBuC4X0pKkehMnulsD5wbcmYpKi6DjLgM2Lf-jWftOnrEUk5iKJWhW-W-GedD91Esf-S50hTjrkW_FDniJngyK0AtbNz4UwzleieJvaD73R-L_M4GXC5rjv3UXIAlbxOv0uRcvk0U6dt4LXweoZ7nHe1fPkgKEWesTP4KVa3hZvsbQbMXikMHhrn-Yos1Xi2A9JsJskWX08H0oKpPYecsvbKLyU-6eiCa03dt7zuqFdNi5GccvUvXDXPuGtmaHK6V_-jE_0a3PV3hD3r3L4SlQOip_tM45A%3D%3D "That’s why I’m taking a risk to ask if you’ll consider donating any amount to my campaign.")**

name: Cheston & John Bailon
subject: Our brother Ruben
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Gallego for Arizona
body:
We know Ruben not only as a friend, but as a warrior and a servant to his family and his community.
#

Peter, if you’ve got a minute we hope you’ll let us introduce ourselves.
We’re the Bailon brothers, Cheston and John, from the Navajo Nation and Kewa Pueblo.
We’ve known Ruben since he joined our unit in the Marine Corps back in 2004, and we deployed together to Iraq.
[](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-oct24.6QErJb&refcode=em241022-1-160&t=1&akid=3419%2E734936%2ENIjJIV)
We had to grow up fast on that deployment. We lost good friends together. And over the 20 years since we met, we’ve become brothers. We know Ruben not only as a friend, but as a warrior and a servant to his family and his community.
We swore an oath to defend the Constitution against all enemies when we signed up for the Marine Corps.

Last night, I had the opportunity to debate Mariannette Miller-Meeks, and Iowans had the opportunity to see firsthand just who Miller-Meeks really is.

This debate was a chance for voters to hear directly from both candidates about our vision for the district. I did my best to present my ideas clearly and honestly – focusing on the issues that matter most to our community.

While I believe there were clear differences between myself and Representative Miller-Meeks, I’ll leave it to the voters to decide whose approach resonated most with them.

Every question and every moment on that stage reinforced my dedication to bringing positive change to IA-01. I spoke from the heart about my plans to address the challenges we face, and I hope that came across to those watching at home.

As we enter the final stretch of this campaign, I’m asking for your support once more. If you believe in the vision I presented last night, and throughout this campaign, would you consider making a small contribution? ---

---
Every Swing State Poll is showing the same thing: **The election is hanging by a thread and the polls are well within the margin of error.** In fact, recent analysis showed 4 of the 7 swing states as a tied race. This means two things: 1) Kennedy supporters are shaping up to be the deciding factor in this election. 2) The winner of this election may come down to who had the better “Get Out The Vote” operation. **Get Out The Vote:** Get Out The Vote or “GOTV” is the process in which campaigns drive turn out. This can be accomplished through texting, door knocking and calling supporters to make sure they have a plan to vote and the information they need to do so. Including:
* Their Registration Status
* How To: Early Voting

My work documenting the sordid mess of [politics in Washington](https://substack.com/redirect/4897c398-8062-4ef0-a563-3870fcc42e99?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) often drives me towards nihilism. Over the past few months, the [political theater](https://substack.com/redirect/bbff19e5-1f39-407e-bca6-aaca913e3da8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) dominating the [continuing farce](https://substack.com/redirect/e7e07323-2792-4014-ae44-7a0cbe5a71a3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of the 2024 election has often left me shaking my head, as genocidal violence enabled by a bipartisan consensus in Washington has [expanded](https://substack.com/redirect/b9eedc5b-523d-4292-9ea9-7d3a47bffda6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) now beyond Gaza to encompass Lebanon, Syria, Iran, and Yemen.
The frequency of my despair is part of why I felt so grateful this summer for the chance to meet a pair of inspiring filmmakers whose opus recently appeared in the [Human Rights Watch](https://substack.com/redirect/ede6634f-969f-437b-8dec-0d66f6b7cda4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) film festival. Their project, "[We Are Guardians,](https://substack.com/redirect/27399aa8-ac5f-4e38-a319-f9d7d6b26b87?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)" has won a series of documentary film awards, including the Green Film Award from Cinema for Peace, the Grand Prize at the Environmental Film Festival, Best Documentary at the Raindance Film Festival, and the Audience Award at the 47a Mostra Internacional De Cinema Em Sao Paulo.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/0912fb76-7978-4bb4-ad55-466245b8fed4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
### **A global horror unfolding in plain sight**
"We Are Guardians" depicts life on the front lines of the mounting global climate catastrophe. Directed by filmmakers Edivan Guajajara, Chelsea Greene, and Rob Grobman, it features protagonists including indigenous activists Sonia Guajajara and Puyr Tembe and their work to protect a priceless global resource.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/4d01aa33-d800-4fbf-9d59-5c3f123f86c3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Far from the board rooms in which executives make decisions to plunder irreplaceable natural resources, and from the committee chambers where policymakers enable predatory industries to undermine our shared future, indigenous communities work in unseen ways to preserve what vanishingly little remains of (what the British Broadcasting Corporation described as) "the [Lungs of the Earth](https://substack.com/redirect/943be465-f87a-477d-bb67-588bf0977a92?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)."

The film particularly examines resistance by indigenous communities in the Brazilian Amazon to illegal logging and deforestation. Several industries fuel the problem, particularly including timber and beef, taking advantage of lax international enforcement of existing regulations and--at the time the film was produced--official encouragement from Brazil's government under the corrupt and disgraced leadership of Jair Bolsonaro.
Among the many subplots in "We Are Guardians" are the hopes of indigenous advocates for the return of Brazil's current President, Luiz Inacio Lula Da Silva, known most widely as "Lula." The film depicts [Lula's victory](https://substack.com/redirect/360d88e0-d361-47da-a2cc-8a59c070a3db?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) over Bolsonaro in Brazil's historic 2023 election, and ends on a hopeful note.
Yet the subsequent history has proven disappointing, perhaps illustrating the complicated process of policy changing circumstances on the ground. Responding to Lula's victory and his administration's [escalation](https://substack.com/redirect/932631b5-83bd-4a1a-a459-fe662f861a34?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of enforcement efforts to protect the Amazon, the industries fueling illegal logging have [accelerated their attacks on the Amazon](https://substack.com/redirect/f2d2ae2a-aec9-4be4-a292-2588e1230d6c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), mobilizing into what have described as a wartime posture.
The film also looks beyond Brazil, exploring how the farm lobby in Washington misdirects resources to support corporate agribusiness, rather than values like sustainability or equity. Looking at the process less internationally, focusing only within the U.S., a further irony emerges. Rural states tend to be represented by policymakers aligned with agribusiness industries, even while the voters within them struggle. Farmers, for instance, have been driven to [suicide at up to 350% of the national average](https://substack.com/redirect/4659d46b-b6d7-4752-85b1-58559d955b21?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
"We Are Guardians" also goes beyond trade and agribusiness to further explore the role of international finance and banking institutions. Ultimately, the range of industries complicit in deforesting the Amazon is almost as vast as the Amazon itself.
### **A visionary and beautiful documentary film**
"We Are Guardians" also highlights the complicated economics driving deforestation, depicting the challenges confronting not only indigenous communities, but also loggers, their families, and their own aspirations for their children. It is both poignant and disturbing to realize how marginalized are people on the ground on both sides of the divide between protector and plunderer.
The film's cinematography is as spectacular as the region it depicts. Aerial shots of the Amazon offer a birds' eye view of breathtaking sunrises and sunsets, as well as plumes of smoke rising from a forest facing increasing numbers of threats from seemingly all directions. Meanwhile, footage from within the jungle features indigenous patrols searching for loggers, as well as loggers searching for resources they can extract. The level of trust necessary to establish the opportunity for these stunning interviews is as impressive as the shots themselves.
It also effectively conveys nuances that might surprise some viewers. For instance, the element of betrayal that emerges within communities on the front line may seem more likely emerge in a Hollywood drama than in a documentary film about indigenous communities on the front line of the climate catastrophe. One of the film's protagonists laments that ""[e]ven our relatives themselves are selling the trees," and says that "I thought I'd fight the loggers, but other indigenous attacked me....They have my picture."

The film's beauty extends beyond its visual imagery and the haunting themes it raises. Its soundtrack is no less compelling, conveying the full range of emotions inspired by the many interviews and impressive cinematography.
### **Communities vs. countries**
It also insightfully explores the tension between environmental conservation and economic opportunities to support international trade and pursue what economists describe as "comparative advantage."
At one point, an interview with a Brazilian activist turns to international aid, with an important message for western viewers. The activist observes a program funded by European country aiming to channel resources specifically to Latin American states that have pledged to enforce environmental restrictions, noting that the support is ultimately misdirected. Rather than supporting the indigenous communities best poised to do the work, the program instead funds government agencies that sometimes work at cross purposes. In at least one area, activists report that law enforcement officers paid to protect the forest instead appear to have overseen deforestation projects to build homes in prohibited areas for themselves.
The challenges confronting indigenous communities also highlight an underlying issue that applies to communities well beyond them. For roughly three hundred years after the [treaty of Westphalia in 1648](https://substack.com/redirect/bfb7c362-5b6f-4625-8f1c-cf5f4efc3a94?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), the international state system was organized primarily according to nation states. That paradigm held until the end of the Second World War, when the victorious allied powers oversaw the creation of various international organizations, such as the United Nations, its various satellite organizations, and economic analogues like the world bank and international monetary fund.
The creation of the Bretton Woods institutions aimed to herald a new era of international human rights, in which the world would guarantee the rights of individuals even against violations by their respective governments. That vision has crashed on the shoals of terrifying realities, visible not only in the Amazon, but particularly in the Middle East from Gaza to Lebanon, where civilian populations endure arbitrary state violence.
The importance of guarding these human rights in Brazil may seem less visible relative to other places in the world where their abuses appear more dramatic. But it is important to recognize the importance of human rights wherever they are threatened. Brazil presents a further dimension, since violations of the rights of indigenous communities also harm a priceless and vanishing natural resource with critical importance to the future of humanity.
Yet the film has an important perspective to offer with respect to international institutions. It follows indigenous advocates to the [Conference of Parties (COP) climate summits](https://substack.com/redirect/be5da81b-fba5-435c-a1fc-845e4c76bc5b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), through which the United Nations periodically convenes voices from around the world to consider climate solutions and potential international agreements. Voices highlighted in the film describe COP as more focused on public relations than a meaningful opportunity to address a shared global challenge. On the eve of [another COP summit focused on biodiversity](https://substack.com/redirect/c55356e0-8f76-466b-b479-1800f59147bb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), this message could not possibly be more important and timely.
### **A Q &A with Director Chelsea Greene**
**SB** : Are there any ways for viewers of the film to support the Guardians directly?
**CG** : [Yes! With gofundme](https://substack.com/redirect/a3e3c3dd-5b14-4a09-8a9a-25470b72fb26?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). They are setting up their own registered nonprofit in Brazil but it takes time and sending donations to Brazil is more difficult than you'd think. So we set up this tax-deductible gofundme link where the funds go to RandomGood Foundation, then are transferred to the Guardians.
**SB** : Where can people learn about upcoming screenings in their community, or how they might set one up?
**CG** : You can [fill out this form to host a screening](https://substack.com/redirect/faa0c7e9-67b9-4b7e-bb34-21c30c526e2d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and see our website for [upcoming screenings](https://substack.com/redirect/fa94785f-38f5-49f6-8436-ff1465c5b6f2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
[Note: "We are Guardians" will be screened at Monarch in San Francisco this Wednesday, October 23. [Tickets remain available](https://substack.com/redirect/5e4d7cab-5a6a-4f84-ac0d-e30d24c0e160?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) online]
**SB** : Are there any trade associations that certify wood and paper products that do adequately police supplies for illegally forested word? Are there any campaigns underway to influence them that viewers can support and share?
**CG** : There are currently not any trade associations that certify rainforest hardwood in a way that would investigate properly the labels from Brazil. Brazil actually has an incredible supply chain tracking system for wood--but it gets corrupted at every point. There is a law in the U.S., the Lacey Act, that prohibits the sale of illegally obtained wood. But the issue is the law enforcement is not working on this enough. You can buy Ipe wood online freely without recourse.
**SB** : The film depicts Lula's victory over Bolsonaro in the 2020 election as a potential turning point. What has the subsequent history been? [Recent news reports](https://substack.com/redirect/4d68ee1f-945b-4f19-bcb1-1ce24bbf035b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) suggest that loggers have responded to Lula's policies by escalating their attacks on the forest.
**CG** : Lula commissioned military police operations to remove the loggers and illegal invaders from Puyr's territory and where Valdir works. But the companies destroying the forest have doubled down lobbying the Congress to weaken environmental protections. In order to actually protect the Amazon, we can't rely on any politician in office. We have to make the companies and banks stop meddling in politics while at the same time stopping international trade of these goods, and incentivising and supporting local and Indigenous communities to transition to a regenerative economy. There is over 100 million hectares of degraded abandoned land in the Amazon that companies who want to produce beef and soy could use to expand their operations using regenerative techniques to restore soil nutrients.
**SB** : What has the role been of U.S. foreign-policy over the last 10 or 20 years?
**CG** : U.S. foreign policy has played an influential, albeit sometimes inconsistent, role in Amazon rainforest conservation. As you can see in the film, the conservative political mindset from the US has been very influential in Brazil. Bolsonaro's relationship with Trump, and the evangelical movement traveling from the US to Brazil has built a strong culture war between the right and left. They are brainwashed to think that the expansion of agriculture is the only way for Brazil to become a global superpower like the U.S. (which they all emulate).
### **Poignant passages**
Several statements made by Brazilian activists rang in my ears well after watching "We are Guardians." Looking to the future, one remarks that "We do not have the right to destroy the lives of future generations," while another observes that "The only inheritance we can leave to our children and grandchildren is the land."
"Without the forest, we have nothing," says a third, setting up what--to me--was the most powerful comment in the entire film: an invitation to "Reforest the mind...the heart...[and] the world."

The creation of the Bretton Woods institutions aimed to herald a new era of international human rights, in which the world would guarantee the rights of individuals even against violations by their respective governments. That vision has crashed on the shoals of terrifying realities, visible not only in the Amazon, but particularly in the Middle East from Gaza to Lebanon, where civilian populations endure arbitrary state violence. The importance of guarding these human rights in Brazil may seem less visible relative to other places in the world where their abuses appear more dramatic. But it is important to recognize the importance of human rights wherever they are threatened. Brazil presents a further dimension, since violations of the rights of indigenous communities also harm a priceless and vanishing natural resource with critical importance to the future of humanity. Yet the film has an important perspective to offer with respect to international institutions. It follows indigenous advocates to the , through which the United Nations periodically convenes voices from around the world to consider climate solutions and potential international agreements. Voices highlighted in the film describe COP as more focused on public relations than a meaningful opportunity to address a shared global challenge. On the eve of , this message could not possibly be more important and timely. A Q &A with Director Chelsea Greene SB : Are there any ways for viewers of the film to support the Guardians directly? CG : . They are setting up their own registered nonprofit in Brazil but it takes time and sending donations to Brazil is more difficult than you'd think. So we set up this tax-deductible gofundme link where the funds go to RandomGood Foundation, then are transferred to the Guardians. SB : Where can people learn about upcoming screenings in their community, or how they might set one up? CG : You can and see our website for . online] SB : Are there any trade associations that certify wood and paper products that do adequately police supplies for illegally forested word? Are there any campaigns underway to influence them that viewers can support and share? CG : There are currently not any trade associations that certify rainforest hardwood in a way that would investigate properly the labels from Brazil. Brazil actually has an incredible supply chain tracking system for wood--but it gets corrupted at every point. There is a law in the U.S., the Lacey Act, that prohibits the sale of illegally obtained wood. But the issue is the law enforcement is not working on this enough. You can buy Ipe wood online freely without recourse. SB : The film depicts Lula's victory over Bolsonaro in the 2020 election as a potential turning point. What has the subsequent history been? suggest that loggers have responded to Lula's policies by escalating their attacks on the forest. CG : Lula commissioned military police operations to remove the loggers and illegal invaders from Puyr's territory and where Valdir works. But the companies destroying the forest have doubled down lobbying the Congress to weaken environmental protections. In order to actually protect the Amazon, we can't rely on any politician in office. We have to make the companies and banks stop meddling in politics while at the same time stopping international trade of these goods, and incentivising and supporting local and Indigenous communities to transition to a regenerative economy. There is over 100 million hectares of degraded abandoned land in the Amazon that companies who want to produce beef and soy could use to expand their operations using regenerative techniques to restore soil nutrients. SB : What has the role been of U.S. foreign-policy over the last 10 or 20 years? CG : U.S. foreign policy has played an influential, albeit sometimes inconsistent, role in Amazon rainforest conservation. As you can see in the film, the conservative political mindset from the US has been very influential in Brazil. Bolsonaro's relationship with Trump, and the evangelical movement traveling from the US to Brazil has built a strong culture war between the right and left. They are brainwashed to think that the expansion of agriculture is the only way for Brazil to become a global superpower like the U.S. (which they all emulate). Poignant passages Several statements made by Brazilian activists rang in my ears well after watching "We are Guardians." Looking to the future, one remarks that "We do not have the right to destroy the lives of future generations," while another observes that "The only inheritance we can leave to our children and grandchildren is the land." "Without the forest, we have nothing," says a third, setting up what--to me--was the most powerful comment in the entire film: an invitation to "Reforest the mind...the heart...[and] the world." clean_body: Unless we organize like never before, the billions that corporate elites are pouring into Pennsylvania could tip the scales in Trump’s favor. | | | Peter, Elon Musk is doubling down in his support of MAGA. On Saturday, Musk promised that he would give away $1 million each day until Election Day to a random signer of his America PAC petition.1 That’s on top of the $75 million Musk already gave to Trump’s campaign in Q3 of this year, the HUNDREDS of paid canvassers and field staff employed by Musk’s super PAC,2 and the massive in-kind support he has lent to Trump and MAGA through his $44 billion purchase of X, formerly known as Twitter. This tells us two very, VERY important things: 1\. That the Trump campaign is getting desperate as we enter the final two weeks of the race. And; 2\. That there’s seemingly no limit to the amount of money and influence that billionaires like Elon Musk are willing to exert in order to anoint their candidate. We’ve talked about the specifics of all the work we can do with your support, and we want to break it down for you again. A $20 contribution today, for example, would allow us to: 📚 Print 64 pieces of literature 📞 Make 58 calls to voters 🚀 Boost canvassing and staff capacity 🌟 Elect Kamala Harris and Working Families Party champions up and down the ballot in Pennsylvania and other swing states. But here’s the thing, Peter. The MAGA movement is running immense voter-contact programs, too. And they have UNLIMITED resources to fuel it. According to reports from last month, America PAC has more than 400 paid canvassers and an additional 27,000 volunteers.3 That is a LOT of doors being knocked, fliers being handed out, and voters potentially being persuaded. We may not have the billions that our opponents do, but we DO have a winning message — one that uplifts working families nationwide — and the best team of supporters and volunteers we could ask for. We can out-organize the MAGA wave, but only with your help. In solidarity, Team WFP Sources: 1\. , CNBC, October 20, 2024. 2\. , The Guardian, September 26, 2024. 3\. Ibid. Thoughts? Feedback? # [Investigate and prosecute Elon Musk for his apparently illegal million-dollar payments to help Trump](https://default.salsalabs.org/T6b54a8ea-8ed4-4b49-8f5c-9c7764f000a4/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

---
| | | Elon Musk is holding a $1,000,000 lottery each day for registered voters who sign a petition, as a way of gathering supporters for Trump. There's just one problem -- it appears to be illegal: "Federal law makes it a crime for anyone who "pays or offers to pay or accepts payment either for registration to vote or for voting." It's punishable by up to five years in prison." ([source](https://default.salsalabs.org/T6b6520b0-30b5-4a80-b602-4b64ae35443b/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)) "Offering money to people who were already registered before the cash prize was announced could violate federal law, Muller said, but the offer also "can include people who are not yet registered," and the potential "inducements for new registrations is far more problematic." [**Don't let Musk ignore the law, and buy the election for Trump. Charge him NOW, punish him, and put him in prison.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tf86effe0-0a2b-4f41-8d73-3869e959140b/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=2106%2E135344%2EP8wKnu)

Stop. *Record scratch. Freeze frame.*
You may be wondering how this girl:
[](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-oct24.UCjdR-&refcode=em241022-2-900&t=2&akid=2106%2E135344%2EP8wKnu)
Ended up here:
[](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-oct24.UCjdR-&refcode=em241022-2-900&t=3&akid=2106%2E135344%2EP8wKnu)
Serving my first of three tours in Iraq as a CIA analyst, working to understand terrorist and militia groups that were targeting US forces and Iraqi civilians and plotting against the U.S.
It started on 9/11. One of the big moments that changed my life.
I was 24 years old, and I happened to be in New York City on my second day of grad school. By the time the dust had settled, I knew that I wanted to go into national security and protect my country.
Several months later, the CIA came to campus and my favorite professor encouraged me to hear what they had to say. Not wanting to disappoint him, I went. I applied, got the job, and after a lengthy background check, I started in Langley as an analyst.
It wasn’t long before I found myself in Iraq, my first of three deployments.
Going from the national security world to politics was a major culture shock. For 16 years, I didn’t talk publicly about my work—when I posted on Facebook that I was thinking about running for Congress, people asked me if I’d been hacked. One thing I definitely hadn’t done was ask people for money.
To be upfront: Winning this race is going to take a lot of resources. A crazy amount. When you're running to win a seat in a swing state like Michigan, you can't take anything for granted.
[**If keeping Michigan's Senate seat blue this November feels worth $3 to you, that's the donation I am asking you to make to my campaign today before.**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-oct24.UCjdR-&refcode=em241022-2-900&t=4&akid=2106%2E135344%2EP8wKnu)

This election is the most important election of our lifetime. It is the reality we are currently living. Arizona’s future prosperity hangs on the balance of my victory to the State Senate this November. Let’s protect this swing district seat together to keep Arizona on a more prosperous track.

name: Rob Mercuri
subject: Two Weeks Until Election Day
body:
What is your plan to vote?

|
---
**The Squad in Western PA** The campaign released a new ad, Western PA's Squad, last week highlighting Chris Deluzio’s far-left voting record. In less than two years, he has supported raising taxes, voted to give illegal immigrants our taxpayer dollars, and even supported illegal immigrants voting. We don’t need an extreme liberal partisan. We need a leader who is going to search for common ground to bring people together to lead us forward. [](https://robmercuri.nationbuilder.com/r?u=QfIZV-WGX1tv8x-Rj8_8rmPIALQoB_HtQ9yBvm3EsdfdP4kpkzPLmZotpYqAnH6_&e=3e5e734082f1493d27255edb80fe3a63&utm_source=robmercuri&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=10_22_24_email_to_supporters&n=1) **My Closing Argument** Several times during the past week, I’ve been asked, “What is your closing argument?” My response was the same thing that I have been talking about with voters since I got into this race over a year ago. We need someone in Washington who will work to find common ground, whether it’s on fiscal sustainability or securing our southern border. By doing so, we can move forward from this partisan moment together and begin to solve every major challenge by finding common ground and working across the aisle for a better tomorrow. Since my opponent Chris Deluzio was elected, he has sided with the far-left, progressive wing of his party and his values don’t align with the values of Western Pennsylvanians. When I am elected to Congress, I look forward to taking the experience that I have gained through West Point and the military, deployments overseas, as a small business owner and as a father of three kids, and I look forward to building a stronger country and representing every constituent in Pennsylvania’s 17th Congressional District.

******Deluzio Ducks Debate** To me, it’s important that the voters of Western PA hear from their elected officials. I’ve always been accessible as a state legislator and have held numerous in-person and virtual town halls during this campaign. Unfortunately, Chris Deluzio has refused to give voters the chance to compare our records and visions for our future. Deluzio has refused to participate in a debate, despite numerous opportunities. Here was my response when asked recently about a debate on KDKA radio. [](https://robmercuri.nationbuilder.com/r?u=aU-ekfYgn9GVAWfMWUBQHXcT-GIFcTFBfAYDnvg0vQCfRBEwhXBqVLnW_FGW3u-5&e=3e5e734082f1493d27255edb80fe3a63&utm_source=robmercuri&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=10_22_24_email_to_supporters&n=2) **Early Voting Continues** I may sound like a broken record, but I’m going to keep saying it – Vote Early! Ask a friend or family member to go with you and vote early together. It is safe and gives you that peace of mind knowing that your vote has already been securely cast. Whether you decide to vote early like me or wait until Election Day, the most important thing is to make a plan ahead of time and decide when you are going to vote. Allegheny County will host ballot return sites for the upcoming General Election. Ballot return sites are staffed locations where voters who received a mail-in or absentee ballot can return ballots in person to a county employee. Ballot return sites will be open the seven days before Election Day, including the weekend of November 2 and 3, and Monday, November 4, 2024. Beaver County also allows for ballots to be returned for the upcoming General Election. Ballots can be returned to the Beaver County Election Office, which has election staff to receive your ballot from 7 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. Monday through Friday and from 8:30 a.m. to 8 p.m. on Election Day. Early in-person voting is also available at this site from 8:30 a.m. to 5 p.m. Monday through Friday and from 8:30 a.m. to 5 p.m. on Oct. 29. Get more details: [https://www.alleghenycounty.us/Government/Elections/Ballot-Return-Sites](https://robmercuri.nationbuilder.com/r?u=Bb-Tmxg6ZlO2xM8wOFdRArfqlwz4DV8r9n2uUNmDAGnBAKhBCG2odpxn9iD1Eq8eHp95wyITOw2IUp0BXCHMPMwAUgcpTm29KKYMUsYGr14&e=3e5e734082f1493d27255edb80fe3a63&utm_source=robmercuri&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=10_22_24_email_to_supporters&n=3) [https://vote.pa/location/beaver-county-election-office/](https://robmercuri.nationbuilder.com/r?u=Tr8elLdCeN1RGf7lJcW6epIRm6HO0QhXv0ENifZy-am8ZpSO5-1D4bxDH62hh_-2sb4CBj3NxKYCkSeXvnFUew&e=3e5e734082f1493d27255edb80fe3a63&utm_source=robmercuri&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=10_22_24_email_to_supporters&n=4) **Grassroots Outreach** The responses we have been getting across the district are what keep me, Kelsey, and the campaign staff motivated. I knew it before the campaign started, but I continue to be encouraged by the goodness of the people here in Western PA. Going door to door has been a highlight of this campaign. We were in Sewickley and Hampton the last two weekends. We may be in yours this weekend! **Last Minute Help** Have you already voted but still looking for a way to make an impact? Your financial contribution still has time to make a difference. Will you [give $5, $10, $20, $50, or $100 to help us](https://robmercuri.nationbuilder.com/r?u=flBDtqPbDiWRlxBXWwXH-QmKshK3no_4UipNukJhZ99RDhsiM_AR4u1oRxwyteWjGKMDFyYj98-cMSyXV0pVxw&e=3e5e734082f1493d27255edb80fe3a63&utm_source=robmercuri&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=10_22_24_email_to_supporters&n=5) today? Leading us forward, Rob Mercuri[](https://robmercuri.nationbuilder.com/?e=3e5e734082f1493d27255edb80fe3a63&utm_source=robmercuri&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=10_22_24_email_to_supporters&n=6) | [](https://robmercuri.nationbuilder.com/r?u=flBDtqPbDiWRlxBXWwXH-QmKshK3no_4UipNukJhZ99RDhsiM_AR4u1oRxwyteWjGKMDFyYj98-cMSyXV0pVxw&e=3e5e734082f1493d27255edb80fe3a63&utm_source=robmercuri&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=10_22_24_email_to_supporters&n=7 "DONATE TODAY") [DONATE TODAY](https://robmercuri.nationbuilder.com/r?u=flBDtqPbDiWRlxBXWwXH-QmKshK3no_4UipNukJhZ99RDhsiM_AR4u1oRxwyteWjGKMDFyYj98-cMSyXV0pVxw&e=3e5e734082f1493d27255edb80fe3a63&utm_source=robmercuri&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=10_22_24_email_to_supporters&n=7)

Fellow American, America is at a critical crossroads, and we need to be brave now more than ever. For years the radical left has waged an all-out war against the Christian values that built this nation. As you look around at today’s culture, it’s easy to feel discouraged. But I believe with all my heart that this moment in history offers an opportunity for a spiritual comeback in America — a chance for people of faith to rise up and lead our nation back to God. My name is Kirk Cameron, and I’m not just an actor or an author. I’m a Christian, a father, and someone who deeply loves this country. Over the years, I’ve witnessed a steady erosion of the values that made America great — values rooted in faith, family, and freedom.
---
| | But recently I’ve been seeing the rumblings of revival across the nation, and I know there’s hope if we act now. body:

Did you know that only about 20-30% of folks open these messages from me?

| | | I can't tell you how much it means to me that you opened this, Friend. Did you know that only about _**20-30%**_ of folks open these messages from me?

I do have to ask a quick favor of you - I am simply asking you to read this all the way through. If you finish reading this & you still think a $1 donation doesn't matter, then I want to just say _**thank you for hearing me out.**_

While only about 25% of our friends are opening messages from me, _**only about 1%**_ will go the extra mile by donating! I'm not exaggerating when I say this, Friend, conservatives like me rely on emails, texts, mail, and phone calls to stay in touch with supporters like you.

I don't have deep-pocketed billionaires that I can call on to hit these goals. **I rely on the couple of bucks that hard-working Americans receiving these messages can afford to give me from time to time.**

If everyone reading this chipped in just a little bit - even just $1 - we would be able to reach our goals and keep up with the Democrats' **_MASSIVE_** campaign coffers.

**I'll be honest ...** The Democrats were able to stop our Red Wave in 2022, and I need every little bit of support I can get if we want to fund the programs needed to win in November - and I need it today.

Fellow Conservative,

We’re in a dead heat, Fellow Conservative.

The latest polling in the Wisconsin Senate race shows I am up **just one point.**

That’s both good and bad.

Good -- because we’ve tightened this race. We’ve put Tammy Baldwin and Senate Democrats on their heels. Because of our hard work, this race is a TOSS UP. The momentum is with us as we enter the final two weeks of this race.

But here’s where I am worried, Fellow Conservative.

The Democrats might be down, _but they aren’t going to take this polling or ratings change lying down._

They are going to come out harder now that the Senate majority is on the line right here in Wisconsin.

So I am going to ask for your help in an unorthodox way. **I am going to ask for just one dollar.**

Why just one dollar? Because I am looking for folks all over the country to step up. It’s our strength in numbers -- not large donors, or Hollywood support that will help win this race.

Fellow Conservative, I’ve personally invested money in this race -- something I am proud to have done - but I need to know if you’re part of this team, too.

clean_body: Be sure to check out the many upcoming events in this final stretch to Election Day. | | | | | | Today's MAHA Town Hall Canceled Due to President Trump's Schedule Change Dear Peter, Today’s virtual MAHA Town Hall has been canceled due to a change in President Trump's schedule. President Trump, Robert F. Kennedy, Jr., and Tulsi Gabbard were eager to engage with you today to discuss the health crisis in our country and how we can tackle the chronic disease epidemic. Be sure to check out the many upcoming events in this final stretch to Election Day where Trump, Kennedy, and Gabbard will be together to discuss the issues critical to this movement. Let’s get President Trump back in the White House and Kennedy and Gabbard to DC so we can end the forever wars, get corruption out of our government agencies, protect our civil liberties, and Make America Healthy Again. Tomorrow, RFK Jr. will join President Trump and other speakers in Duluth, Georgia. With only 14 days to go, the clock is ticking. Every dollar matters in this fight to protect our freedoms and secure a better future for all Americans. We appreciate your continued support. | | Dear Fellow American,

I'm reaching out to you today because I'd like to send you your **2025 Hillsdale College calendar**.

I know, I know. It's a little early to be thinking about 2025. But since you're someone who cares about liberty, I wanted to make sure you had this chance to get the 2025 calendar.

**Claim your 2025 Hillsdale College calendar before October 31 by clicking on this secure link:**

[**https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/2025calendar**](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=8fbbf2c6fe4048a291c250414076cef3&_e=ZF5p4ebaBN4Fu30nnhmvs6Zm6Z6DAdqKqproBPYRim3I6RUuVL0HklbpKtss_IRf79x5BynLsxjY1zR_qmaolYGuK7QjTo95Np1CZ4LSU6JrdBL2WiL-AumId2FxcWfnmMMtu_BCKNzy0aLTj6itzzEzTyfqo9NlEQ4n6ZE5lNkHV0e5ZYJqMkQrLP3nrtfoKolmTGlh0mAH29c9RfQucoEjAVMaO57ohgwU7wjvbET0VU5v2EHJbhPMJqmborfDbqR1QvpA0AhmKN4tr_KUjrw45cu6y4FAEdX_fHI9mpzFv8qUJi4vOpgujJ7ycFzySBUSrT053tlgJa5X07A1HmbaD0ke9rWdn0hwl5yxUvjJUTE4pZht_RJLrZw7gLTEvyKXxN5q0TXjSb2z1Tnp8A%3D%3D)

As you know, we live in an era of increasing bureaucratic despotism. You've seen it, and you understand. More and more, we are ruled by an administrative state that operates without the say of our elected representatives.

It is, therefore, completely **unaccountable** to "we the people."

This collapse of the separation of powers has spread far beyond the federal level into our states, our cities, and maybe even where you live!

One particularly disturbing example is in our K-12 schools...

At these schools, swarms of administrators impose dangerous ideologies and actively undermine parents.

In higher education--especially at taxpayer-funded state universities--bloated administrations push ideologies that teach young Americans to disrespect or even hate their country.

But thanks to our supporters, we remain free of this corrupting influence. We stay true to our mission...

...to provide "sound learning" that preserves "the blessings of civil and religious liberty."

Indeed, as the crisis in our nation has deepened in recent years, we have redoubled our efforts to extend this mission nationwide. But we've only been able to do so thanks to supporters like you.

**Just in the last year, our dedicated supporters have helped to ...**
* **Teach 4 million Americans in Hillsdale 's _free_ online courses**, including "Constitution 101: The Meaning and History of the Constitution," "The American Left: From Liberalism to Despotism," and our newest course, "Marxism, Socialism, and Communism."

* **Distribute hundreds of thousands of free copies of the Constitution** to citizens nationwide--especially younger Americans, especially thousands of K-12 students.

* **Provide an American classical education** to young students nationwide through K-12 education programs, returning excellence and proper civics instruction to K-12 classrooms.

* **Expand the circulation of _Imprimis_** , Hillsdale's monthly digest of liberty, to more than 6.7 million households and businesses.

I hope you'll claim your **2025 Hillsdale College calendar** so that when you use it next year, you'll remember how you can advance the important work of defending liberty through education.

Remember, your support is especially crucial because we refuse every penny of government funding--even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans. NOT. ONE. PENNY--to remain INDEPENDENT!

Your generosity, and that of tens of thousands of people like you, reaches and teaches millions of Americans nationwide. You'll help enroll millions more Americans in free online courses, expand the readership of _Imprimis_ , and restore excellence to K-12 education.

**Please show your support today by making your best tax-deductible gift of $50, $75, or $150 --or the best gift you can--by clicking the secure link below:**

[**https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/2025calendar**](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=8fbbf2c6fe4048a291c250414076cef3&_e=ZF5p4ebaBN4Fu30nnhmvs6Zm6Z6DAdqKqproBPYRim3I6RUuVL0HklbpKtss_IRf79x5BynLsxjY1zR_qmaolYGuK7QjTo95Np1CZ4LSU6JrdBL2WiL-AumId2FxcWfnmMMtu_BCKNzy0aLTj6itzzEzTyfqo9NlEQ4n6ZE5lNkHV0e5ZYJqMkQrLP3nrtfoKolmTGlh0mAH29c9RfQucoEjAVMaO57ohgwU7wjvbET0VU5v2EHJbhPMJqmborfDsCdyWQ3FslxiSQDiCw3rUKD7yWKzg8BN4s3EYGlLv7-OQ60Z_8rcvaR9ZXvxWEW1iwN6WjwIAuEdFAT-dnA2PBVRThiZT4RdQ3MurobKQFlUgposSbPQ9eOI3VtJznx83KGBLdZBweiUhwyoYlr-Ag%3D%3D)

And when you do, you'll claim your **2025 Hillsdale College calendar**. But you must act before October 31.

Thank you for being a steadfast Hillsdale supporter. Your generosity is needed now more than ever.

Warm regards,

Bill Gray, '01
Vice President
Institutional Advancement
Hillsdale College

name: Ted Cruz
subject: Bernie Sanders said this recently:
body:
“As goes Texas, so goes the country.”

clean_body: Help stop gerrymandering, elect Democracy Defenders, and fight for fair elections for years to come. | HiPeter! The Washington Post recently published a story that grabbed my attention: “She’s running with all she’s got for a seat she can’t win. That’s the point.” But what really caught my eye was the section it was in: DEMOCRACY IN AMERICA. Yep, that’s how our democracy works right now. Kate Barr is running for a seat in the North Carolina legislature, but she already knows she’s going to lose. In fact, she introduces herself with “I’m your losing candidate for state Senate District 37.” In the Tar Heel State — and across the country — politicians are choosing their voters instead of the other way around. And that’s because of one thing — the scourge of gerrymandering. = | If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: = | = = | = = | = Last year, the North Carolina legislature enacted some of the most gerrymandered maps in the country. According to a Duke University analysis, for example, the state legislative maps allow Republicans to attain supermajorities in both chambers even in the event Democrats win statewide elections. As Attorney General Eric Holder says: “The extreme wing of the Republican Party has grown dependent on gerrymandering. It’s become pretty clear that competitive elections just aren’t their thing.” Fighting gerrymandering and nefarious Republicans will require investment and work for the long term — not just in the weeks leading up to Election Day. That’s why the NDRC’s 10 Year Plan is so critical. We know that with our battle-tested strategy and team, we can protect the fair maps we have achieved, fight the ongoing attempts to gerrymander, and be ready for the redistricting fights ahead. But we can’t do it alone.= Thanks, Sofia Digital Director NDRC = = Since 2017, the NDRC has executed a comprehensive redistricting strategy that shifts the redistricting power, creating fair districts where Democrats can compete. ### **Amendment 4 -- A "yes" vote overturns DeSantis' near-total abortion ban.**
The text of the ballot proposal ([which you can find here](https://substack.com/redirect/e2ea93c7-1300-4411-98ba-7cfae88de157?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)):
> Limiting government interference with abortion.-- Except as provided in [Article X, Section 22](https://substack.com/redirect/18779258-a8ee-4c4b-8e08-5bc7f7048b78?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), **no law shall prohibit, penalize, delay, or restrict abortion** before viability or when necessary to protect the patient's health, as determined by the patient's healthcare provider.
If approved by voters, Amendment 4 would overturn the state's oppressive[ six-week abortion ban ](https://substack.com/redirect/20957475-c3eb-4a7e-893a-a93c0060af30?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)-- a policy personally [pursued by DeSantis ](https://substack.com/redirect/2ae4d05e-115d-4dd8-96aa-b55efda12e26?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)after he made assurances that the already [unreasonable 15 week ban](https://substack.com/redirect/7e11732c-0963-4523-8bb5-f8fcd853ec4d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) passed just last year would be "enough."
_Article X, Section 22 should also be repealed, as that requires[ parental notification](https://substack.com/redirect/5df142b2-0e3c-49f8-93a4-9bffabd71135?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for any minor seeking pregnancy care, but that's for another day._
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/95426aef-d365-4173-bc23-7e1083c5d53d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

On **September 6** , DeSantis [used public funds and the Agency for Healthcare Administration's (AHCA) authority](https://substack.com/redirect/13407865-e498-4872-954b-6b74648ee3bb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to[ make false claims about Amendment 4](https://substack.com/redirect/a7fb91db-88a0-4d1f-852b-7b559ce9d47f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). [Florida law](https://substack.com/redirect/aafbb478-21c7-4aac-984d-c972218f6807?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) states that no employee or officer of the state shall "use the authority of his or her position to secure support for, or oppose, any candidate, party, or issue in a partisan election or affect the results thereof." (Florida Statutes, Title X, § 110.233(4)b)
While this was hardly DeSantis' first effort to[ mislead the public](https://substack.com/redirect/3d969a7f-c8d1-43ab-be47-d93970643dbf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on the ballot initiative or lobby against it, the clear violation of law shocked many who aren't familiar with [DeSantis' brand of weaponized state government](https://substack.com/redirect/47cde1ef-e4b5-4176-b4c2-43e53f9aadce?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
On **September 10** , DeSantis [started conspiracy theories](https://substack.com/redirect/2c05a10d-9986-4efb-a260-6071005a4fa6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) about widespread "fraud" in the collection and submission of voter petitions required to put Amendment 4 on the ballot. DeSantis also repeated false claims and conspiracy theories about non-licensed medical professionals " greenlighting late-term abortions all the way up to the moment of birth." Later on during DeSantis' public meltdown, DeSantis said he didn't like the pro-choice ads being aired and that "[ads should be taken off the air.](https://substack.com/redirect/2c05a10d-9986-4efb-a260-6071005a4fa6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)"
On **September 19** , DeSantis' administration forced AHCA to[ issue threats to healthcare providers](https://substack.com/redirect/1009195d-95ee-4c6e-8348-1500b814c6dc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) who shared information about the oppressive laws after two women were [killed because of similar laws in Georgia](https://substack.com/redirect/a3d0e902-2a47-46d4-86a2-7b4fca8996d6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
In a letter dated **October 3** , [under direct orders from DeSantis' administration](https://substack.com/redirect/8315f721-3645-4abb-b7fa-1af174031eb0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), the Florida Department of Health (DOH)[ threatened television stations ](https://substack.com/redirect/403219ac-b15b-4b68-be49-3e35f174a4d0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)in Tampa, Gainesville, Sarasota, and Panama City [with criminal charges](https://substack.com/redirect/7134fd7b-3259-4de7-83c3-3f63b1bf1f70?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for airing ads in support of Amendment 4.
On **October 8,** the FEC soundly ruled that DeSantis' threats to jail local television station owners and executives were a[ flagrant violation of the First Amendment](https://substack.com/redirect/7134fd7b-3259-4de7-83c3-3f63b1bf1f70?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), with FEC Chairwoman Jessica Rosenworcel [issuing the following public statement:](https://substack.com/redirect/4eb941ec-6f89-4283-b698-897f4d408252?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
"The right of broadcasters to speak freely is rooted in the First Amendment. Threats against broadcast stations for airing content that conflicts with the government's views are dangerous and undermine the fundamental principle of free speech."
On **October 10,** the[ lead attorney](https://substack.com/redirect/72795661-0239-41b6-8f58-59135c12b01a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for DOH who sent the threatening letters [resigned his position](https://substack.com/redirect/51f1a2bd-3bbb-40a0-b63a-5a66f1103b69?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), stating in his [resignation letter](https://substack.com/redirect/b3e03064-5968-4f2d-bdd6-d3ea2665304c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg): "A man is nothing without his conscience. It has become clear in recent days that I cannot join you on the road that lies before the agency."
On **October 11** , Florida's Secretary of State, through the DeSantis-created "elections crimes office,"[ claimed ](https://substack.com/redirect/cfb46ca2-f48f-44f5-a447-c7d418fd0adc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)it was opening "more than 100 criminal investigations" related to ballot petition signatures collected to put Amendment 4 on the ballot. Cord Byrd, a DeSantis sycophant previously appointed to the head of Florida's education department, provided no evidence or proof.
Floridians Protection Freedom[ filed a lawsuit ](https://substack.com/redirect/de6c11d3-9669-45b7-8e05-3f9a771c315b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)in federal court against DOH on **October 16**.
On **October 18** , a federal judge [issued a restraining order](https://substack.com/redirect/001e809c-ddbf-4228-84cd-2500f4a72a51?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) against DOH and the DeSantis administration to prevent them from continuing to threaten, intimidate and harass tv stations airing the ads.
Chief US District Judge Mark Walker stated in his decision, "To keep it simple for the State of Florida: it's the First Amendment, stupid."
Also on **October 18** , opponents of Amendment 4 filed a [400-page lawsuit ](https://substack.com/redirect/f0e14d9c-c0cb-45a9-8422-4e6762a0c1e8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)making unsubstantiated claims of massive petition fraud in an attempt to remove the amendment from the ballot altogether. The claims in the lawsuit, which provide no evidence of any widespread petition fraud, echo the Florida Secretary of State's earlier claims.
A hearing on the restraining order will be held next week, on **October 29**.
In order to pass, the amendment needs 60% voting "yes." Given the lies being spread by not only the GOP and DeSantis, but also official state agencies about the amendment, it's no surprise that favorability[ is razor-thin](https://substack.com/redirect/fcc72a89-145f-4afa-881b-22e09f3be424?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for Amendment 4.
Meanwhile, Amendment 3 -- legalizing adult use of Marijuana -- polled at 65% support in a Sachs Media research Survey last week.
## Amendment 3 -- A "Yes" vote legalizes marijuana use for adults 21 and older.
While not getting nearly as much attention as the state's abortion rights ballot initiative, DeSantis again weaponized state government against another amendment -- Amendment 3.
[Full text of amendment](https://substack.com/redirect/d3369be5-80d2-40f0-adeb-28653043986a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> The non-medical personal use of marijuana products and marijuana accessories by an adult, as defined below, in compliance with this section is not subject to any criminal or civil liability or sanctions under Florida Law.
> Medical Marijuana Treatment Centers, and other entities licensed as provided below, are allowed to acquire, cultivate, process, manufacture, sell, and distribute marijuana products and marijuana accessories to adults for personal use upon the Effective Date provided below.
> A Medical Marijuana Treatment Center, or other state licensed entity, including its agents and employees, acting in accordance with this section as it relates to acquiring, cultivating, processing, manufacturing, selling, and distributing marijuana products and marijuana accessories to adults for personal use shall not be subject to criminal or civil liability or sanctions under Florida law.
The less legaleese-version of that is: A "Yes" vote on Amendment 3 allows adults 21 years or older to possess, purchase, or use marijuana products and marijuana accessories for non-medical personal consumption by smoking, ingestion, or otherwise.
DeSantis again used public funds in spreading disinformation on another voter-approved ballot petition amendment -- this time [stealing money](https://substack.com/redirect/17301861-720e-44ea-8270-d43f27be5bdc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) from the [Department of Education](https://substack.com/redirect/a2a920e1-303d-4a55-9924-8caae522e62d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to lie about marijuana.
And because weaponizing one agency wasn't enough, he took funds from and used the authority of the Department of Health, Department of Children and Families, and the Department of Transportation for this one, using the guide of "Public Service Announcements" to get discounted rates on airing false, inflammatory ads against legalizing marijuana.
One of the ads [falsely blames marijuana use](https://substack.com/redirect/2e47a303-7c1a-4ac9-b27e-646ca750c588?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for domestic abuse and crime.
In another, the state makes the absurd claim of [rampant DUI's due to marijuana use.](https://substack.com/redirect/1ffdcde2-b0a0-4fcf-a984-7e5893fd7131?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
DeSantis -- no stranger to hiding, manipulating and falsifying data to suit his agenda -- approved ads that claim [total DUI crashes increased in states that have legalized Marijuana](https://substack.com/redirect/e2b19da4-79c4-418d-b73c-c4d95d6f0c73?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), claiming weed use was responsible for more crashes and deaths and higher insurance premiums -- **none of which is true**.
The total amount of sunshine could have increased over the same period, but it wouldn't be because of marijuana use.
Research has shown that cannabis alone [may actually reduce the risk of a crash](https://substack.com/redirect/17770561-7107-468e-93f1-6ea213f259e9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). The NIH found that "retail marijuana sales did not elicit substantial changes" in crash severity. Overall, [there's no clear link](https://substack.com/redirect/905fe624-edce-450e-a865-954749ba09e9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) between the two.
And crime? The conservative CATO Institute even found that claim to be bogus:
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/90923c69-e966-4f86-9430-16ac5e52d185?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Even 20 years ago, the RAND corporation debunked these myths in a 2004 comprehensive review of evidence, noting: _" In the case of violent crime, we find a statistically significant association with arrests **but not reported crime** , suggesting that marijuana use may just influence the likelihood of getting caught committing these crimes."_
Even Republicans called out DeSantis on this one, with former state senator Jeff Brandes warning that the governor's actions set a dangerous precedent, suggesting that such use of public funds may not be permissible under Florida's budget.
_**In all, taxpayers have funded a $20 million disinformation campaign to keep abortion and marijuana illegal in the state.**_
Florida reporter Jason Garcia posted some of the itemized receipts for those costs [here](https://substack.com/redirect/a2a920e1-303d-4a55-9924-8caae522e62d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
On another stage, the marijuana issues has become personal for DeSantis because of the public and political humiliation he's been subjected to by Donald Trump.
DeSantis' poor imitation of a 1970s housewife petrified by "reefer madness" was met with Donald Trump's "progressive" support of legalizing marijuana for adults.
If you've been following the relationship between these[ two egotistical maniacs](https://substack.com/redirect/d9669762-4171-4009-a54f-8c6afa9220cb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), you'd know they [loathe each other](https://substack.com/redirect/fde4e225-5bb4-4428-afec-471120d26da1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and Trump's [support of Amendment 3](https://substack.com/redirect/258973ab-b0f0-45bd-a906-33a50c86602c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) (and b[rief support of Amendment 4](https://substack.com/redirect/a2c08b75-c62d-4812-aed0-abfcd194fbf0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)) may be more about[ pissing off DeSantis](https://substack.com/redirect/302c5e40-0a0a-41ba-a577-c86cb100aede?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) than any moral or legal justification for its passage.
(I explain the difference between these two's ideologies [in this post](https://substack.com/redirect/02495e3b-f4e2-4ca6-bd10-d6ae23d5df96?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), but can also simplify the difference between these two men as: "DeSantis believes he's ordained by God; Trump believes he _is_ King, Empower and God-almighty")
The First Amendment exists to prevent exactly the kinds of authoritarianism DeSantis' invokes in these attacks. It's not there to protect you from getting sued, or to keep you on social media. It's there so that government cannot _jail_ you for disagreeing with it.
DeSantis crossed that line nearly four years ago with me.
It should come as no surprise that he's crossing now with the entire state of Florida.

Ron DeSantis, ever the one to punish those who disagree with or criticize him -- fully weaponized multiple state agencies in a coordinated disinformation and political campaign against two initiatives on this year's ballot. Threats against broadcast stations for airing content that conflicts with the government's views are dangerous and undermine the fundamental principle of free speech." On October 10, the for DOH who sent the threatening letters , stating in his : "A man is nothing without his conscience. It has become clear in recent days that I cannot join you on the road that lies before the agency." On October 11 , Florida's Secretary of State, through the DeSantis-created "elections crimes office," was opening "more than 100 criminal investigations" related to ballot petition signatures collected to put Amendment 4 on the ballot. Floridians Protection Freedom federal court against DOH on October 16. Chief US District Judge Mark Walker stated in his decision, "To keep it simple for the State of Florida: it's the First Amendment, stupid." Also on October 18 , opponents of Amendment 4 filed a unsubstantiated claims of massive petition fraud in an attempt to remove the amendment from the ballot altogether. The claims in the lawsuit, which provide no evidence of any widespread petition fraud, echo the Florida Secretary of State's earlier claims. A hearing on the restraining order will be held next week, on October 29. In order to pass, the amendment needs 60% voting "yes." Meanwhile, Amendment 3 -- legalizing adult use of Marijuana -- polled at 65% support in a Sachs Media research Survey last week. Medical Marijuana Treatment Centers, and other entities licensed as provided below, are allowed to acquire, cultivate, process, manufacture, sell, and distribute marijuana products and marijuana accessories to adults for personal use upon the Effective Date provided below. As you know, we live in an era of increasing bureaucratic despotism. You've seen it, and you understand. More and more, we are ruled by an administrative state that operates without the say of our elected representatives.

It is, therefore, completely **unaccountable** to "we the people."

This collapse of the separation of powers has spread far beyond the federal level into our states, our cities, and maybe even where you live!

One particularly disturbing example is in our K-12 schools...

At these schools, swarms of administrators impose dangerous ideologies and actively undermine parents.

In higher education--especially at taxpayer-funded state universities--bloated administrations push ideologies that teach young Americans to disrespect or even hate their country.

But thanks to our supporters, we remain free of this corrupting influence. We stay true to our mission...

...to provide "sound learning" that preserves "the blessings of civil and religious liberty."

Indeed, as the crisis in our nation has deepened in recent years, we have redoubled our efforts to extend this mission nationwide. But we've only been able to do so thanks to supporters like you.

**Just in the last year, our dedicated supporters have helped to ...**
* **Teach 4 million Americans in Hillsdale 's _free_ online courses**, including "Constitution 101: The Meaning and History of the Constitution," "The American Left: From Liberalism to Despotism," and our newest course, "Marxism, Socialism, and Communism."

* **Distribute hundreds of thousands of free copies of the Constitution** to citizens nationwide--especially younger Americans, especially thousands of K-12 students.

* **Provide an American classical education** to young students nationwide through K-12 education programs, returning excellence and proper civics instruction to K-12 classrooms.

* **Expand the circulation of _Imprimis_** , Hillsdale's monthly digest of liberty, to more than 6.7 million households and businesses.

Remember, your support is especially crucial because we refuse every penny of government funding--even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans. NOT. ONE. PENNY--to remain INDEPENDENT!

Your generosity, and that of tens of thousands of people like you, reaches and teaches millions of Americans nationwide. You'll help enroll millions more Americans in free online courses, expand the readership of _Imprimis_ , and restore excellence to K-12 education.

Rupert Murdoch’s once-respected paper says Democrats are the real problem

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95578040/507189279/2130526953?refcode=emwrapper&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNDg5ZTIzYzItOTc5MC1lZjExLTg0NzQtMDAwZDNhOThmYTZiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=Op5nX_XMtBSDcVVjSg2xlFVZDoXi4x15x4XoygTS-4o=&emci=419e23c2-9790-ef11-8474-000d3a98fa6b&emdi=489e23c2-9790-ef11-8474-000d3a98fa6b&ceid=14016711)
Peter,
In recent days, more and more people are finally calling Donald Trump what he is: a fascist.
Kamala Harris, General Mark Milley, and even _The New York Times_ are using the term to describe the growing threat Trump poses to our democracy. After years of hesitation, apparently, the reality is now too glaring to ignore.
The shift comes in response to Trump’s latest threats to use the military against what he calls “the enemy within”— anyone who disagrees with him or works to protect our elections.
**Trump’s repeated rhetoric about turning the military on his political opponents is a clear warning of the authoritarian path he’s prepared to take.**
But while many are (finally) waking up to the danger, the _Wall Street Journal_ —owned by Rupert Murdoch—has dismissed the fascism label as nothing more than a “meme.” According to them, the public won’t accept it, because in their eyes, the real “fascists” are Democrats who want to use the government to actually solve problems.
[**We’ll explain more about how the _Wall Street Journal_ is doing Trump’s dirty work by deliberately downplaying his fascist tendencies in a moment, but if you’re ready to do your part to correct bias in legacy media and stop right-wing propaganda, please consider making a donation of $25 or more to COURIER today. **](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95578041/507189280/-593472309?refcode=20241022-EM-WSJBias&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNDg5ZTIzYzItOTc5MC1lZjExLTg0NzQtMDAwZDNhOThmYTZiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=Op5nX_XMtBSDcVVjSg2xlFVZDoXi4x15x4XoygTS-4o=)
The _Wall Street Journal_ ’s attempt to save Trump from the media storm against him is laughable. The paper dismisses the fascism allegations by claiming that Trump was a “deregulator” for most of his term, even arguing that the most fascist thing Trump attempted to do was build the border wall.
The paper claimed this is small potatoes compared to President Biden’s student loan forgiveness plan and the Democrats’ “culture war.” **WSJ even alleged that Democrats have used fascism in an attempt to beat Trump by prosecuting him for his actions.**
The _Wall Street Journal_ mostly ignored Trump’s most authoritarian moments, like his refusal to accept the results of the 2020 election that ended with the attacks on the Capitol on January 6. Or his threats to jail or use military force on his current and past political enemies, including Hillary Clinton, Chuck Schumer, Liz Cheney, and the press.
The _Wall Street Journal_ says these are not relevant because “checks and balances” have previously prevented Trump from following through on his promises – something that would be impossible if Trump is able to follow through on his threats to only appoint trusted allies to government positions.
Peter, the folks at the _Wall Street Journa_ l aren’t stupid. They want to give themselves and their readers a justification to vote for Trump, and they’re willing to do all sorts of mental gymnastics to do it.
But we can't let that go unanswered.
**Here at COURIER, we’ve been honest about Trump from the beginning**. And while we’re glad most of the legacy media are on board now, we know that’s not enough. Right-wing rags like The Wall Street Journal shouldn’t be allowed to pretend they’re unbiased, and they should be taken to task for spreading Trump talking points.

This means we’re closer to protecting our Senate majority, the White House and, ultimately, our democracy. But I won’t lie to you, friend: The stakes have never been higher.
What happens on Election Day will determine the fate of our nation. And with the GOP continuing to attack our personal freedoms, it remains absolutely critical for us to do everything we can to defend our Senate majority from right-wing extremism.

| | | Friend, you might think I'm nuts when I say I'm going to tell you a story about voting rights and McDonald's – but stick with me here.
---
I believe that voting is one of our most fundamental rights as Americans and that democracy only works when we're all able to make our voices heard. So back in the day as Ohio's secretary of state, I set out to register _as many eligible voters as possible_.

**A huge part of running any successful campaign is meeting people where they are – so that's exactly what I did: I reached out to McDonald's and got them to print voter registration forms on their tray liners, like the one here.**
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95578247/507189697/-1893289703?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk3505-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY0NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0ZjllMjNjMi05NzkwLWVmMTEtODQ3NC0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=zrdDM-5KmBVJ42AGACLDyZxHXFm4HBnLibVqQyfFgwE=)
Some of them came back with ketchup and mustard stains, but we were honored to accept them. _The Washington Post _even called our voter registration efforts "the most intensive and wide-ranging in the nation."

I've fought my whole life to protect and expand voting rights – and with the GOP currently waging war on everything from voter ID laws to mail-in and early voting, I promise I'm not stopping anytime soon.
**But I need your help to keep up the fight, friend. A new poll shows me trailing my Trump-backed opponent by one point, and with the election just two weeks away, we're running out of time to turn this around. This is my toughest reelection yet, and this race _will_ decide Senate control.**

## Toolkit: Organize your community
---
The most impactful organizing is when we start with our smallest circles and build connections through family, friends, and neighbors. **You know your folks better than any canvasser will.** And you can share with them your story about what the stakes of this election mean for you and them. Here are some resources for encouraging your family, friends, and neighbors to vote and answer questions about the Harris-Walz vision for our shared future.

name: Ken Mitchell for Virginia
subject: Two Weeks.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Ken Mitchell for Virginia**
body:
| | | | |
---
| | | |
---
| My name is [_Ken Mitchell and I am running to represent you and Virginia’s 6th Congressional District in the U.S. House of Representatives._](https://kenmitchellforvirginia.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=435990a56c5fdf5272fa9ea86&id=65f975fa06&e=0fced71d8c) Most of you know me by now but I want to reintroduce myself for those who might be joining a little late. I served twenty-four years in the military, including six years at the White House under both political parties. My civilian career began with large telecom corporations deploying broadband solutions, and transitioned to starting my own construction company. In that role, I oversaw infrastructure renovations at Monticello and helped upgrade local water systems in the 6th District.
---
[Donate Now!](https://kenmitchellforvirginia.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=435990a56c5fdf5272fa9ea86&id=f3b063ee2d&e=0fced71d8c)
| Now, I've moved to Rockingham County with my fiancée, Michele, where we're developing a small farm. I'm ready to bring principled leadership and pragmatic problem-solving to Congress.
---
| I believe deeply in duty and service to my country. Throughout my distinguished military career, I was recognized for my exceptional leadership and unwavering dedication. My time in the armed forces taught me the importance of working with diverse teams and strengthened my commitment to making a positive impact on the world and my community.
---
| We have just 15 days to go until Election Day. We have so much more ground to cover as things really heat up— [**and we need your support to make it happen!**](https://kenmitchellforvirginia.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=435990a56c5fdf5272fa9ea86&id=c2dc53229e&e=0fced71d8c)
---
| I understand our community’s needs and am committed to listening to your stories and proposals. Your support is crucial to us reaching every voter possible. It’s not new news that the sixth district is vast and sprawling in many ways - we are home to over 730,000 residents. It’s also costly to run a campaign against an incumbent that has a [**war chest filled with corrupt money and MAGA loyal lobbyists funds.**](https://kenmitchellforvirginia.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=435990a56c5fdf5272fa9ea86&id=e3bf69c3ee&e=0fced71d8c)
---
| [**Can you donate $50, $100, or $250 dollars to help us defeat Ben Cline?**](https://kenmitchellforvirginia.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=435990a56c5fdf5272fa9ea86&id=2570c168ba&e=0fced71d8c)
We should be in this fight together. Not pandering to party loyalists and being bought by large corporations. If we don’t get back to pragmatic problem solving, mutual respect, and putting country before party, our democracy will not survive. We can do better.
We leave no one behind.
**—Ken Mitchell, Democratic Candidate for Virginia’s 6th Congressional District**
---
[Donate Now!](https://kenmitchellforvirginia.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=435990a56c5fdf5272fa9ea86&id=6a59a29d66&e=0fced71d8c)

I’ll keep this quick. Mitch McConnell recruited a wealthy, Montana newcomer to run against me. Now, his super PAC lackeys are pouring millions of dollars into my Senate race to flood the airwaves with misleading attacks. The pattern is clear. **Outside groups are trying to spend their way to victory in Montana.** Unlike my opponent, I can’t gift myself millions of dollars at the drop of the hat. | **_GET TO KNOW CURTIS_**

**Curtis Bashaw is a hotel entrepreneur, job creator, and preservationist. He's running for United States Senate to provide greater freedom and opportunities for all New Jerseyans.**

A lifelong New Jersey resident, Curtis grew up in Camden County and spent his summers at the Jersey Shore working as a bellhop and waiting tables at Congress Hall in Cape May. He has spent his life in the real estate and hospitality industries, and is the Founder and Managing Partner of Cape Resorts, a hotel company focusing on the restoration and operation of classic American resort properties in New Jersey and New York.

Throughout his career, Curtis has worked to build communities and bring people together. He is widely recognized for leading the landmark restorations of Congress Hall and the Virginia Hotel in Cape May, and for launching creative programming to dramatically extend Cape May's season, a catalyst for the economic rebirth of one of the Jersey Shore's most beautiful communities.

Curtis is a successful businessman and job creator, employing more than 1,000 people in New Jersey and New York.
