“Andrew Do is the only candidate we trust and the only one endorsed by the Orange County Republican Party and he needs every one of our votes.” -Baugh | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/03d6588ad38c/maga-extremist-scott-baugh-silent-on-longtime-ally-andrew-dos-felony-indictment-in-widening-republican-bribery-and-corruption-scandal-18229769?e=7017cc100e)

| | **For immediate release:** October 22, 2024
**Contact:** press@davemin.com
**MAGA Extremist Scott Baugh Silent on Longtime Ally Andrew Do’s Felony Indictment in Widening Republican Bribery and Corruption Scandal** _“Andrew Do is the only candidate we trust and the only one endorsed by the Orange County Republican Party and he needs every one of our votes.” - Scott Baugh_
**IRVINE, CA —** Today, disgraced Orange County Supervisor [Andrew Do has agreed to plead guilty to federal felony charges and immediately resign](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=566e4705fe&e=7017cc100e) his position after conspiring to steal millions of dollars meant to feed needy seniors — playing a central role in one of the largest corruption and bribery scandals in Orange County’s history. **Yet MAGA Republican Congressional candidate Scott Baugh, Do’s close political ally and politician**[**with his own history of corruption**](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=c4d55e9db7&e=7017cc100e)**, remains silent.** Meanwhile, [State Senator Dave Min continues to lead the fight for accountability with the passage of his Restoring Public Trust Act](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=e7e5cd9282&e=7017cc100e) (SB 1111), a bill he authored to address exactly this kind of misconduct. Signed into law by Governor Newsom, the bill [requires local officials to disclose conflicts of interest ](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=7368ac4dca&e=7017cc100e)involving family members and to abstain from voting on related contracts. **"Scott Baugh has been at the center of shady dealings for years, and he himself was indicted for 22 counts of campaign finance fraud and bribery earlier in his career, so it is no surprise that his crony Andrew Do is involved in a similar abuse of his office. Baugh’s silence in the face of this scandal is telling. Orange County deserves leaders who will root out corruption, not enable it.”** said State Senator and Democratic Nominee for CA-47 Dave Min. **“I’m proud to have passed legislation that tackles this very issue, and as your next Congressman, I’ll continue to fight for clean, honest government.”** Baugh has dragged Orange County voters through the mud with him for decades, leaving behind a trail of corruption and scandal, including:
* **Changing voter registrations without consent:** As Chair of the Orange County Republican Party, [Baugh was at the center of a scandal where as many as 600 Orange County residents had their voter registrations changed to Republican without their knowledge](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=76e4f7b6f4&e=7017cc100e)– and led to [12 arrests](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=e77e9d6e07&e=7017cc100e).
* **Indicted on more than 20 criminal charges:** In 1996, [Baugh was indicted on more than 20 criminal charges](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=cd0e09b3b1&e=7017cc100e), including [four felonies](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=c5f0945c51&e=7017cc100e), for violating campaign finance laws and [persuading someone to commit perjury](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=6b6e0bf556&e=7017cc100e). He [admitted to committing nine violations](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=05e39dbcae&e=7017cc100e) of the California Political Reform Act and [was forced to pay tens of thousands of dollars in fines](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=18d16cad29&e=7017cc100e).
* **Worked to disenfranchise voters:** Baugh was a [founding chairman](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=eaab242b1f&e=7017cc100e) of an organization that [spread voter disinformation and attempted to disenfranchise California voters](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=fece260dea&e=7017cc100e)—long before the 2020 election.

###
_California’s 47th is an open DCCC Red To Blue Congressional District in Orange County that includes the Cities of Costa Mesa, Huntington Beach, Irvine, Newport Beach, and Seal Beach, and portions of Laguna Beach, Laguna Hills, and Laguna Woods. Incumbent Democratic Representative Katie Porter is not running for re-election. In 2022, Porter defeated former Assemblymember Republican Scott Baugh by 3.44% in this “toss up” district. State Senator Dave Min currently represents over 80% of Congressional District 47 in Sacramento. In 2020, Min received over 158,000 votes within CA-47, defeating incumbent John Moorlach by 5.15% in this area. 19% of the registered voters in CA-47 are of Asian and Pacific Islander descent, including one of the largest Korean-American populations in the country._

Fighting Back for Veterans: Tim Walz and Brian Munroe
As Americans, we must always put Country over Party. That means putting democracy over politics, patriotism over pettiness, and service over personal gain.
As long as I breath, you can count on me to never disparage another veteran's military service. Whether it be Governor Tim Walz, State Representative Brian Munroe, or Senator JD Vance - we as Americans should never attack the record of the 1% who have served our country in uniform.
They wrongly attacked Tim Walz and you stood with me to defend him. Now, in critical Bucks County, they are going after my friend, Navy Veteran and State Representative Brian Munroe. He served honorably and we shouldn’t have to defend his record of honorable military service against baseless political attacks. We must always stand strong for veterans who have served honorably - regardless of political affiliation or policy preference.
I know that you will stand with me to uphold this commitment to respecting those who’ve worn the cloth of our country. Thank you for this commitment.
Yours in service,
Patrick J. Murphy

Former Congressman

America is at a critical crossroads, and we need to be brave now more than ever.

| | | America is at a critical crossroads, and we need to be brave now more than ever.
---
| |

Fellow American, America is at a critical crossroads, and we need to be brave now more than ever. For years the radical left has waged an all-out war against the Christian values that built this nation. As you look around at today’s culture, it’s easy to feel discouraged. But I believe with all my heart that this moment in history offers an opportunity for a spiritual comeback in America — a chance for people of faith to rise up and lead our nation back to God. My name is Kirk Cameron, and I’m not just an actor or an author. I’m a Christian, a father, and someone who deeply loves this country. Over the years, I’ve witnessed a steady erosion of the values that made America great — values rooted in faith, family, and freedom.
---
| | But recently I’ve been seeing the rumblings of revival across the nation, and I know there’s hope if we act now. In my new book, _Born to Be Brave: How to be a Part of America’s Spiritual Comeback_ , I explain how Christians can lean into their “birthright of courage” to overcome fear and boldly live out their faith. **[**And I want to offer you the opportunity to get one of the first signed copies of my latest book while supporting a project near and dear to my heart.**](https://email.republicanmajority.net/c/eJyMkT2v2yAYhX8N3ojghYA9eEhk-06uKg_piPh4k0trTITxrfrvq_Rr7vpI5-g8Ol9mM9u4xu3xySbsSzJlNy4Yl8tGa6YOqSv2Aw0wkJQzCmBEE3rVgW55gz3X0CmQXcua9z4oKUE7rgP33gavPepOuXOLgUnU2MT-1cMZANeyFewEXdcqrgJvRcs6ZYlkBZ-HW6O3W7Jfc4n1x2nD2qz9e63PnYgLgYnAtKM_Cp7shiHXk8-JwPRrKnU5f9sJTBD8GfHOqOBnoPLugFotHbVaa8Hau-fcETEdNZk9H8UjEcN1eKPLeCOgXjhhiEciYhjncf7DvE1PGx8bEcNvF67MdXgz1-VyG831apbxZj5f6PIvkLeKWyViWGb6V78pfXh-j-sad6WJZI9k4_qyaOr_nvDRw88AAAD___EniEU)**

My friends at Brave Books and I are determined to take this movement even further. We have a goal of reaching 100,000 children in the next year with wholesome, God-honoring Story Hours across the nation — and we need your help. | | | Brian, the fifth of five boys, was born in Salt Lake City.

[](https://king4ut.us/l/TLK6OShQtlWI)

Returning to Utah after his mission for the LDS church in St. Louis, Missouri, Brian’s decision to follow in his family's legal footsteps unfolded organically. Three out of five brothers became lawyers, and Brian decided to become a trial lawyer representing individuals who have been harmed by insurers’ wrongful denial of claims.

The intertwining of family, career, and public service defines Brian's narrative. As an LDS Bishop in the mid-1990s, he embraced connecting with people during vulnerable moments. Political service became a natural extension of Brian's commitment to community. Elected to the State Legislature in 2008, he later assumed the role of House Minority Leader from 2015 to 2023. In navigating the complexities of legislation, Brian learned the art of thoughtful disagreement for the better—a principle he carried into the legislative sphere from his personal and professional life.

In 2022, Brian's life took a new turn when he married Ann Silverberg Williamson, adding twin daughters and a son to his family. Their Brady Bunch family of seven children, along with three grandkids, gathers for family dinners on Mondays. These visits encapsulate the essence of shared values and a commitment to open dialogue.

---
Did you know that seven of the 39 signers of the Declaration of Independence were immigrants? Unfortunately today, political rhetoric has successfully demonized immigrants with misinformation and disinformation. Politicians (Trump) often repeat the same tired accusations about immigrants, claiming they bring crime, drugs, diseases, and economic burdens. However, each of these accusations is not just misleading, it's outright false. And it is is important we tackle these common lies and debunk them with facts--because that's how we build a stronger, safer, and healthier America. Below I debunk 7 of the most common anti-immigrant myths.
**Let 's Address This.**
**Let's Address This with Qasim Rashid is a reader-supported publication. Please consider becoming a subscriber.**
[ Upgrade to paid](https://substack..upDdnXkpaGeWaAMNiBdZVvaYIhBXZZHWmuvEcT3Y2AI?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=150226063)
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/03c7523c-deac-4501-ba24-c9682ceb80fb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Creator: Darren Hauck | Credit and Copyright: 2017 Getty Images
### Myth 1: "Immigrants bring crime to this country."
**Fact:** Immigrants actually make communities safer. According to research, including a study from Northwestern University that looked at 150 years of crime data, immigrants--both documented and undocumented--[have ](https://substack.com/redirect/ab8b26fc-810a-4f8c-9790-057a0fb6ee0c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_[always](https://substack.com/redirect/ab8b26fc-810a-4f8c-9790-057a0fb6ee0c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_[ had lower crime rates than U.S. citizens](https://substack.com/redirect/ab8b26fc-810a-4f8c-9790-057a0fb6ee0c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). The myth that immigrants increase crime has been disproven time and time again. In reality, immigrants contribute to more stable, law-abiding communities.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/36a9d791-5e38-4e75-b2d9-c77f8b1fcf1a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
### Myth 2: "Immigrants bring drugs & fentanyl into the U.S."
**Fact:** The majority of drugs, including fentanyl, are smuggled into the United States by U.S. citizens, not immigrants. More than [80% of these drugs enter through legal ports of entry and are brought in by U.S. citizens](https://substack.com/redirect/1a115380-81b4-4ef2-9838-c77edd495dd3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Blaming immigrants for the drug crisis not only ignores the facts but also prevents meaningful solutions to stop the horrific death toll inflicted upon Americans via the opioid epidemic.
### Myth 3: "Immigrants are lazy and collect welfare."
Most immigrants, [including undocumented immigrants, are ineligible for federal public benefits](https://substack.com/redirect/0a8c8134-f549-4d46-966f-485930eba3bd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) such as welfare, food stamps (SNAP), Medicaid, and Supplemental Security Income (SSI). According to U.S. law, lawful permanent residents (green card holders) must wait at least five years before they can access these benefits. Undocumented immigrants and certain temporary visa holders are entirely ineligible for most federal welfare programs.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/49fdd3ff-192b-4009-aefd-63a66e27a8e2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..upDdnXkpaGeWaAMNiBdZVvaYIhBXZZHWmuvEcT3Y2AI?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=150226063)
### Myth 4: "Immigrants are taking our jobs."
**Fact:** America is suffering a massive labor shortage. Far from "stealing jobs," [immigrants are filling that critical labor shortages](https://substack.com/redirect/7dbbd413-1264-4bef-b2c1-b27cb96d5c0b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Study after study shows that immigrants help boost the economy, [and their presence in the workforce increases wages for all workers, both U.S. citizens and immigrants alike](https://substack.com/redirect/cd679881-f0f8-4db3-b438-14b07d72a83b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). As a detailed study by the National Bureau of Economic Research [reports](https://substack.com/redirect/e0739f38-3e8e-42c7-a375-4b9798eaff2e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> Immigration, thanks to native-immigrant complementarity and college skill content of immigrants, had a positive and significant effect between +1.7 to +2.6\% on wages of less educated native workers, over the period 2000-2019 and no significant wage effect on college educated natives. We also calculate a positive employment rate effect for most native workers. Even simulations for the most recent 2019-2022 period suggest small positive effects on wages of non-college natives and no significant crowding out effects on employment.
Instead of displacing American workers, immigrants are essential to the functioning of industries like agriculture, construction, and healthcare, which struggle with labor shortages.
### Myth 5: "Immigrants bring diseases into the U.S."
**Fact:** [Immigrants have higher vaccination rates than U.S. citizens](https://substack.com/redirect/e466e5e7-f992-4b39-ac78-3ab8db32f552?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). So not only are they less likely to carry diseases, they are also more likely to help prevent the spread of illnesses. This myth is particularly dangerous because it perpetuates xenophobic stereotypes, when in reality, immigrants often contribute to healthier communities.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/73ef3b91-01c2-4410-8619-b9b099993aee?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
### Myth 6: "Immigrants don't pay taxes & that hurts the economy."
**Fact:** Immigrants significantly contribute to the U.S. economy. In total, immigrant households earn nearly $2.1 trillion annually, pay about $400 billion in federal taxes, and contribute nearly $200 billion in state and local taxes. [This includes undocumented immigrants, who contribute nearly $97 billion each year in taxes](https://substack.com/redirect/8f830de7-2ee2-41ea-9bcf-d52dc4a85fa9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Over the next decade, [immigrants are projected to add $7 trillion to the U.S. economy](https://substack.com/redirect/7dff784d-1a0c-48d0-9ea8-5054ac4939fb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Not only do immigrants pay far more taxes than all of America's billionaires, they also grow the economy by several orders of magnitude.
### Myth 7: "Immigrants hurt American innovation."
**Fact:** Immigrants have long been drivers of American entrepreneurship and innovation. Did you know that [44% of Fortune 500 companies were founded by immigrants or their children](https://substack.com/redirect/943527cb-6183-4879-bebb-66440f190c92?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)? That's 224 of the most successful companies in America today! These companies create jobs, stimulate growth, and solidify the U.S. as a leader in the global economy. Millions of Americans are employed today, most of whom are U.S. citizens, due to immigrant ingenuity. Instead of stifling economic progress, immigrants are at the forefront of ensuring our economic success.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..upDdnXkpaGeWaAMNiBdZVvaYIhBXZZHWmuvEcT3Y2AI?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=150226063)
### Conclusion
No one is claiming that the U.S. immigration system is perfect. However, the facts are clear--immigrants make our country safer, healthier, and stronger economically. Rather than falling for political propaganda that demonizes immigrants, we should focus on meaningful immigration reform that maximizes public safety, economic growth, and public health.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/6b6561dc-8846-4001-a75b-227e53dd6df5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Those who ignore the facts and refuse to acknowledge the essential role immigrants play in our nation, reveal much about their own character--or lack thereof. If you were misled about immigrants and immigration, it's okay to admit you were misled. But you also have the opportunity to rectify that wrong, and join together with those committed to building a fair, just, and effective immigration system and continue advancing American growth and success.
As the saying goes: "_Immigrants, we get the job done. "_

subject: A Tale of Two Countries
body:
[](http://links.conservativeum.com/u/click?_t=26c2e4aa9bbe40418f61e26972138f21&_m=3481c335136d46e5a5be51cc3df58124&_e=cHuMN2QEuXg7Jx_sLFV7BsYd2xDq0JXyyImVZJ3dESsDbHvOv_8AEj1VIWxU-KSrkKu42fw8Vg3SJ5K4NiPOxveT95IyuWGnt-5UssMW9C48MJjXQwGtlS5RY_TjI7qN1mMajgfevx6-u3RZnnVtdNekupLD-pKJfIVE5VKtkevbxIX3tRwD2CkX2ERXOOfvehHvC3Zew70h9rARhzWNkqZRXQN_af4IDF25Tibn-N4eyyq1q0bZ7jW0nXrRiMyviUL-_Aze31DWKP--BCMAwJb14O0Puixvz0JD32DQMyub4Kb4BGxwHBN2vPUn-Dn0Y7VQ42Q-N-4zMtTFkXNjMWiHNTllr5Tbwa5WYF_ACtz1rqYYSvSuHKkU8Kw2gPqXRNB0myuvKn9LojLmqQXdE_mPAAFkNnfH9LE18BwHK-E%3D)
Peter,

Argentina and Venezuela used to be both rich and free until socialists slowly but surely destroyed their economies. But last year, Argentinians were able to elect Javier Milei while Venezuelans remain under the iron fist rule of Nicolas Maduro.

Milei has drastically cut government spending and repealed regulations. Maduro imprisons his opponents and takes over private businesses.

Unsurprisingly, the two countries are now on opposite trajectories...

Inflation is falling in Argentina and the economy has begun to boom in less than a year of free market reforms. Venezuela continues to expel thousands of refugees every day. This is the stark difference between freedom and socialism.

I'm Daniel Di Martino, the founder of the Dissident Project. At the Dissident Project, we are sharing these stories to remind American high school students of the importance of liberty and to warn them about the dangers of following the same path Venezuela did.

[_**You can help us share our experiences with the problems caused by socialism and authoritarianism and prevent them from gaining ground in the United States by donating today.**_](http://links.conservativeum.com/u/click?_t=26c2e4aa9bbe40418f61e26972138f21&_m=3481c335136d46e5a5be51cc3df58124&_e=cHuMN2QEuXg7Jx_sLFV7BsYd2xDq0JXyyImVZJ3dESsDbHvOv_8AEj1VIWxU-KSrkKu42fw8Vg3SJ5K4NiPOxveT95IyuWGnt-5UssMW9C48MJjXQwGtlS5RY_TjI7qN1mMajgfevx6-u3RZnnVtdNekupLD-pKJfIVE5VKtkevbxIX3tRwD2CkX2ERXOOfvehHvC3Zew70h9rARhzWNkqZRXQN_af4IDF25Tibn-N70ljK5MVKzajfr0SuqRC_MMVMt8jQr6qC1Cy2hsfM_oIqCf2T41__FsPmnktolZX7fQohYFvWDh0JRtWHoo5eJYQzyDkDkyl-JlPP9pKMJP4V31FYU2eSOb2SQml4u0qfBKXQvoGjoNFcUNVuzQmYai8anihoKAukCi-_rUvf2SJ_9i0UV5xMoOP9hCocIfSc%3D)

As a Venezuelan who witnessed my homeland's collapse under socialism, I know firsthand the devastation it brings.

Even two decades after taking over, Venezuela's socialist dictatorship continues to stifle freedom, destroy wealth, and force millions of people to flee in search of basic necessities.

The average Venezuelan can't last a few days without working, or there will be no food on their table, so they can't resist. Meanwhile, south in Argentina, the rise of liberty-loving leaders like Javier Milei are offering hope to their country that Venezuelans can only remember.

It's important for high school students to learn that freedom and socialism aren't compatible, and how the ideas we support today can affect the next few decades, for better or worse.

The Dissident Project allows speakers like me, who fled socialist and other authoritarian countries, to share our experiences with high school students across the country.

clean_body: Peter, Argentina and Venezuela used to be both rich and free until socialists slowly but surely destroyed their economies. But last year, Argentinians were able to elect Javier Milei while Venezuelans remain under the iron fist rule of Nicolas Maduro. Milei has drastically cut government spending and repealed regulations. Maduro imprisons his opponents and takes over private businesses. Unsurprisingly, the two countries are now on opposite trajectories... Inflation is falling in Argentina and the economy has begun to boom in less than a year of free market reforms. Venezuela continues to expel thousands of refugees every day. This is the stark difference between freedom and socialism. I'm Daniel Di Martino, the founder of the Dissident Project. At the Dissident Project, we are sharing these stories to remind American high school students of the importance of liberty and to warn them about the dangers of following the same path Venezuela did. As a Venezuelan who witnessed my homeland's collapse under socialism, I know firsthand the devastation it brings. Even two decades after taking over, Venezuela's socialist dictatorship continues to stifle freedom, destroy wealth, and force millions of people to flee in search of basic necessities. The average Venezuelan can't last a few days without working, or there will be no food on their table, so they can't resist. Meanwhile, south in Argentina, the rise of liberty-loving leaders like Javier Milei are offering hope to their country that Venezuelans can only remember. It's important for high school students to learn that freedom and socialism aren't compatible, and how the ideas we support today can affect the next few decades, for better or worse. The Dissident Project allows speakers like me, who fled socialist and other authoritarian countries, to share our experiences with high school students across the country. Your generous donation helps Dissident Project speakers afford to travel, set the record straight, and help students gain a new appreciation for the freedom we have in this country. Click below to donate. Thank you, Daniel Di Martino Dissident Project Founder The Dissident Project is a program of Young Voices, a 501c3 nonprofit organization. body:
Voter Action Project Logo [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-weekly?refcode=102224_2&amount=25]
WaPo: Pennsylvania presidential election results could again take days to count [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=102224_2&amount=25]
Team: Do you remember all the cries to "Stop the count!"?
When the polls closed on election night in 2020, one candidate appeared to be winning Pennsylvania. But over the next several days, as officials counted mail-in ballots, his lead shrunk and then disappeared. By Saturday, the other candidate was the clear winner of Pennsylvania — and with it, the presidency.
The protracted counting process left a days-long vacuum that was filled with demands to stop counting the ballots while one candidate was still ahead, declaring premature victory in Pennsylvania and building the false narrative that the mail-in votes were fraudulent .
Even if it was done correctly in the end, the delay was just another partisan tactic by opponents of voting rights in the state legislature to sow mistrust in our elections and an attempt to make sure untold numbers of legally cast ballots didn't count.
Why bring this up again? Because -- unlike the 27 states that allowed for "pre-canvassing", or the counting of mail-in ballots prior to Election Day, in 2020 and unlike the 16 states who have changed their laws since 2020 to allow for counting to begin, Pennsylvania is still one of the seven states that bars counting mail-in ballots until Election Day . This delay will likely cause confusion, deteriorate trust in the process, and make election workers targets for harassment. Again .
The continuing danger to mail-in voting is obvious, Team. Help defend mail-in ballots with $25 or whatever you can right now and make every vote count in this crucial election >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=102224_2&amount=25]

clean_body: Voter Action Project Logo [] WaPo: Pennsylvania presidential election results could again take days to count [] Team: Do you remember all the cries to "Stop the count!"? When the polls closed on election night in 2020, one candidate appeared to be winning Pennsylvania. But over the next several days, as officials counted mail-in ballots, his lead shrunk and then disappeared. By Saturday, the other candidate was the clear winner of Pennsylvania — and with it, the presidency. The protracted counting process left a days-long vacuum that was filled with demands to stop counting the ballots while one candidate was still ahead, declaring premature victory in Pennsylvania and building the false narrative that the mail-in votes were fraudulent . Even if it was done correctly in the end, the delay was just another partisan tactic by opponents of voting rights in the state legislature to sow mistrust in our elections and an attempt to make sure untold numbers of legally cast ballots didn't count. Why bring this up again? Because -- unlike the 27 states that allowed for "pre-canvassing", or the counting of mail-in ballots prior to Election Day, in 2020 and unlike the 16 states who have changed their laws since 2020 to allow for counting to begin, Pennsylvania is still one of the seven states that bars counting mail-in ballots until Election Day . This delay will likely cause confusion, deteriorate trust in the process, and make election workers targets for harassment. Again . The continuing danger to mail-in voting is obvious, Team. | **Busy on the Campaign Trail**
Yesterday I enjoyed my second debate with my opponent, hosted by the Foley Institute at Washington State University. I appreciated the chance to highlight again why our ideas are the best fit, and the best way forward, for Eastern Washington and for America.
Last weekend I was at Eastern Washington University for the annual Red Tie Gala. In the State Senate I was proud that we were able to secure funding for the new EWU science building. Go Eagles!
I was also honored this week to receive the endorsement of the Washington Trucking Associations, and the Spokane Homebuilders. I appreciated visiting the Greenstone construction site in Liberty Lake. We need more houses, and we need to make it less expensive to build by reducing unnecessary regulation.

| **Letter to the Editor**
Thank you for this wonderful endorsement yesterday! Please consider helping the campaign by writing your own letter to the editor. [Email](mailto:eleanor@votebaumgartner.com?subject=&body=) us if you want support.

In the state Senate, he displayed maturity, self-control and focused on key solutions: helping get critical highway funding for Eastern Washington, fighting for our new medical school, and passing balanced budgets. Michael supports free markets to drive down costs and improve transparency; he champions small business; he’ll work to secure our border and stop fentanyl.Michael actively listens first, and then acts soundly to get results. He is high character, industrious, a brilliant thinker and seasoned in public affairs. He shows respectful dialogue, and works effectively across the aisle to achieve fair, sensible fiscal decisions and reduce debt inefficiencies....” _Duane Grummons, Colbert_

We appreciate all your support of the campaign. We are almost at the finish line and we’re keeping up the fight over these final two weeks!
Let’s win!

| | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95584482/507209433/717639134?refcode=MW_ATA_EM_FR_TwoWeeks_241022_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4Y2FiMjQ0Zi1hMTkwLWVmMTEtODQ3NC0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=EErtvA4J9wHItGRgCwCs0yi8DhG5AQG3g1SB9C0-9RU=) Derek,

I’ve been getting a lot of questions as we enter the home stretch of the campaign season. People want to know if we’re going to keep our Senate majority; and if they give, they want to know how their support is going to help with only two weeks until Election Day.

[_**I’m going to answer both questions below – but first, two weeks out, please donate $2 or whatever you can give to help keep the Senate blue this year.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95584483/507209434/717639134?amount=2&refcode=MW_ATA_EM_FR_TwoWeeks_241022_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4Y2FiMjQ0Zi1hMTkwLWVmMTEtODQ3NC0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=EErtvA4J9wHItGRgCwCs0yi8DhG5AQG3g1SB9C0-9RU=)

The answer to the first question is simple. **We’re defending a one seat majority,** and several races across the country are expected to be decided by very close margins. So control of the Senate is going to come down to the wire.

That’s where you come in. We know the states that the road to protecting our Democratic Senate majority will travel through this year, and _we need to be active in all of them._ Your donation today is going to directly support our work to get out the vote in these states.

We’re working hard to reelect my colleagues Bob Casey in Pennsylvania, Sherrod Brown in Ohio, Tammy Baldwin in Wisconsin, Jacky Rosen in Nevada, and Jon Tester in Montana. All five are in tough reelection campaigns against well-funded, Trump-endorsed candidates.

And we’re mobilizing in Virginia to send Tim Kaine back to the Senate. Tim is in a tough fight right here at home – Republicans are pouring significant money into the Commonwealth to defeat him AND with only two weeks left, he’s being outraised by his GOP opponent.

Turnout will be key in all of these races. We have to work together in these next 14 days to get voters to the polls.

#

Peter,
In just a moment, I am going to ask you — humbly — to make a contribution to my campaign for U.S. Senate. We have two weeks to go until Election Day, and I’d really appreciate the chance to explain why this request — especially today — is so critically important.
Here’s the truth:
Over the last month, my campaign has seen a fundraising slowdown worse than any we’ve had in the entire race. To be completely honest with you, we budgeted the exact opposite. And over the last few weeks we’ve had to make cut after cut to that budget to try and cobble together a new plan that can win.
Right now, there’s nothing left to cut. We have two weeks of media buys to pay for — the most important two weeks of the entire campaign. **This is your two-week notice.**

New Mexico voters are poised for change, and MANY are still undecided. They are who will decide the outcome of this race.

With 14 days until Election Day, **every effort** possible is required **every waking moment** for us to reach these voters and close the gap with Martin Heinrich in the polls.

[**Your support is needed TODAY to accomplish this. Can you rush your urgent support to help us win this fight?**](http://links.nellanewmexico.com/u/click?_t=bec4f693b6284a4ba56cb04ba05e5b45&_m=229425ef27ec457d9f2bc90b2a710cf3&_e=hKSV12IlP_KqI65KsJ2PG3h1UR30tQDgU4Qxya_v-4DGRDaiCSf5il_F6Aw8a123o4J4iS_NxdnVjlbko0PkHpat61RJmM_XhDPSsckmav80RkoNhDHA9PpzykiVEFREJYKGtNt7_75tpGgh8p30KHVRhn9GsPfjiTE-WnXFKVsHO2D_NPsLsAGmHLnY7FBi6PdEEpQB1DDHvbhU_2ldRG0oEwJQeBWuOrrY4SGWokL82pwAe_WTuePiOOF4LVtfRWU60-QRiwMW7bGE1fYPJUF7a5zx12jjYPEVO3V64eh4Ehmb8sNBW7HCt2TAz4s6nsHvEk_EIxTsG5YEmDUqsjpIptj5U_j_MzK9krXORLVB1NgzFSVg9cPYMXl-gjgbOYS-VsldRCLoKbb_vnR31A%3D%3D)

Thank you!

**Nella Domenici**
Republican for Senate

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

As a United States Senator, I will introduce a bill that changes the tax-exempt status law, allowing Christian institutions to speak to their communities about politics and policies without losing their 501C3 status. That’s what Katrina Christiansen is fighting for, and in North Dakota, your donations go further than about any place else. And it’s a state that, until 2019, had a Democratic Senator for 58 straight years. With a Senate map full of battleground states like Wisconsin, Pennsylvania, and Ohio, it can be easy to lose sight of other opportunities to defend our Democratic Senate majority. Don’t count out North Dakota. Derek, I cannot promise you that Katrina Christiansen will win, but what I can promise is this — your donation to Katrina’s race will go further than perhaps any other U.S. Senate race in this country. The Republican candidate only won his race with 56% of the vote last election. With the right investment, we can put North Dakota back on the map. | Fellow Patriot,

I feel like our culture has forgotten--or ignored--some very important and basic lessons when it comes to the development of human life.

Our society has been infected by an anti-life ideology, treating its most vulnerable members as disposable objects. Abortion that was once thought of as a last resort in a medical emergency has become the new normal.

Medicine tells us that life begins at the moment of conception. It also tells us when an unborn baby develops a heartbeat, brainwaves, and nervous system. Yet, despite all of this, the unborn are not treated as though they are alive or even human. [](http://links.redconservatives.com/u/click?_t=66ce1250519441959ebe70cf27686494&_m=b979dbbed313412ab8eb5860c050cfe4&_e=sFvXpT3OvafjpW7Db7tYM5tkMpqa89sXnW0wOt84vvUPXnhrkE4AyZW9jqD_JRvZlD7JJLOWTwZP-fFfGRY1fIjFLJkB_vFJt71MIT2Ct5Zr0_KcmuWkWTYNToTOmokV31jzx3wEE2dv7I7KS8P_1-tDBZp1hsOEiBDfbDjmWqKaTA7Mx_6HyBptxRU36ZgewdqfWd0SJuuAF_90V8k78LPELuEiAEVaxzqaDPnCX1vVbTfE-NKDVvYDyrs0qPECBMwDnHjGc32Qew_C2RBBe7AA-u8944vbnC5fySAXN_Y1YYk6191aMFpCs52OaiStSgr3JyyoaDaJELvVQ8FLYQSeEScfuL_1iZZJYn3iRTlWf8FJgHHfjVZ8QG3kJKYrqLBIUSLPhcOd7SIllMs_Um6RgeA-lRNGVU-cSUJLknk%3D) **As a surgeon, I have operated on infants pre-birth. I can assure you that they are very much alive.**

Life is a precious gift that has been given to us from our creator. No person is disposable, and every life is precious according to Him.

I believe that everyone deserves life, even those who have been denied this right by our society. I believe that together we can make a difference and bring dignity and a voice to the unborn. I also believe that I'm not alone in this belief.

I believe that you believe that too.

I've started working with a group of like-minded individuals who are looking to change our culture. We want to build a society that values life but that takes people like you and I making a commitment.

The first step is clearly stating what we believe and what we are willing to do to protect the lives of the unborn. **[**Will you join me today and stand up for those who cannot do it for themselves?**](http://links.redconservatives.com/u/click?_t=66ce1250519441959ebe70cf27686494&_m=b979dbbed313412ab8eb5860c050cfe4&_e=sFvXpT3OvafjpW7Db7tYM5tkMpqa89sXnW0wOt84vvUPXnhrkE4AyZW9jqD_JRvZlD7JJLOWTwZP-fFfGRY1fIjFLJkB_vFJt71MIT2Ct5Zr0_KcmuWkWTYNToTOmokV31jzx3wEE2dv7I7KS8P_1-tDBZp1hsOEiBDfbDjmWqKaTA7Mx_6HyBptxRU36ZgewdqfWd0SJuuAF_90V8k78LPELuEiAEVaxzqaDPnCX1vVbTfE-NKDVvYDyrs0qPECBMwDnHjGc32Qew_C2RBBewuvr76KTfrCgxw33kSfFKSXlncviMv8fkOw52oxui_kNQ9DmNuo7DtDuMYDb2RrahnlL65vIb2GfuNOL9R4ndhxf36AMXIgPsr8LVh6Zy9HDYKpDXlFVL6-n93nDjdd5VLMdBQiN6_wlM-8YOZ4eT8%3D)**

I've created a new pro-life pledge; I'd love your support. Would you read the pledge below to see if you align with our shared goals and are willing to commit to fighting for the lives of the unborn?

[https://offers.americancornerstone.org/pro-life-statement/](http://links.redconservatives.com/u/click?_t=66ce1250519441959ebe70cf27686494&_m=b979dbbed313412ab8eb5860c050cfe4&_e=sFvXpT3OvafjpW7Db7tYM5tkMpqa89sXnW0wOt84vvUPXnhrkE4AyZW9jqD_JRvZlD7JJLOWTwZP-fFfGRY1fIjFLJkB_vFJt71MIT2Ct5Zr0_KcmuWkWTYNToTOmokV31jzx3wEE2dv7I7KS8P_1-tDBZp1hsOEiBDfbDjmWqKaTA7Mx_6HyBptxRU36ZgewdqfWd0SJuuAF_90V8k78LPELuEiAEVaxzqaDPnCX1vVbTfE-NKDVvYDyrs0qPECBMwDnHjGc32Qew_C2RBBe4jQv2xAk__9eWoVawt474eNqcYV3I452_W_PBR0zIOOJeupll9CEGEvWcgvzG7SYM5E0pHFP9rFQcMyVhw2B2Y-fuM8ea7h4XY6_AmZj0CmoF1cIVIF_OWiNHq1Q3XDNNL3WhrHKBwqnBNzr9k10c0%3D)

Regards,

Dr. Ben Carson
Founder & Chairman
American Cornerstone Institute

name: No Dem Left Behind
subject: Across the Country: October 22nd, 2024
body:
The housing crisis continues in America's battleground states.
| | | | | |
---
**_Across the Country_**
---
|
---
Hello, folks! Welcome back to _Across the Country_ , the weekly series from No Dem Left Behind! I’m Sabrina Niazi, and together with my colleague Daniela Rodriguez, we’re keeping you updated on the critical issues shaping battleground states. This week, we’re turning our attention to the housing crisis, which is hitting states like Michigan, Arizona, and North Carolina especially hard. Skyrocketing rents, lack of affordable homes, and increasing homelessness are impacting millions and will be a decisive factor in the upcoming elections.
---
| | | | **Housing Crisis in Battleground States**
---
|
---
As we head toward November, rising home prices and soaring mortgage rates are becoming a central focus in several crucial battleground counties. The high cost of housing is putting intense pressure on potential homebuyers, many of whom are already feeling the squeeze of inflation and economic uncertainty. In places like Maricopa County, Arizona, and Oakland County, Michigan, first-time homebuyers are struggling to afford homes in what were once considered more affordable markets. These counties, already political bellwethers, are now grappling with a housing market that’s pricing out many middle-class families. According to a recent report, 80% of homebuyers in key battleground counties feel financially strained by current housing conditions, and this dissatisfaction is increasingly becoming a decisive factor in the 2024 election. Voters in these regions are more likely to prioritize economic policies that can address housing affordability, and candidates who fail to respond risk losing support. President Biden has acknowledged the crisis, emphasizing federal programs designed to ease the burden on homebuyers, including expanded tax credits and low-interest loan options. However, rising mortgage rates—pushed up by inflation and Federal Reserve policies—continue to make homeownership inaccessible for many Americans. The Biden administration has also advocated for building more affordable housing to increase supply, which is seen as one of the long-term solutions to the crisis. Republicans, on the other hand, are leveraging this housing crisis to criticize the current administration’s handling of inflation and economic policy. In places like Michigan and Pennsylvania, GOP candidates are promising to curb inflation and ease housing costs by cutting government spending and scaling back federal regulations. Housing affordability is not just a financial issue—it’s a deeply personal one. For many voters, the ability to own a home is tied to the American Dream, and when that dream feels out of reach, it drives political decisions. The current crisis is shifting voter priorities in key counties, making the 2024 election about more than just traditional economic indicators. It's about whether or not everyday Americans feel like they can build a stable life for themselves and their families. Candidates who address this issue with actionable plans—whether it’s through reducing inflation, increasing affordable housing, or providing more direct financial assistance—are likely to gain an edge in these battleground regions. As we get closer to November, expect to see housing affordability rise as one of the most critical issues for voters in 2024. Stay tuned for more updates as we continue to cover the issues shaping this election. Stay informed with NDLB!

# FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
October 22, 2024
CONTACT: press@kevinfaulconer.com

**Faulconer Campaign Launches New Ad Exposing Terra Lawson-Remer’s Absenteeism**
_**Highlights Absenteeism and Lack of Action Despite Rising Homeless Crisis**_
**San Diego, CA** – Today, Kevin Faulconer campaign unveiled its latest ad, spotlighting Supervisor Terra Lawson-Remer’s chronic absenteeism and failure to address critical issues facing San Diego County. Titled “[ _Can’t Hide_](https://kevinfaulconer.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c8e1915e5d9cc8e4a2f64f766&id=910a41d5e3&e=784f78234b)” the ad highlights her absence from county meetings, missed votes, and lack of leadership on homelessness despite her role as vice chair of the homeless task force.
---
[](https://kevinfaulconer.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c8e1915e5d9cc8e4a2f64f766&id=99bdafd2d4&e=784f78234b)
[CLICK HERE TO WATCH: “Can’t Hide”](https://kevinfaulconer.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c8e1915e5d9cc8e4a2f64f766&id=e37cd7bc7a&e=784f78234b)
| _**“San Diegans deserve leaders who show up, address the issues that matter, and deliver real results,” said Faulconer. “While Lawson-Remer has been absent, I’ve spent my career tackling challenges like homelessness. It’s shameful that, when confronted with her record, she chose to lie and mislead the public. It’s time to hold her accountable by firing her this November.”**_
The ad contrasts Faulconer’s track record as mayor—where he worked across the aisle to reduce homelessness, increase affordable housing construction and make San Diego the safest city in America—with Lawson-Remer’s inaction and poor attendance, which has contributed to the county’s struggles with homelessness, housing and public safety.
Watch the full ad here: “[Can’t Hide](https://kevinfaulconer.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c8e1915e5d9cc8e4a2f64f766&id=ace49b6eaf&e=784f78234b)”. ###

Join Call With Rural Believers Tonight 8 pm | |

| | | If you live in a rural community or have friends and family who do, please join us for a [Rural Evangelicals for Harris supporter zoom call](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=d55c050524&e=43463f1dee) TONIGHT from 8 - 9 pm ET.

Supporting Harris and Walz brings unique challenges and opportunities for believers who live in rural communities, so tonight's call is designed by and for rural and agricultural families and those who support them. **Please **[**join us**](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=002bb8d81d&e=43463f1dee)** for prayer, encouragement, and discussion of Harris/Walz administration policies that will benefit rural and agricultural families and communities. **We’ll also share ways **to discuss these policies with families and friends, and how to do more to elect Harris and Walz in these final weeks before the election.**

This is an off the record conversation.

Please register [here](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=723e24c9a9&e=43463f1dee). We look forward to seeing you TONIGHT from 8-9 pm ET.

_**"Let my whole being bless the Lord! Lord my God, how fantastic you are! You are clothed in glory and grandeur! You wear light like a robe; you open the skies like a curtain."**_(Psalm 104:1-2)

Psalm 104 is one of our favorite Bible chapters because it reminds us that God's glory extends over all the created order, including farm and field.

Thank you for all you're doing to support Harris and Walz. We’re praying for you.

Blessings,
The Evangelicals for Harris Team

| Friends and Neighbors,

We are now just two weeks out from the 2024 General Election on Tuesday, November 5. Make your voice heard and get out the vote! Early voting started this week, and there is still time to request and turn in your Vote-by-Mail Ballot. Please visit the [Marion County Supervisor of Election’s website](https://ryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=0ae8e3888c&e=d1c1b9864f) for more information.

Today, I will be sharing with you an update from last week’s events in the district. I had a great time out in the community, meeting constituents and learning more about the issues important to Marion County. As always, [please do not hesitate to reach out to me](https://ryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=3d98862116&e=d1c1b9864f) if there is something you need assistance with. I would be more than happy to speak with you!

---

---

---

I also had the pleasure of joining Rep. Rachel Plakon in Seminole County to knock on doors in her community. With the election only a few weeks away, I want to encourage you to learn more about who is running to represent you at each level of government.
---

It is so important to get informed about brain health and what you can do to help support those affected by Alzheimer’s.

clean_body: [] Friends, A new independent poll from Newsday/Siena has John neck and neck with LaLota - and climbing! [] A three point lead for an incumbent well below 50% is bad news for Nick LaLota. Here’s the thing. There are still a LOT of undecideds in our race. But let us explain why we’ve got all the momentum: 1. When an incumbent is only getting 47% of the vote and has had years and millions of dollars to get to 47%... that’s bad news. That means 53% of the district doesn’t want anything to do with LaLota anymore. Now our job is to make sure they know John’s the best choice to be an independent voice for Suffolk County families. 2. Did you know that at least 71% of our district is pro-choice? And over 90% believe abortion should be legal in at least some cases? That’s overwhelming opposition to Nick LaLota’s 12 week abortion ban. 3. We’ve got one of the largest field programs in the country. We’re talking to THOUSANDS of voters every day, spreading the word about John’s common sense solutions - and it’s working. That in person outreach beyond the base is how you win swing districts. 4. BTW, we can think of one vote LaLota isn’t getting... his own. Yeah. Remember he broke his promise to move to the district and can’t even vote for himself. This poll shows what we’ve always believed: This is going to be within the margin of error. It’s going to be really close. But we’ve got the momentum. It’s all hands on deck to finish strong. Are you with us? [] CONTRIBUTE [] Thank you for fighting the good fight with us. -Team Avlon PAID FOR BY JOHN AVLON FOR CONGRESS John Avlon for Congress PO Box 1200 Sag Harbor, NY 11963 United States If you believe you received this message in error or wish to no longer receive email from us, please unsubscribe: .

| | | **Stand with Us to Protect Hunting & Fishing Rights in Washington****!**
---

Dear Peter,

---
| | | Washington’s 8th Congressional District is home to some of the most beautiful lands and waters in the country, and for generations, hunting and fishing have been a way of life for our families and communities. These traditions are a vital part of our heritage, but now, they’re under threat from out-of-touch politicians and bureaucrats who want to impose unnecessary restrictions and take away our rights.

Carmen Goers strongly advocates for protecting these rights to ensure future generations can continue to enjoy the outdoors and sustainably harvest natural resources, preserving these traditions and our ecosystems. Just last month, Kim Schrier voted **against **protecting the rights of our citizens to hunt and fish. Does this represent you?

---
| | | |
---
| We need your help to make sure our values are represented in Congress. Your donation today will help us defend the rights of sportsmen and women, ensure future generations can enjoy the outdoors, and promote common-sense conservation.

Whether you can give $25, $50, or any amount, your support will make a real difference in our fight to protect hunting and fishing rights in Washington’s 8th District.

---

Thank you for your support,
Team Goers

subject: Be Brave
body:
America is at a critical crossroads, and we need to be brave now more than ever.

| | | America is at a critical crossroads, and we need to be brave now more than ever.
---
| |
---
| | [](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/SgDb9huxa07Rlx1pe-Xoag~~/AARclAA~/RgRo-pXeP0SyaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS9icmF2ZS1ib29rcy8yZGM1ZWVmMC0zMTUyLTRmYjItYTc0Yi1hNzc3MzA4ZmMxMWI_dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1CREctUkVWJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09RU0mdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTIwMjQxMDE2X0JER19CUkFWRV9CQl9SRVZfUEEtT0dUJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PU9HVC0yMDI0MTAyMlcDc3BjQgpnEsb6F2fzyT1VUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)
---
Fellow American, America is at a critical crossroads, and we need to be brave now more than ever. For years the radical left has waged an all-out war against the Christian values that built this nation. As you look around at today’s culture, it’s easy to feel discouraged. But I believe with all my heart that this moment in history offers an opportunity for a spiritual comeback in America — a chance for people of faith to rise up and lead our nation back to God. My name is Kirk Cameron, and I’m not just an actor or an author. I’m a Christian, a father, and someone who deeply loves this country. Over the years, I’ve witnessed a steady erosion of the values that made America great — values rooted in faith, family, and freedom.
---
| | But recently I’ve been seeing the rumblings of revival across the nation, and I know there’s hope if we act now. In my new book, _Born to Be Brave: How to be a Part of America’s Spiritual Comeback_ , I explain how Christians can lean into their “birthright of courage” to overcome fear and boldly live out their faith. **[**And I want to offer you the opportunity to get one of the first signed copies of my latest book while supporting a project near and dear to my heart.**](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/SgDb9huxa07Rlx1pe-Xoag~~/AARclAA~/RgRo-pXeP0SyaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS9icmF2ZS1ib29rcy8yZGM1ZWVmMC0zMTUyLTRmYjItYTc0Yi1hNzc3MzA4ZmMxMWI_dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1CREctUkVWJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09RU0mdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTIwMjQxMDE2X0JER19CUkFWRV9CQl9SRVZfUEEtT0dUJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PU9HVC0yMDI0MTAyMlcDc3BjQgpnEsb6F2fzyT1VUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)**

| | I’ve partnered with Brave Books because I believe that by standing together and standing strong, we can realign this nation with Heaven’s values. We’ve already seen the impact of that courage in our nationwide “See You at the Library” movement. This past August, over 30,000 God-fearing Americans joined us at public libraries to reclaim these spaces for God and country. Together, we reclaimed our nation’s libraries and read stories that teach children the values of faith, bravery, and love of God and country. But this is just the beginning. My friends at Brave Books and I are determined to take this movement even further. We have a goal of reaching 100,000 children in the next year with wholesome, God-honoring Story Hours across the nation — and we need your help. [**That’s why I’m asking you to support our mission with a special donation today. And as a special thank-you for your generous gift of $100 or more, I’ll send you a signed copy of my new book,****_Born to Be Brave_****.**](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/SgDb9huxa07Rlx1pe-Xoag~~/AARclAA~/RgRo-pXeP0SyaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS9icmF2ZS1ib29rcy8yZGM1ZWVmMC0zMTUyLTRmYjItYTc0Yi1hNzc3MzA4ZmMxMWI_dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1CREctUkVWJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09RU0mdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTIwMjQxMDE2X0JER19CUkFWRV9CQl9SRVZfUEEtT0dUJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PU9HVC0yMDI0MTAyMlcDc3BjQgpnEsb6F2fzyT1VUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~) Your donation will help fund our nationwide Story Hour initiative, sending “Story Hour Kits” filled with faith-based, patriotic books to parents and grandparents who want to counter the radical left’s influence in our libraries. Each kit equips families with the tools they need to teach children the truth about faith, freedom, and the values that made America great. America’s future depends on what we do today. Together, we can stand boldly for what is right and bring our nation back to God. **[Please donate today and join us in this revival of faith and freedom. With your support, we can ensure that America’s children grow up with the courage to stand for truth.](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/SgDb9huxa07Rlx1pe-Xoag~~/AARclAA~/RgRo-pXeP0SyaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS9icmF2ZS1ib29rcy8yZGM1ZWVmMC0zMTUyLTRmYjItYTc0Yi1hNzc3MzA4ZmMxMWI_dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1CREctUkVWJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09RU0mdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTIwMjQxMDE2X0JER19CUkFWRV9CQl9SRVZfUEEtT0dUJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PU9HVC0yMDI0MTAyMlcDc3BjQgpnEsb6F2fzyT1VUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)** Thank you, and may God bless you and this great nation. | | Dear Fellow American, We generally remember ancient Rome for its sprawling empire and powerful emperors. But overlooked by our fascination with the might and drama of imperial Rome is the fact that Rome reached its greatness through a far different form of government. Did you know that Caesar Augustus inherited 90% of the territory of his Empire from the Roman Republic? The story of how the Roman Republic emerged from a group of warring tribes in the middle of the Italian peninsula to dominate the Mediterranean and, later, most of Europe is a captivating narrative of achievement, political and military genius, and the perils of success.
---

body:
Transformative change is coming on her first day

| | | [ ](jillstein2024.com/)
---
Peter, The protectors of the deadly status quo will tell you that change can only come in small increments. The corporate duopoly is fully funded by the billionaire class – because they know the politicians they pay off won’t rock the boat. As Joe Biden assured them back in 2020, whether you put a Democrat or a Republican in the White House: “ _Nothing will fundamentally change._ ”

** _Jill Stein will bring transformative change on day one._****_
_**
Check out Jill’s empowering agenda that she will enact on her first day in office:

---
[ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/day1?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=fe_10_22_pm&n=1)

---
Yes, this is an ambitious agenda, but don’t let the naysayers fool you – this can and will be done by a Stein/Ware administration immediately.

As President, Jill is committed to using the power of the office to unleash the power of the people. She will end the march towards WWIII and bring a lasting peace. She will stop sending billions abroad to fund the horrific genocide in Gaza, and instead invest in the American people and pass the real Green New Deal so that we can reverse the impact of climate change before our planet becomes unlivable. She will fight for living wages, affordable housing, and Medicare for All. And she will transform our political landscape so that we’re a healthy democracy that isn’t controlled by big money interests. [_**Peter, we’re in our final two weeks and we need to get the word out to voters around the nation that they can vote for a brighter future with a Stein/Ware administration. We need to run ads and get 8 million people to see our digital billboards. body:
https://rokhanna.com [https://rokhanna.com]

Friend,

Over 15 million Americans [https://www.cnn.com/2024/05/10/health/ozempic-glp-1-survey-kff/index.html] use GLP-1 drugs like Ozempic and Wegovy to treat diabetes and obesity. Yet many are paying $1000 or more out of pocket each month for these treatments, leaving millions more unable to access them. Some people are even turning to risky compound versions [https://www.cnn.com/2023/05/30/health/fda-compounding-semaglutide/index.html] of this drug that lack FDA approval.

Meanwhile, Novo Nordisk has made nearly $50 billion [https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/health/2024/09/24/senate-hearing-novo-nordisk-ceo-ozempic-wegovy-prices/75348020007/] on the sales of Ozempic and Wegovy since 2018, with nearly three-quarters of those profits coming from U.S. sales. While Americans spend over $12,000 annually on these lifesaving medications, patients in other countries may pay as little as $60 each month.

GLP-1 drugs have the potential to curb obesity while treating related conditions like diabetes and heart disease [https://www.massgeneralbrigham.org/en/about/newsroom/articles/weight-loss-drug-reduces-heart-disease-risk-study] , leading to lower healthcare costs for everyone. But that’s only if patients can afford them and insurance companies will cover the cost.

We can’t allow major drug companies to bleed Americans dry for vital treatments. Tell Congress: Stand up to Big Pharma and cap prescription drug prices. [https://act.rokhanna.com/a/cap-prescription-prices-petition?contactdata=oGVwegKt98Ke1ybpFJ3+afFrLhq8N4wTnLTItaJ6oVRb1xAkaEYbjUaN9+mR1lVGez99IfX4u7yCrKkSkdxKBBDV6+W+dDWia0M1sf/yMDz/mDmZeboCLTSJKRRbJWqgzqtTpcdoYcKxG+yluxNGGw==]

https://act.rokhanna.com/a/cap-prescription-prices-petition?contactdata=oGVwegKt98Ke1ybpFJ3+afFrLhq8N4wTnLTItaJ6oVRb1xAkaEYbjUaN9+mR1lVGez99IfX4u7yCrKkSkdxKBBDV6+W+dDWia0M1sf/yMDz/mDmZeboCLTSJKRRbJWqgzqtTpcdoYcKxG+yluxNGGw== [https://act.rokhanna.com/a/cap-prescription-prices-petition?contactdata=oGVwegKt98Ke1ybpFJ3+afFrLhq8N4wTnLTItaJ6oVRb1xAkaEYbjUaN9+mR1lVGez99IfX4u7yCrKkSkdxKBBDV6+W+dDWia0M1sf/yMDz/mDmZeboCLTSJKRRbJWqgzqtTpcdoYcKxG+yluxNGGw==]

Americans pay more for their medications than any other country. Over 9 million Americans [https://www.cnn.com/2023/06/02/health/prescription-drug-costs-rationing/index.html#:~:text=Most%20adults%20between%20the%20ages,according%20to%20the%20CDC%20data.] tried to save money by skipping doses of their medications in 2021. Meanwhile, Big Pharma’s high prices and lobbying efforts resulted in $38.7 billion [https://accountable.us/analysis-drug-companies-impacted-by-biden-rx-cost-saving-effort-boasted-of-38-7b-in-profits-in-2022/] in combined earnings the following year.

No matter the condition or coverage, we must ensure that all Americans can access the medications they need.

Sign the Petition [https://act.rokhanna.com/a/cap-prescription-prices-petition?contactdata=oGVwegKt98Ke1ybpFJ3+afFrLhq8N4wTnLTItaJ6oVRb1xAkaEYbjUaN9+mR1lVGez99IfX4u7yCrKkSkdxKBBDV6+W+dDWia0M1sf/yMDz/mDmZeboCLTSJKRRbJWqgzqtTpcdoYcKxG+yluxNGGw==]

Thank you for your activism and all that you do.

In solidarity,
Ro

Wait! One more thing–

Ro doesn't accept a cent from lobbyists or PACs, meaning our work is completely funded by grassroots supporters like you. By donating just $3 today, you’re helping us create a country that works for everyone, not just those at the top. That means a renewed investment in American manufacturing, Medicare for All, student debt relief, and a green future.

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

| **_GET TO KNOW CURTIS_**

**Curtis Bashaw is a hotel entrepreneur, job creator, and preservationist. He's running for United States Senate to provide greater freedom and opportunities for all New Jerseyans.**

A lifelong New Jersey resident, Curtis grew up in Camden County and spent his summers at the Jersey Shore working as a bellhop and waiting tables at Congress Hall in Cape May. He has spent his life in the real estate and hospitality industries, and is the Founder and Managing Partner of Cape Resorts, a hotel company focusing on the restoration and operation of classic American resort properties in New Jersey and New York.

Throughout his career, Curtis has worked to build communities and bring people together. He is widely recognized for leading the landmark restorations of Congress Hall and the Virginia Hotel in Cape May, and for launching creative programming to dramatically extend Cape May's season, a catalyst for the economic rebirth of one of the Jersey Shore's most beautiful communities.

Curtis is a successful businessman and job creator, employing more than 1,000 people in New Jersey and New York. Curtis' company owns and operates eight hotels, ten cottages, six restaurants, four retail outlets and a working farm, all on the Jersey Shore and Long Island's East End. Curtis lives in Cape May with his husband, Will.

name: Team Lizzie
subject: #TeamLizzie Update—2 weeks to Election Day!
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ELIZABETH PANNILL FLETCHER FOR CONGRESS
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe241022wu?refcode=lpfe241022wu [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe241022wu?refcode=lpfe241022wu]
Yes, you read that right—Texans are voting now in the 2024 elections! Early voting is open, and Lizzie and Texans across the state have already cast their ballots.
It’s go time in Texas. And #TeamLizzie is going, going, going. It’s been a great week.
Last Tuesday, Lizzie was in Dallas to support Congressman Colin Allred at his debate against Senator Ted Cruz. We couldn’t be more excited about Colin’s performance or more confident that he’s the leader Texans need and deserve in the Senate.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe241015wu?refcode=lpfe241015wu [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe241015wu?refcode=lpfe241015wu]
On Friday, we mailed out thousands and thousands of postcards to voters across this district. Many thanks to the dozens of #TeamLizzie volunteers who joined us week after week for postcard parties and the many others who took them home and brought them back to put in the mail!
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe241022wu?refcode=lpfe241022wu [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe241022wu?refcode=lpfe241022wu]
We had a great weekend in #TX07 and across HTown! Thanks to all the #TeamLizzie volunteers who spent this beautiful weekend knocking on doors and talking with voters! We're glad to join West U Democrats, Bayou Blue Democrats, West Houston Democrats, Houston Black American Democrats, Southwest Democrats, Swing TX Left, and Harris County Democratic Party at events all across the district for a weekend full of action. Very special thanks to the great Congressman Jim Clyburn, who Lizzie was thrilled to welcome back to Houston as we work to elect our friend Colin!
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe241022wu?refcode=lpfe241022wu [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe241022wu?refcode=lpfe241022wu]
#TeamLizzie capped off the weekend in Fort Bend County for a GOTV rally where we were thrilled to welcome Colin and Congressman Clyburn. Lizzie is proud to represent Fort Bend in #TX07 and to team up with leaders from across the county as we work to get out the vote and elect Democrats up and down the ballot!
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe241022wu?refcode=lpfe241022wu [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe241022wu?refcode=lpfe241022wu]
We know you know the stakes in this election. Everyone needs to make a plan to vote—vote early and get others to do the same!
Texans can find early voting locations here. [https://teamrv-mvp.sos.texas.gov/MVP/mvp.do] If you’ve already voted, please share this link [https://teamrv-mvp.sos.texas.gov/MVP/mvp.do] with Texans far and wide and encourage them to do the same.
https://teamrv-mvp.sos.texas.gov/MVP/mvp.do [https://teamrv-mvp.sos.texas.gov/MVP/mvp.do]
There are only two Saturdays before Election Day, and of course, we’re spending them getting out the vote. We’re hitting the doors again this Saturday, October 23, from 9 a.m. to noon and noon to 3 p.m. [https://www.mobilize.us/fletcherforcongress/event/678074/]
https://www.mobilize.us/fletcherforcongress/event/678074/ [https://www.mobilize.us/fletcherforcongress/event/678074/]
Can’t make it this weekend? Join us for an evening phone bank! Our next one is tomorrow, October 23, from 5 to 8 p.m. [https://www.mobilize.us/fletcherforcongress/event/678056/] You can also sign up to help us deliver #TeamLizzie yard signs [https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSc0-jLsPbvw4F5Gmi2SJasRkuMHfMi1O5DF_SvSo4koyAbihQ/viewform] to voters and polling locations across the district.
https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSc0-jLsPbvw4F5Gmi2SJasRkuMHfMi1O5DF_SvSo4koyAbihQ/viewform [https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSc0-jLsPbvw4F5Gmi2SJasRkuMHfMi1O5DF_SvSo4koyAbihQ/viewform]
This is it—we’re in the home stretch to Election Day. We need as many volunteers as possible helping us get out the vote. We hope you can make it to some—or several, or all—of these events!
Thanks for being a part of the team,
Team Lizzie

body:
Kari Lake and Donald Trump should absolutely lose this election. But the truth is, Arizona is going to come down to the wire.
#

Peter -
We’ve been trying to come up with the best way to convince you to donate to Ruben’s campaign. We decided the best way is to be completely honest with you.
So, look:
It would be one thing if Kari Lake and Donald Trump were just regular, run of the mill Republicans.
**But these are two of the most dangerous politicians our country has ever seen. Kari Lake seriously calls herself the “MAGA Queen” and the “most dangerous politician in the world!”**
It would be one thing if we could expect these two to just put aside the results of the election if they lost and move on.
**But Kari Lake is still trying to get the courts to declare her Governor, and she called on the House of Representatives to void the 2020 election and replace President Biden with Trump!**
And it’d be one thing if Arizona wasn’t one of the most competitive states around.
**But just about every election in Arizona is decided by fewer votes than it takes to fill a football stadium, and this one is no different!**
Look — Kari Lake and Donald Trump should absolutely lose this election. But the truth is, Arizona is going to come down to the wire. And that... that is genuinely ridiculous. Sorry, but it’s true.
It’s close, but Ruben’s leading the pack in Arizona right now. And if he can pull enough votes behind him, enough votes away from Trump, there’s a really good chance we not only defeat Kari Lake and defend the U.S. Senate, but that we defeat Trump as well.
And Nate Silver says that if we defeat Trump in Arizona, there’s a 93% chance that we defeat him nationwide.
We’ll take those odds. How about you?

body:
This powerful story follows the journeys of two Army officers
[](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=ef33fb4fd62e46b7aadcae437d6f679f&_e=ySa4ktKAAnaH7j4RjvSj38eoPCSb26fvIwZ7q4tzxcLQJyNznCIcGNyPs5p62gFIyc8pjiElsq2XSK1sqkZgf_HsLZgbnvJ-NnH7Qp4xVE91uhUesdBjSGfnV8u3J8vucOZPf51XfGtBFmmR_ymBRIuU6HurK7iYu5o1g929w_yCHPaUpWZE94uX_ZnhHcXEXQfqy7okfYJO-pXMvExkEKucgJ8CsjwFExCF1sRgM9myU-UMw8cPspUi3v6IWaQSwnNu8i5Gj77qKiFxRHPamCP6G8Rcn_gdgECPwiI5T1F3NGHmSLvs_X34IHyQyp7hUt6AKlwdI641dTPJA1Ua5C5i5yjTgg8zqfcbrHauLRHAVyFbnR-MogidFEI_Do-UP-sj5kN71-qtbRovFFGidA%3D%3D)

Fellow Patriot,

Before you sit down for dinner, will you take a minute to read this?

As I am on the campaign trail, I'm reminded of the great sacrifices that are made every day to defend our country. Today, I hope you'll take just a few minutes to hear this personal story directly from me.

Nearly four decades ago, during my time at West Point, I came across a book that left a lasting impact on me. **[It was"Once an Eagle" by Anton Myrer.](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=ef33fb4fd62e46b7aadcae437d6f679f&_e=ySa4ktKAAnaH7j4RjvSj38eoPCSb26fvIwZ7q4tzxcLQJyNznCIcGNyPs5p62gFIyc8pjiElsq2XSK1sqkZgf_HsLZgbnvJ-NnH7Qp4xVE91uhUesdBjSGfnV8u3J8vucOZPf51XfGtBFmmR_ymBRIuU6HurK7iYu5o1g929w_yCHPaUpWZE94uX_ZnhHcXEXQfqy7okfYJO-pXMvExkEKucgJ8CsjwFExCF1sRgM9myU-UMw8cPspUi3v6IWaQSwMsFXNz7XBz7ylB_J1BBfMN4n6T-sQ2L806lJTJRv5Y27MJxrkY4xor7PSvFae9aGnYxWeF4ovB-CVAAEcv75A0GIUlqIrl-C9LQAN3cR-JLMiWTLDqzsk-Px7D410J5SkMaT3HkT5-pxGmxEvSdZg%3D%3D)**

This powerful story follows the journeys of two Army officers - one who navigated his career driven solely by personal gain and advancement, and one who navigated his career by putting the well-being of his fellow soldiers above all else.
[](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=ef33fb4fd62e46b7aadcae437d6f679f&_e=ySa4ktKAAnaH7j4RjvSj38eoPCSb26fvIwZ7q4tzxcLQJyNznCIcGNyPs5p62gFIyc8pjiElsq2XSK1sqkZgf_HsLZgbnvJ-NnH7Qp4xVE91uhUesdBjSGfnV8u3J8vucOZPf51XfGtBFmmR_ymBRIuU6HurK7iYu5o1g929w_yCHPaUpWZE94uX_ZnhHcXEXQfqy7okfYJO-pXMvExkEKucgJ8CsjwFExCF1sRgM9myU-UMw8cPspUi3v6IWaQSjO74zLQVFU-MgPxVBFIly-GjQNLgWAGmj86DPesD0lQ5XMFBdA63jDzOW7C4RAKasNgnR0lbUdvfzlvvw17IlxolD1HQe8aLYcTllzdBS7L0DXjEPPf9oOJoINVMv9k4gUVHgk8LBtl_XJ2Wp3azjw%3D%3D)
After graduating from West Point, I went into the Army. It was then that I truly reflected on this book and one very important lesson it taught me.

**[True leadership is not about you. It is about selfless service to others and to the mission.](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=ef33fb4fd62e46b7aadcae437d6f679f&_e=ySa4ktKAAnaH7j4RjvSj38eoPCSb26fvIwZ7q4tzxcLQJyNznCIcGNyPs5p62gFIyc8pjiElsq2XSK1sqkZgf_HsLZgbnvJ-NnH7Qp4xVE91uhUesdBjSGfnV8u3J8vucOZPf51XfGtBFmmR_ymBRIuU6HurK7iYu5o1g929w_yCHPaUpWZE94uX_ZnhHcXEXQfqy7okfYJO-pXMvExkEKucgJ8CsjwFExCF1sRgM9myU-UMw8cPspUi3v6IWaQS4cgWjTnYqDA6zslImbJPZuJqELoi7gejj3Dcmxq68N5SEFQcWKWOfN3iUHR0NckEKgDF3SUGu_6aeb5Na0jIlTHxZqcoPLaHZar0E414UEozGcISupK3V6bkh_xVPnkDzkbotblsiN_fidxib8kQkQ%3D%3D)**
[](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=ef33fb4fd62e46b7aadcae437d6f679f&_e=ySa4ktKAAnaH7j4RjvSj38eoPCSb26fvIwZ7q4tzxcLQJyNznCIcGNyPs5p62gFIyc8pjiElsq2XSK1sqkZgf_HsLZgbnvJ-NnH7Qp4xVE91uhUesdBjSGfnV8u3J8vucOZPf51XfGtBFmmR_ymBRIuU6HurK7iYu5o1g929w_yCHPaUpWZE94uX_ZnhHcXEXQfqy7okfYJO-pXMvExkEKucgJ8CsjwFExCF1sRgM9myU-UMw8cPspUi3v6IWaQS9-o-E9SfFU1G--PMtSorQkvSfTKPOEZDVUX6VR0pLsPg2X6yl5TCv7xaSsjA82pPZH8uRL1L8WUuufqn_5P5YDu7zV_eeFGhMMmiPdPZ9e8_ouUphjWS-QrBYQOfrCwSzB_fZMI7_OKUwzkhs-f1sA%3D%3D)
As a combat vet, the days are long and hard. You're deep in the heart of a grueling trek, the weight of your pack bearing down with each step.
[](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=ef33fb4fd62e46b7aadcae437d6f679f&_e=ySa4ktKAAnaH7j4RjvSj38eoPCSb26fvIwZ7q4tzxcLQJyNznCIcGNyPs5p62gFIyc8pjiElsq2XSK1sqkZgf_HsLZgbnvJ-NnH7Qp4xVE91uhUesdBjSGfnV8u3J8vucOZPf51XfGtBFmmR_ymBRIuU6HurK7iYu5o1g929w_yCHPaUpWZE94uX_ZnhHcXEXQfqy7okfYJO-pXMvExkEKucgJ8CsjwFExCF1sRgM9myU-UMw8cPspUi3v6IWaQSznKS4Y1WnLsPvx2wqnYviKdkIqsVzwjzucsBDkNeJmFiQ0WryAT3nGKgNBO8Bjp0gLMfe3XBA93UHY6mk3EWSyiySHGgBjWsZ5BBAovQTU9MJeB5lH-tt-cglCpRkiGDRtbJLyPSWkNtLr53pGoysQ%3D%3D)

Hey Peter, With just about two weeks to go, I’m putting all my nervous energy into concrete ways to help our Democracy Defenders turn out enough votes to win their races. **[If you, too, are looking for ways to quell any anxieties and make a real impact, Peter,I recommend making a donation to the NDRC to help these critically important state-level races.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/95592959/507238011/-1538012183?refcode=don_ndrc_tier1_email_StateSupremeCourtRedux_email_20241022-NDRC-Tier1-StateSupremeCourtRedux_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20241022-NDRC-Tier1-StateSupremeCourtRedux_&utm_campaign=StateSupremeCourtRedux&express_lane=true&amount=30&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImYzZDMwZjU1LWI2OTAtZWYxMS04NDc0LTAwMGQzYTk4ZmE2YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=FrH9XDVNRuw4bSD54U5CiFRbeH0EOuDF_2k4A-yzBrY=)** And, okay, yes, sometimes at night I scroll my phone, looking for every possible update on these must-win races. (I can’t be the only one.) Last night, for example, I was reading the latest about the Arizona State Supreme Court. Two of seven seats are up for “retention,” as it’s called there. We’re supporting the effort to replace these two judges — they both recently voted to uphold a 19th-century abortion ban. There’s _also_ a ballot initiative in Arizona (Prop 137) that would _end term limits_ for state supreme and appellate court judges — _and_ it would be retroactive. If this ballot initiative passes, it would essentially cancel future elections for these seats and nullify the results of the two 2024 elections. Honestly, I started spiraling a bit. The current environment that we’re dealing with in state supreme court races is not a partisan environment as much as it is a question of democracy vs. authoritarianism. Tonight, instead of endlessly scrolling for updates, I’m going to re-energize by reading through our list of supporters who stepped up and pitched in with a donation. I hope I see your name, Peter. **[We have to help protect the integrity of our state supreme courts. Can you chip in right now to help pro-democracy leaders win their races across the country?](https://click.everyaction.com/k/95592960/507238012/-1538012183?refcode=don_ndrc_tier1_email_StateSupremeCourtRedux_email_20241022-NDRC-Tier1-StateSupremeCourtRedux_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20241022-NDRC-Tier1-StateSupremeCourtRedux_&utm_campaign=StateSupremeCourtRedux&express_lane=true&amount=30&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImYzZDMwZjU1LWI2OTAtZWYxMS04NDc0LTAwMGQzYTk4ZmE2YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=FrH9XDVNRuw4bSD54U5CiFRbeH0EOuDF_2k4A-yzBrY=)** | _If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_
