clean_body: With state supreme courts playing a vital role in deciding cases about gerrymandering, there is almost nothing that’s not at stake in 2024 with state supreme court races. | Hey Peter, With just about two weeks to go, I’m putting all my nervous energy into concrete ways to help our Democracy Defenders turn out enough votes to win their races. = And, okay, yes, sometimes at night I scroll my phone, looking for every possible update on these must-win races. (I can’t be the only one.) Last night, for example, I was reading the latest about the Arizona State Supreme Court. Two of seven seats are up for “retention,” as it’s called there. We’re supporting the effort to replace these two judges — they both recently voted to uphold a 19th-century abortion ban. There’s also a ballot initiative in Arizona (Prop 137) that would end term limits for state supreme and appellate court judges — and it would be retroactive. If this ballot initiative passes, it would essentially cancel future elections for these seats and nullify the results of the two 2024 elections. Honestly, I started spiraling a bit. The current environment that we’re dealing with in state supreme court races is not a partisan environment as much as it is a question of democracy vs. authoritarianism. Tonight, instead of endlessly scrolling for updates, I’m going to re-energize by reading through our list of supporters who stepped up and pitched in with a donation. I hope I see your name, Peter. = | If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: = | = = | = = | = A recent headline from Democracy Docket read, “Abortion, Voting Rights, Gerrymandering: What’s at Stake in 2024 Supreme Court Races.” (This was another late-night read that did the opposite of calming my nerves.) The article basically said that with state supreme courts playing a vital role in deciding cases about gerrymandering, there is almost nothing that’s not at stake in the 2024 state supreme court races. I’m not going to sugarcoat this: These elections are extremely high stakes. But we are not helpless. = Thank you so much, Biz John Bisognano President of the NDRC = = Since 2017, the NDRC has executed a comprehensive redistricting strategy that shifts the redistricting power, creating fair districts where Democrats can compete. Our victories have been made possible by our strong community of grassroots supporters. = If you want to receive periodic updates from the NDRC on our fight for fair maps, text MAPS to 36787. Text HELP for help, STOP to end. Msg & Data rates may apply. We know we send a lot of emails, but we think it's important to keep you updated with the latest information on Republican gerrymandering and voter suppression and how we're fighting back -- regardless of whether you choose to donate. = to make a donation. Every dollar you give will go toward our fight to end gerrymandering and voter suppression. | | Paid for by the National Democratic Redistricting Committee, John Bisognano, President. | | | | | ---|---|---|---|--- National Democratic Redistricting Committee 712 H St NE, Suite #25 Washington, DC 20002 United States if you'd like to receive fewer emails from the NDRC.

name: DNC HQ
subject: You deserve to know how we’ll put your $3 contribution to work in these final days:
body:
---
Derek, With 14 days until Election Day, we’re reaching out to ask for your help. But first, we want you to know exactly how we’ll use your $3 contribution and every other dollar we raise in these final days. Our top priority right now is **voter outreach** and making sure as many people as possible have a plan to cast their ballots for Democrats. name: Marjorie Taylor Greene
subject: Who is Shawn Harris?
body:
| | | | |
---
Friend –
Many people have been asking me... **_Who is Shawn Harris?_**
[](https://go.vbtrc.com/r/9iEH/?__vbtrk=MjU1MjU3OjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjU1MjU3OjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
_Shawn Harris: My propped up Democrat opponent_
Shawn Harris is a _**radical Democrat, masquerading as a moderate**_ , who was recruited by the Democrat establishment and even some fake “Republicans” to **_defeat me_** this November...
In his own words:
**“We're building a coalition from across the country,**
**united in our goal to**** __unseat Marjorie Taylor Greene__****.”**
** _\- Shawn Harris_**
[DEFEND MTG](https://go.vbtrc.com/r/9iEH/?__vbtrk=MjU1MjU3OjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjU1MjU3OjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
Make no mistake: Democrats are dumping TENS OF MILLIONS of dollars in the battleground states like Georgia.
They have a MASSIVE war chest being used to crush downballot races across the state like mine.
**And Democrats will spend MILLIONS of dollars against me like they always have to suppress Republican turnout, which hurts President Trump’s chances of winning Georgia.**
If that happens, we lose the state of Georgia.
[DEFEND MTG](https://go.vbtrc.com/r/9iEH/?__vbtrk=MjU1MjU3OjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjU1MjU3OjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
Shawn Harris has referred to me as “Moscow Marge,” because I opposed shipping _**your tax dollars overseas**_ while our border is wide open, and _**Americans _desperately_ need that money here at home**_.
When Shawn Harris _**lies to the public**_ and claims that I am some sort of Russian agent just because I don’t believe we should be fighting wars that have _**nothing to do with us**_ , he is flirting with ideas that _**could get me killed**_.
How do I know? Because Ryan Routhe, the latest lunatic to attempt to murder President Trump was _**radicalized to do so**_ because of his love for Ukraine...
That isn’t the only example of Shawn Harris lying about me, or my record... But that’s the kind of rhetoric that has led to the h _**ighest amount of death threats against me and my family...**_
It isn’t that Shawn Harris doesn’t know what the consequences of his actions might be...
**_It’s that radical Democrat consultants, their handlers, and their Candidates like Shawn Harris _just don’t care_._**
They didn’t care when **violent BLM rioters** burnt the entire country down in 2020...
They didn’t care when there were **two assassination attempts** against President Trump...
They didn’t care when **pro-Hamas rioters shut down the Capitol**...
In fact,_** it was all part of the plan of The Democrat Party of Violence**_.
[STAND UP TO RADICAL VIOLENT DEMOCRATS](https://go.vbtrc.com/r/9iEH/?__vbtrk=MjU1MjU3OjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjU1MjU3OjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
When I said that the US should stand with Israel - one of our longest standing allies - before standing with Ukraine - Shawn Harris called me an “anti-Semite” (a word he clearly doesn’t know the definition of) and again accused me of working for Putin:
[](https://go.vbtrc.com/r/9iEH/?__vbtrk=MjU1MjU3OjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjU1MjU3OjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
Friend, it is no secret that I am the biggest thorn in the side of the Deep State Controlled Democrats, and gutless, weak RINO “Republicans...”
There is a reason that now, with **less than a month to go before the election, Democrats are _propping up a candidate with _NO POLICIES_ other than complaining about _me_ , calling me names that could get me _murdered_ , and trying to popularize sending more money out of our country._**
If we lose our House majority this November, and the likes of Shawn Harris and other Deep State funded, phony candidates flood into our government... **_Even if President Trump wins, the fight will be lost. _**
[DEFEND MTG - DEFEND AMERICA](https://go.vbtrc.com/r/9iEH/?__vbtrk=MjU1MjU3OjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjU1MjU3OjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
I don’t want that to be our reality...
I want to secure victory for President Trump, and guarantee the House is full of Members of Congress that will __**support his Agenda 47**__ , **__secure the border__** , _**_protect the 1st & 2nd Amendments_**_, **_and stop the_** _**_endless foreign wars_**_** _!_**
But if we allow the left to flip seats like mine and crush one of the biggest opponents to the Radical Left, I’m afraid none of that will happen...
The stakes are too high for **the DNC** and **their pawns** to install **a puppet Member of Congress in _my seat_** , **create more chaos** , **undermine President Trump** , **get us tied up in more wars** , and _**leave the Southern Border open**_**!**
There is a reason that the DNC is choosing _**me**_ to hit with this, and not some other member: They know what a threat I am to them.
I’m getting nervous, and to be honest... _**I need your help...**_
__**[I’m fighting tooth-and-nail against this new development... But I can’t do it alone...](https://go.vbtrc.com/r/9iEH/?__vbtrk=MjU1MjU3OjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjU1MjU3OjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)**__
__**[Are you with me](https://go.vbtrc.com/r/9iEH/?__vbtrk=MjU1MjU3OjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjU1MjU3OjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)**__ _**?**_
_Yours Sincerely,_
[](https://go.vbtrc.com/r/9iEH/?__vbtrk=MjU1MjU3OjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjU1MjU3OjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
Marjorie Taylor Greene
[](https://go.vbtrc.com/r/9iEH/?__vbtrk=MjU1MjU3OjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjU1MjU3OjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)

name: Tamie Wilson
subject: We can’t afford another 2 years of Jim Jordan
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP33/1/100067/images/LOGO.jpg]
Friends,
Jim Jordan’s chaos has cost us dearly, and it’s impossible to fully measure the damage he’s done.
I’m not just talking metaphorically either – his obstructionist, do-nothing approach to his 17 years in Congress has literally cost Ohio millions and millions of dollars.
As an entrepreneur, I know that lost opportunities are often the most expensive – and Ohio has lost countless business and revenue opportunities under Jim Jordan’s so-called “leadership.”
Will you chip in $25, $50, or $100 today to help us continue reaching voters and build the future we all deserve? Every dollar brings us closer to unseating Jordan and stopping the harm he’s caused. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20241022_whats_possible_link1]
Let’s dig a little deeper on this:
Take Jordan’s vote against the CHIPS and Science Act last year.
This bill was designed to attract investments into American manufacturing, particularly semiconductors, yet Jordan opposed it.
Ohio was primed to benefit from this bill, which is creating thousands of high-paying jobs in the tech industry right here in our state.
Jordan could have helped bring even more resources to Ohio, but instead, he turned his back on us – choosing obstruction over progress.
And let’s not forget Jordan’s vote against the Inflation Reduction Act.
This bill is bringing billions of dollars in clean energy investments to states across the country.
Jim Jordan voted against it.
These are votes just within the last few years – think about all the resources he’s said NO to in 17 years!
His vote shows his complete disregard for everyday people who are struggling with high utility bills and looking for good-paying, future-proof jobs.
While he wastes time chasing partisan conspiracies and running sham hearings, workers across our state are missing out on opportunities to grow, thrive, and move forward.
Unlike Jim Jordan, I built a small business from the ground up.
I know what it’s like to face challenges and overcome obstacles, but I also know the value of seizing every opportunity.
With me, our country won’t miss out on the future we deserve. We’ll invest in small businesses, bring down everyday costs for families, and make sure our local economies thrive again.
I’m committed to revitalizing Main Street, creating more opportunities for local businesses to grow, and ensuring that hardworking Americans have access to fair wages and affordable living.
I will also fight to bring more federal resources back to our district – something Jim Jordan has refused to do.
Whether it’s infrastructure improvements, support for schools, or economic development grants, I’ll make sure our district gets the funding it deserves.
Together, we’ll build a future where our communities are strong, businesses of all sizes can succeed, and our district gets the investment it’s been denied for far too long.
We’ve raised more than $2M, but we need to hit $3M to keep up the fight and reach every voter. Will you help us finish strong? Every dollar gets us closer to removing Jim Jordan from office and bringing opportunity back to Ohio. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20241022_whats_possible_link2]
We’ve got just 14 days to send Jim Jordan packing. Are you with us?
Working for US,
Tamie Wilson
PS: If you can join us making phone calls, knocking on doors, or a number of other things, please sign up ASAP here. [https://www.tamiewilson.com/volunteer/]

clean_body: Power our work in this critical election year | | | Our work to protect the right vote happens every month, every year — because elections don’t only take place every four years. That means we need resources to run our volunteer campaigns, ensure voters stay aware of changes to voting rules, and fight back against voter suppression wherever and whenever it takes place. But what if we told you there’s an easy way to help fund this work and champion voting rights, and it’s something simple that you can start doing today? Our dedicated team of monthly donors — Democracy Defenders — play a key role in supporting our work for free and fair elections. Monthly donations make it easier to plan our budget, ensuring our team can build long-lasting programs, create comprehensive training and education plans, and invest consistently in increasing access to the ballot box for everyone. = | = = We’re seeing a nationally coordinated scheme to keep ballot access as far out of reach as possible, especially for Black and brown, young, disabled, unhoused, and rural voters. Anti-voter extremists are paving the way here in Georgia, starting with mass voter purges, attempting to disrupt the election certification process, and upending election administration. From training cohorts of Democracy Warriors to make their voices heard on voting access, to empowering people who have been historically shut out of the process with accurate and timely voting information, the Fair Fight Action team is committed to making sure all voters can access the ballot box, freely and fairly. Recurring, sustained support will help ensure we can revamp up our efforts before, during, and after elections. It’s the best way to support voting rights year around. = Your support moves us forward — thank you. But what many don’t realize is that state legislative races are just as crucial. These down-ballot races will determine if we move forward on climate action or let corporate polluters pull us back. That’s why I’m spotlighting three incredible JanePAC-endorsed candidates running for the Pennsylvania State House. **[Megan Kocher, Anna Thomas, and Hadley Haas are running against pro-Oil and Gas Republican incumbents, and they need your help to flip their districts! Can I count on you to split a $30 contribution between my Climate Champions of the Week?](https://click.everyaction.com/k/95595073/507244792/-2033403745?amount=30&refcode=ea.8b9386fd-b890-ef11-8474-000d3a98fa6b&ms=ea.8b9386fd-b890-ef11-8474-000d3a98fa6b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjhiOTM4NmZkLWI4OTAtZWYxMS04NDc0LTAwMGQzYTk4ZmE2YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=dyZWvQGB2iiz6J2_UOLRRDTuLZcPyrJ8qZ-uX7uf7Qc=)** I know you’re busy, but here’s why this moment is so important. ✅ **Pennsylvania is a make-or-break battleground state for climate action.** PA is the second-largest gas producer and the third-largest coal producer in the country, so the decisions made here have a substantial impact on our nation’s carbon footprint. Corporate polluters are determined to flip the state House to give Republicans the power to expand fracking, accelerate coal production, and roll back clean energy initiatives. All three of these seats are held by Republican incumbents, and with Democrats holding just a _one-seat_ majority, the outcomes will decide control of the chamber. ✅ **Turning out climate voters down ballot will also boost our chances at the top of the ticket.** The voters who show up for these state-level elections could also be the voters deciding the presidential race. If we can boost turnout down ballot, we can help secure Pennsylvania’s 19 electoral votes for Kamala Harris and Tim Walz, giving us the best shot at defeating Donald Trump. | **Meet My Climate Champions of the Week** 🌍 **Megan Kocher, HD-119:** Megan is fighting in one of Pennsylvania’s closest races, where her district has been devastated by fracking and pollution. She’s committed to leading the clean energy transition, advocating for grants to help families install solar, and fighting back against the fossil fuel giants that are hell-bent on building a $6 billion gas plant in her community. 🌍 **Anna Thomas, HD-137:** Anna came within 700 votes of flipping her district in 2022, and this time, she’s more than ready to win. Her district has some of the worst air quality in the state, and she’s ready to hold corporations accountable, ban forever chemicals, and preserve open space to protect her community. 🌍 **Hadley Haas, HD-44:** Hadley is running to flip a critical seat in Allegheny County, where fracking, watershed erosion, and pollution threaten her community’s health. She fought against _PennEnergy_ ’s plans to take a million gallons from a local creek and is committed to protecting clean air, clean water, and green spaces. Hadley knows that protecting our environment is essential for the future of her district.

clean_body: We only have two weeks left. | = With the race for the White House neck and neck, Pennsylvania’s role as a key swing state is front and center. But what many don’t realize is that state legislative races are just as crucial. These down-ballot races will determine if we move forward on climate action or let corporate polluters pull us back. That’s why I’m spotlighting three incredible JanePAC-endorsed candidates running for the Pennsylvania State House. = I know you’re busy, but here’s why this moment is so important. ✅ Pennsylvania is a make-or-break battleground state for climate action. PA is the second-largest gas producer and the third-largest coal producer in the country, so the decisions made here have a substantial impact on our nation’s carbon footprint. Corporate polluters are determined to flip the state House to give Republicans the power to expand fracking, accelerate coal production, and roll back clean energy initiatives. All three of these seats are held by Republican incumbents, and with Democrats holding just a one-seat majority, the outcomes will decide control of the chamber. ✅ Turning out climate voters down ballot will also boost our chances at the top of the ticket. The voters who show up for these state-level elections could also be the voters deciding the presidential race. If we can boost turnout down ballot, we can help secure Pennsylvania’s 19 electoral votes for Kamala Harris and Tim Walz, giving us the best shot at defeating Donald Trump. | Meet My Climate Champions of the Week 🌍 Megan Kocher, HD-119: Megan is fighting in one of Pennsylvania’s closest races, where her district has been devastated by fracking and pollution. She’s committed to leading the clean energy transition, advocating for grants to help families install solar, and fighting back against the fossil fuel giants that are hell-bent on building a $6 billion gas plant in her community. 🌍 Anna Thomas, HD-137: Anna came within 700 votes of flipping her district in 2022, and this time, she’s more than ready to win. Her district has some of the worst air quality in the state, and she’s ready to hold corporations accountable, ban forever chemicals, and preserve open space to protect her community. 🌍 Hadley Haas, HD-44: Hadley is running to flip a critical seat in Allegheny County, where fracking, watershed erosion, and pollution threaten her community’s health. Peter,

I wanted to take a moment to explain why I first decided to enter politics, and _why I'm still committed to fighting for Washington's families._ This is a longer email than usual, so if you don't have time to read it at length at this moment, [**you can go ahead and make a donation to my campaign here.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95595167/507245118/1521311957?refcode=em24_241022_whyrun_fnd_gq_act___dks_ettx&utm_campaign=em24_241022_whyrun_fnd_gq_act___dks_ettx&utm_medium=email&refcode2=33860fba-b990-ef11-8474-000d3a98fa6b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MTExMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzMzg2MGZiYS1iOTkwLWVmMTEtODQ3NC0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ZIJ0uT4NJ3qNC6Ir_MKuW3d_sdXk_b-tCGay25MWb88=)

In 2017, Congressional Republicans announced their plan to overturn the Affordable Care Act (ACA). **As a pediatrician, I saw firsthand the danger this would pose to my patients and families across America.** I joined three other doctors from my clinic to fight back. We went to our congressman's office to explain how the ACA protected the people of Washington's 8th District – and why it was critical to keep it intact.

**Then, two days later, he voted to overturn the ACA. I knew right then and there that it was time for me to take serious action.**

I realized I could do more for the children and families of this district from a seat in Congress than I ever could from my exam room. So, I made the difficult decision to leave the job I loved and run for office.

Thanks to the incredible support of this grassroots team, we flipped WA-08 blue for the first time ever in 2018, knocking out that same representative who ignored the very concerns I had raised to him just one year prior. _And we went on to keep it blue in 2020 and 2022._ Since then, I've been fighting to give working families a voice in Congress.

Together, we've made some incredible progress. I have had 18 pieces of legislation signed into law under two presidential administrations – all addressing the concerns the people of Washington's 8th District have brought up directly to me. We're doing things differently now in this district, and I refuse to have us go back to a time when our leaders served their party, rather than the people in the district.

As your congresswoman, **I will never stop fighting for accessible, affordable healthcare for every person in this district. I will continue to ensure our farmers and distributors have the resources they need to thrive. And I will always fight my heart out to help anyone in need.**

But now, I need your help to keep up this fight. We're facing another tough election in just 14 days, and we have to give it everything we've got to come out on top. [**Will you chip in $10 right now to help me defend WA-08 and take back the House majority? I'm not done fighting for each and every one of you, Only**four seats** sit between us and flipping the House 14 days from now. I've got some important information to share with you.
Did you know that there are **[4 warning signs of memory loss?](https://email.email.america1stwarroom.com/c/eJw8j72O2zAQBp-G6s4gVzIlFSpyOThFDocgXa4Jln82A_7IS8qO3_4gQXC73wAzi3EO3j0m1r8ygIs3hQGw9hsDuP65R1r-xZ8_XsSVv79c5Uc8rit839EbPOGk8SrFJb9_uo_yqj7rb_rV38QTr4_ZPuFderARfViv_VtjptYZ3jV2Ej2MsgU-QnOZoO-OR6W6USJYECP0DofO8LHVXCjZNn4CDp3gACBAiOGghkFwMYzcoNJOO9bxzXPAaMlrFKXekSjneNA5NmG61DqXLezE4JSwLoRBEfqkci7V0soxOM1ki00Vq8-JtafsnDesfdP5nHxY_jOQuJ-MJ6urWh6FgczOWVoo7PBekdzd0VbdMZCVtrUSpoJ6Ffz1pqHJzHcfgi-yZx0_b1-szbcJvgIAAP__1wWKFA)** I was surprised when I learned about this, and I think you might be too.
Here's something that really caught my attention: Scientists predict that **61% of seniors will have cognitive declining by 2050.**
Can you believe it? That's almost two-thirds the population of older folks!
I don't know about you, but this got me thinking. So, how do we protect ourselves from losing our precious memories?
I mean, our memories are what make us who we are, right?
And here's the thing that really made me sit up and take notice - how could we recognize the **4 warning signs** of brain fog (**#2 is scary!**)?
I think it's something we all need to be aware of.

body:
Peter,
**Every election, Latino voters play a crucial role in determining the next president – and this year is no different. So what’s happening with the Latino vote in 2024?**
For decades, Latino voters reliably favored Democrats in national elections. Democrats have carried the Latino vote by more than 20 points in every election since 2004. In 2012, President Obama received 71% of the Latino vote, the highest share since 1996.
But unfortunately, in 2020 Democrats lost some strength among Latino voters, with President Biden winning roughly 59% among Latinos. And this year, polling shows Trump continuing to make some gains with Latino voters — despite his racist rhetoric and his abysmal record as president — which must be countered by Democrats working overtime to win back the confidence of all working-class voters.
**In 2024, VP Harris and Democrats are NOT taking the Latino vote for granted. Latino voters may decide this election – and we’re working to EARN their votes.**
In fact, today Vice President Harris will unveil a new agenda for Latino men that will include proposals to increase Latino homeownership, provide small businesses with forgivable loans, double the number of Latino apprenticeships, and provide tax benefits for workers who have to buy their own tools and equipment.
Peter, I spent this last week campaigning in Nevada on behalf of Harris-Walz, having real conversations and answering tough questions from Latino voters about Democrats’ plans to address the most important issues.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95595943/507247841/629446958?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NDI5NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhOWI5NTg0ZC1iYzkwLWVmMTEtODQ3NC0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=H9GyJgQj5kBQJyBJaqhhCcz4IG2VI7nrTqEO1i_Tz1k=)
I spoke with voters about the economy, abortion rights, health care — and importantly, what’s at stake for working-class families this November.****
Working-class Latinos make up a huge share of the Latino vote. And like so many working families, Latino voters are frustrated by record income inequality, a stagnant minimum wage, and an economy that seems to be rigged in favor of billionaires.
**As I told them, this election will determine whether we invest in working families with a President Kamala Harris, or continue giving billionaires and big corporations more tax cuts under Donald Trump. Whether we restore abortion rights and protect personal freedom, or allow far-right extremists to dictate our health care decisions. Whether we deliver basic protections for workers in construction or the trades, or allow Trump to continue slashing worker protections to help the bottom line of big business.**
Latino voters deserve a president who will fight for working people no matter what. Kamala Harris and Democrats are focused on improving the lives of working families, including the millions of Latino families who work to put food on the table.

Team: We're two weeks out from one of the most important elections of our lifetime. 14 days to push back against everything Donald Trump and his cronies stand for. While Trump is out there fighting to stay out of prison, Kamala Harris is fighting for you and your family. Kamala is standing up for working families, reproductive rights, voting rights — **your rights**. name: Lonnie Scott, Michigan Legacy PAC
subject: It's Jocelyn's birthday!
body:
Friends, it's Lonnie from the Michigan Legacy PAC.

Our team has been responsible for helping Jocelyn grow the network of Democracy Defenders around the state - and with your help, I'm proud of the work we've been able to do.
You probably know today's a big day in Michigan. Yes - it marks the beginning of the final two weeks to vote in the 2024 Presidential election. But, it's also Jocelyn's birthday!
How has Jocelyn celebrated her birthday today? As anyone who knows her would expect, she's been traveling all around Michigan, doing her duty as Secretary of State to defend democracy and make sure every eligible citizen has the opportunity to vote in a secure and transparent election. Think about this: Our primaries this year were historic. And in this election, over a million citizens have already cast their ballots.

That's what doing the hard work means. And look at how this election has been going so far: Two days ago Detroit became the first city in the state to launch an early in person voting option for its voters. Amazingly, in just two days, we saw over 2,000 Detroiters show up - breaking records and sending a message to the nation: Michiganders are engaged, and we’re voting. All thanks to Jocelyn's leadership and the commitment of her entire team.

And yes, all this is happening as Elon Musk is attacking Jocelyn and using his considerable platform on X to sow false seeds of doubt about her integrity and our elections.
So today let’s take a stand. Join us in wishing Jocelyn a Happy Birthday and thank her for everything she is doing to stand up to anyone, anywhere, who will stand in between your voice and your vote. Can you make a contribution before Jocelyn blows out the candles on her cake tonight to show that we have her back as she works to defend democracy? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michiganlegacypac-oct]

As Jocelyn always says, democracy is a decision. I know the decision we've made. We're all in to do whatever we can to defend democracy. Please help us continue this vital work.

Together,
Lonnie

The negotiations were not successful, Roberson remained on death row in Livingston, and the committee hearing adjourned Tuesday afternoon.

Democratic Rep. **Joe Moody** of El Paso, chairman of the committee, said he will continue to press for Roberson to testify before lawmakers.

"There have been a number of very productive conversations on that front and we will continue to have those and fully anticipate that we will be able to take Mr. Roberson's testimony in the near future, and we're working on those details," Moody said before adjourning.

Moody opened Monday's hearing by saying he was disappointed Roberson would not be testifying but said negotiations were continuing to have him transported from death row to the Capitol.

The committee voted last week, one day before Roberson's scheduled execution, to issue a subpoena compelling him to testify Monday. Prison officials began working to comply with the subpoena, Roberson's lawyer **Gretchen Sween** testified, before the attorney general's office intervened, telling the committee Roberson would be available to testify via video conferencing but not in person.

"**Capitol hearing adjourns a day late without hearing Robert Roberson** ," Dallas Morning News' **Aaron Torres** -- "After hearing more than nine hours of testimony Monday on **Robert Roberson 's** case, the House Criminal Jurisprudence Committee stood at ease - instead of adjourning - as lawmakers worked to get the death row inmate to appear in person in Austin.
The negotiations were not successful, Roberson remained on death row in Livingston, and the committee hearing adjourned Tuesday afternoon.

Democratic Rep. **Joe Moody** of El Paso, chairman of the committee, said he will continue to press for Roberson to testify before lawmakers.

"There have been a number of very productive conversations on that front and we will continue to have those and fully anticipate that we will be able to take Mr. Roberson's testimony in the near future, and we're working on those details," Moody said before adjourning.

Moody opened Monday's hearing by saying he was disappointed Roberson would not be testifying but said negotiations were continuing to have him transported from death row to the Capitol.

The committee voted last week, one day before Roberson's scheduled execution, to issue a subpoena compelling him to testify Monday. Prison officials began working to comply with the subpoena, Roberson's lawyer **Gretchen Sween** testified, before the attorney general's office intervened, telling the committee Roberson would be available to testify via video conferencing but not in person.

body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

Today, we’re officially two weeks away from Election Day.

While it’s critical we make our voices heard in the 2024 general election,
including re-electing Justice Democrat incumbents like Representatives
Ilhan Omar, Rashida Tlaib, Summer Lee, and more, we recognize the fact
that we deserve more progressives on the ballot, from top to bottom.

That’s why Justice Democrats is looking ahead to the 2025-2026 cycle and
preparing to recruit the next generation of young, diverse, working-class
progressives to run for Congress.

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jd-em-20241022?refcode=em20241022-36087&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&refcode2=36087_1203867_nE3XHs&akid=36087%2E1203867%2EnE3XHs ]Will you support our Candidate Recruitment Fund with a contribution of
$5 or whatever you can afford today?

It’s beyond clear: we need more bold, courageous visionaries who are
committed to making change for regular, everyday people through
legislation like Medicare for All, the Green New Deal, the Equality Act,
an arms embargo and ceasefire resolution, and so much more.

But with corporate and right-wing super PACs like AIPAC and the crypto
lobby spending more and more dark money in our elections to plant shills
in Congress who will do their bidding, Congressional races are becoming
more expensive than ever before. That’s why we need to start building the
grassroots resources to find, recruit, train, and support progressive
candidates NOW.

With your help, we recruited and elected Squad members like AOC who are
leading our progressive movement and building real power in Congress. But
after losing Representatives Cori Bush and Jamaal Bowman in this year’s
most expensive Democratic primary elections, it’s going to take a
groundswell of grassroots support to rebuild the bloc.

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jd-em-20241022?refcode=em20241022-36087&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=36087_1203867_nE3XHs&akid=36087%2E1203867%2EnE3XHs ]Every donation, from $5 to $500, makes a real impact. We don’t expect
you to donate to every email like this, but if you can, please consider
investing in our 2025-2026 Candidate Recruitment Fund today!

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jd-em-20241022?refcode=em20241022-36087&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&refcode2=36087_1203867_nE3XHs&akid=36087%2E1203867%2EnE3XHs ]Contribute $5

We are a truly people-powered operation. The sooner we build up our
financial resources, the better our chances of finding and electing the
next set of Justice Democrats to fight for our progressive values in
Congress.

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

Contribute to Justice Democrats: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/justicedemocrats?refcode=em20241022-36087-footer&t=1002&refcode2=36087_1203867_nE3XHs&akid=36087%2E1203867%2EnE3XHs

## Don't listen to "vibes" -- here is the DATA...
[](https://substack.com/redirect/f932250a-4eef-4424-bc07-2013a838c266?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
I've said it before and I'll say it again, when it comes to elections, I'm a data guy, trust the data. Seth Keshel joins me to talk about all the latest data, numbers on registration, early vote and more -- don't miss this one to know where we stand right now.
## Sean Spicer Show LIVE on Election Night...
We're planning something big for Election Night and I want you to mark your calendar now. I will be live 8 pm Eastern to midnight (maybe beyond depending on what happens) giving you my unfiltered take, real time reactions, the data I'm checking AND bringing you into all the different appearances I'm doing on other networks.
Some details are still being worked out, but mark your calendar, subscribe to my YouTube and hit the notification button so you don't miss it.
[CLICK HERE](https://substack.com/redirect/01ef5d8c-e6f4-4bdd-9241-11b5247895b5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
## Stories I'm Reading...
[Football coach and cheerleader: How Tim Walz is defining masculinity in 2024](https://substack.com/redirect/8edfe6ce-cc30-4004-ae09-c989c4f0727f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) -- via USA Today
[4 vulnerable Dem candidates - Baldwin (WI), Slotkin (MI), Tester (MT) and Casey (PA) are up with ads tying themselves to Trump](https://substack.com/redirect/5926e201-a9da-4749-af67-f286f7b7393f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) -- via Axios
[Harris has a problem with young voters, a key voting block for Dems](https://substack.com/redirect/5e3bd294-085f-4c6e-808b-23974e5129ca?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) -- via NBC News
[Scoop: Bernie Moreno leads in GOP polling of Ohio Senate race](https://substack.com/redirect/42add4cd-3fcf-448d-9047-b273ceb5718a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) -- via Axios
['Now I like him': Some Black voters in Georgia see Trump as a real option](https://substack.com/redirect/be31bc62-fb16-4dda-b939-8bb5dbd01f91?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) -- via Politico
## The final 14 days
My how times have changed. This is has been most unreal election cycle in modern history.
First Trump came out to an early lead over Biden because - well let's face it - voters saw that Biden's age was an issue. After that historically early debate it seemed a Trump return to the White House was a forgone conclusion. Biden wasn't going to get younger and the issues were only going to get worse.
Then, in a move that seemed unreal, Biden was pushed out and Kamala was coronated. ...

| | Caroleene Dobson is a distinguished attorney, wife, mother, District Two resident, and a lifelong advocate for conservative values. Born and raised in Beatrice, Alabama, Dobson grew up on her family's fifth-generation cattle farm, where she learned the meaning of hard work and developed a firsthand understanding of the challenges faced by hardworking families and entrepreneurs. Currently practicing real estate law at the Maynard Nexsen law firm, Dobson represents a diverse clientele, including homebuilders, retailers, small business owners, and private landowners. She has spent her career advocating for her client’s interests while also achieving tangible, positive outcomes. In Congress, she will hold true to her core conservative values while ensuring Washington D.C. is working for the people of District Two. A passionate advocate for families, farms, and faith, Dobson aims to preserve the bedrock values and moral backbone that have defined our nation. With a call for Alabama common sense, she is determined to challenge the far-left agenda in Washington, D.C., advocating for the rights of property owners and defending the freedom to think, speak, and act without interference. Caroleene, alongside her husband Bobby, is the proud parent of two daughters, Philippa and Lydia. Her decision to run for Congress is deeply rooted in a desire to secure a future for her children and to champion the principles that have made America the land of the free.

It's exciting, but it's also a reminder that we're in the final stretch – and that we urgently need to work together to win. Here's why:

Hey team — it’s Wes Moore, Governor of Maryland. For the last several months, I’ve been working hard to elect Vice President Kamala Harris as our next President of the United States. # Melton for Iowa 2024
---
---
| Hello Peter,

This is Ryan Melton, Democrat running for the U.S. House in Iowa's 4th Congressional District. During my 2024 campaign, I'll send you a weekly email to keep you in the loop while not overwhelming your inbox. Typically, the newsletter will be a review from the week prior: Where we went, what issues of note were on the minds of those I met with, where we'll be in the next week, etc.
Where I went on the campaign trail last week: Last week, I attended a disability care forum at Northwestern College in Orange City, drove up to Rochester, MN to film a local news segment for a station that covers the north central part of Iowa, attended a Heartland Family Services legislative forum, spoke at the Brown-Woodard Dinner in Boone, attended a postcard writing even in Ames where my amazing volunteers wrote 400 post cards, did some door knocking and sign planting in Story county, and attended meet and greets in Marshalltown and Story City.
The pressing issue on the campaign trail last week: Hello all,
Sorry I haven't sent out a newsletter the past couple weeks. It's been super, super busy, but in a good way. Per the media section below, I've done so many interviews lately I've forgotten everyone I've interviewed with, but I've linked to those below. We also just hit 30,000 post cards sent, so thank you so much to our volunteers, including many readers of this email, that helped with that. I also just texted 94,000 Republicans and 50,000 Independents in our Congressional district and have been working through those replies when I've had the time. While certainly there are plenty of Republicans that are hard nos in those replies when it comes to voting for me, there are plenty that are definitive yesses. Others say they are writing in my opponent Randy Feenstra's Republican primary opponent Kevin Virgil. Remember, Virgil endorsed me back in August. I want to share some of the positive replies from those Republicans, because my ask is for you, if willing and able, to reach out to your friends and family, including your right-leaning friends and family, letting them know our campaign has built a cross-partisan coalition. Let them know a lot of Republican voters are sending a message to Republican party leadership at the voting booth this time that it's time for them to stop selling their rank and file voters out to the corporate titans of the state. A lot of Republicans in the district are ready to make a protest vote over their party leadership's defense of the carbon capture pipelines, attacks on public ed and the AEA's, lack of care for the water pollution crisis in our state, disregard for the fact we're the only state in the country with a rising cancer incidence rate, and amplification of the economic, infrastructural, and population hollowing out of most of our district's communities.
"Even though I am a life time rep I will only vote Democratic on this election. I am disappointed with the rep position to ignore trumps attack on democracy. I will vote for you"
"Ryan, Nice text. And effective. Will be pulling for you."
"I've read about you and watched you on believe Iowa Press where Feenstra didn't show up. I support you and you will have my vote."
"I'm a republican and you have my vote"
"Already got your sign in my yard. Keep up the good work."
"You certainly have my vote."
"Randy is uni-party republican and it's time for him to go!! He's spineless and has no morals."
Our schedule for this week: This week, I plan on attending some tabling events for early voting at Iowa State University late-week, the Humboldt Co Dems Stew Supper Friday evening, a meet and greet Sunday 10/27 from 1-3 at Jackson Brewery in Sioux City, and I plan on doing plenty of door knocking and sign planting in between.
Recent press/social media posts of note: Recent interviews:
https://www.timesrepublican.com/news/todays-news/2024/10/meet-the-candidates-2024-u-s-house-district-4-pt-1/
https://www.timesrepublican.com/news/todays-news/2024/10/meet-the-candidates-2024-u-s-house-district-4-pt-2/
https://www.kcci.com/article/close-up-early-voting-iowa-elections/62639461
https://www.kwit.org/podcast/whats-the-frequency/2024-10-18/whats-the-frequency-incumbent-feenstra-and-democrat-melton-weigh-in-on-their-iowa-4th-congressional-district-rematch
https://nonpareilonline.com/news/state-regional/government-politics/elections/feenstra-melton-rematch-iowa-fourth-district/article_fa22563f-c4ac-5812-82dd-75c0378e380d.html

We again are rejecting all Corporate PAC money, so we really rely on, and are extremely grateful for your support. We'll spend your donations on ways to expand our reach to as many voters as possible, including: -Post cards and other mailers and postage -Hand out cards for events -Text messaging campaigns -Transportation costs for events and door knocking -Campaign website costs -Radio ads, Social Media Ads, and (hopefully) TV ads -Our campaign staffers
Finally, if you have anyone else in mind that would like to be added to our email list or who would be interested in volunteering, let us know at melton4iowa@gmail.com!
Let's keep fighting the good fight together! Ryan Melton

**Republicans are sounding the alarm. ** A private memo sent to Republican mega donors has been leaked and team, they are calling for an all hands on deck situation here in CA-45. **Alarming fact: More than 48 million Americans hear so poorly that their quality of life significantly suffers as a result.**

The problem: Most wait too long to act, hoping their hearing will improve on its own. Sadly, it never does.

But now, **a game-changing device is revolutionizing the hearing aid industry,** and experts say it's the biggest breakthrough they've seen in over a decade.

Free and Equal debates show what a real debate should look like, with all candidates on the ballot invited to participate. As of now, the other candidates who've accepted the challenge to debate include Chase Oliver of the Libertarian Party and Randall Terry of the Constitution Party. Contrast this open debate with the exclusive, phony "debates" organized by the Democrats and Republicans to keep all other voices from being heard on the debate stage. When Kamala Harris shared a debate stage with Donald Trump, both candidates agreed on the need for fossil fuel expansion, draconian immigration restrictions, and unconditional support for Israel's genocidal war machine, with no other candidate allowed on the stage to challenge these duopoly dogmas. Harris and Trump are done debating, meaning Wednesday's Free and Equal debate is likely to be the last presidential debate before Election Day. It's sure to be a lively debate, and afterwards Free and Equal will hold a vote to determine the winner, so please join us to watch and support Jill!

Fellow American, the Senate majority will come down to just 7 races:

**Montana
Ohio

**
Here's the bad news, Fellow American. Our candidates are being outraised by millions in these states.

Right now, there's about a $50 million resource gap on TV between Democrats and Republicans. Yes, you read that right, Democrats have _**$50 million dollars more in TV ads**_ than Republicans.

[**TAKE BACK THE SENATE ⇒ HELP 7 RACES **](http://links.conservativesfordjt.com/u/click?_t=05b03ef2209247bcbdad7fd5099cd670&_m=c2ed2e3253ec400b91ef051ba851ebd7&_e=Fq6wj-0BkI2p2duvU33XkcMna7AWN0tjyLsw6iesyxWtOF-l29XFKjGDK4xRpjysXa4D0jfAVtl3thmuPzM3ccPElwK7XXgzenjjFDppSyKB321rTxrJebxJliWd2EiwlKFsO-YtcC9IFp58pLQh91SNmswSJnFr6lt-2kqoaIZlmedUSia31DXAPS3Jn-fNTNnjZZSspwxEPAXKH9anbP1Fo3nG5SXzERUe4TJIeUDq0rHL8sjp8d2IrELWKLnOT-n1fiO1krI7wTsC59Vw_rUrQJf0n5j-3z0WXcgIpkCjJXcc44vBYwgHQotQjtMPDgpaS6ahPtGxifN1wiWDZ6d_e0_H7Db9QrrDhBMrIvB141rxCCq1mIMxiqIRJGBROS5u6y4Jwp2QZiHEWi8vBQ%3D%3D)
But this isn't just about the Senate. These states will also be CRITICAL for President Trump to win back the White House.

President Trump is polling neck-and-neck with Kamala Harris in battleground states. If our Senate races are successful, it will help Donald Trump DEFEAT Kamala Harris where it matters most.

I know what we're up against, Fellow American. Democrats are raising and spending millions more than us, but we have a better message.

_Kamala Harris has done NOTHING to secure our border as Vice President._ **Donald Trump and a Republican Senate will BUILD THE WALL.**

_Joe Biden and Kamala Harris were responsible for our disastrous Afghanistan withdrawal._**Republican candidates like Tim Sheehy, Sam Brown, and Dave McCormick actually have SERVED overseas.**

This is what happens when leaders like Marsha Blackburn spend two decades in Washington chasing special interest dollars instead of actually doing their jobs.
**_Marsha’s made it her mission to attack public schools instead of funding them, to single out the LGBTQ+ community instead of protecting their rights, to vote against lowering prescription drug costs, and to back tax cuts for the wealthy—while working families pick up the tab._**
High crime, limited healthcare access, and controversial laws are pushing our state to the bottom. We can’t afford to keep electing far-right extremists like Marsha who have nothing to show for their time in office but a track record of extremist attacks.
**The clock is ticking, and in two weeks, we’ll decide whether to move forward or face another six years of Marsha Blackburn’s failed leadership. I need to know right now—are you ready to help me flip Tennessee blue?**

Battleground States & Townhall Debates | The Latino Vote Episode 59
| Chuck and Mike share key insights from recent races, focusing on the **shifting dynamics in battleground states**. Chuck highlights the significance of Senate candidate Ruben Gallego’s lead in Arizona while raising concerns about the tightening race in Wisconsin, where changing demographics and union member defection are reshaping voter behavior.

The discussion turns to **Donald Trump’s recent town hall on Univision** and **Vice President Kamala Harris's strategic decision to appear on Fox News** , as they try to grab hold of the key demographics which won the last presidential election: college-educated white women and Latino communities.

body:
[](http://links.conservativeum.com/u/click?_t=26c2e4aa9bbe40418f61e26972138f21&_m=0f23fbb79d46434f94bb8a291d91713f&_e=gVHbnalQ2pvucT22_C0MzL3PQn_wXhI_E5cncfjAA2ceLd3TyH9hZuuU7OZKS3VjFblYyLCxxZGBqHf6dOWxoPD20SaDqVWRydpQwZCBrECtw8EYNxzo_GGmdpYnKiq02E3i8MRY41dAImqVW6MHsuClxbbq4kZUzy-q7hFikaBPePXpzITS7yucI9izL8r-v8lKY9TH0CCpsVCzIdhp5eVDDLEqwboXyuj-looWM3LjJB075ya_EL76c1kWhZV2w1VQb04JXn6jRHFIcUCNlbk0rx3il211_0vNQNJWZNwafFBPpgOvXQVFS23cNtx1YbX9k6ntH_4W9ebgyPwCykaL5hYdqef76pVYVOdrsdXf1WzB_sfh4u_PnwLz53MWrTF1QrH1iFe5Mj4zqyi-as7wsWwxCmKM7IKHm-BZPd8%3D)
Peter,

Do you know what's the 2nd most popular book in America in the 20th century after the Bible? _Atlas Shrugged_!

_Atlas Shrugged_ by Ayn Rand is an epic adventure story, a mystery, a sci-fi thriller, and a love story rolled into one. It's a cautionary tale of the consequences of a society embracing the doctrines of irrationalism, self-sacrifice, brute force, and collectivism: boarded-up storefronts, broken supply chains, stagflation, unemployment, and mounting cynicism.

We see these predicted consequences all around us today! Yet, as Ayn Rand herself observed: "_Atlas Shrugged_ is not a prophecy of our unavoidable destruction, but a manifesto of our power to avoid it, if we choose to change our course."

This is a message that the younger generation desperately needs to hear so they stop sacrificing themselves on the altar of collectivist delusions, like climate change hysteria, social justice, or identity politics.

Unfortunately, young people simply aren't reading like they once did.

**Fifty years ago, 70% of young people read books every day just for fun. Today, that number has dropped to 12%.**

Can you imagine convincing them to pick up a 1,000-page novel? It's not easy!

This is about the future of our country, our families, and the kind of world we want to live in. | [](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=04d72604cddd4f0781841e5a2d95f03d&_e=2Yk2Wys7UEgQp1c_Bigun_OcW5eooGRhKtBRe3Ht2Hy-A8MsyBpNmXLigq1dYigaN5-1bvzybKCj9igxlVWAsrVHHNaUaikXnWU5EuoUjeko3MjyT7nF_wU-ML4Ji_ArQKSzjx6gu6WpxIp5atMCs01InYdKRrVlV29vLyn2wJPShuE8okuy8dQ4qLmy_kXocN7q3PPNOVCZf8LIx1CgHIc0Z9lpllBEF-GMZxD8Gm1XMzJBz3vzeQ_BIdcGp85uw4tpfX7TfCQ6v5OVEnVnyMnr5arabjR062KErYHwhYiofmqyb1MpQxvkZKq1w4LYRkMOriCr9Tr6-kvNByisBGDgKGd_QM8wvCzphDujg27D703TOW9yck-4ImhokD5qFTc0gLRdrjL0I4iSWS5ZoA%3D%3D)

**Two weeks.** That’s all the time we’ve got, Peter.

In two weeks, America will decide if we continue down this insane path of chaos, incompetence, and failure brought on by the radical left. OR, if we finally slam the door shut on useless career politicians like my opponent, Sherrod Brown.

In today’s digital age, we must combat the growing threat of AI-driven misinformation to protect our elections. Election workers across the country are stepping up to face this challenge head-on.
In Colorado, county election officials received a specialized training to recognize AI-generated misinformation. This cutting-edge effort is crucial, as bad actors may use increasingly sophisticated tools. You can read more about the initiative here. [https://www.cpr.org/2024/08/08/state-election-workers-ai-misinformation-training/]

To learn more about how election workers are being trained to spot the latest AI-driven threats, be sure to check out the full story here. Sherrod Brown. Just a month ago, Brown led by 4 points. A new poll taken October 15-16 shows Moreno with a 1-point lead, 47%-46%!
